osaka_iwai_bettei_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Courses combine sushi with tempura (wheat batter) and side dishes such as a fish katsu sandwich (July 2026); sushi is usually served with soy sauce or a soy glaze, which normally contains wheat.
osaka_iwai_bettei_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of sushi, seafood and tempura.
osaka_iwai_bettei_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 16:00–23:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; phone cancellations are not taken outside business hours (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: counter and private rooms for 2, 4 and 6; whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 10 September 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_iwai_bettei_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, sushi and tempura in one course] The Kitashinchi branch of Iwai, a group that grew from a tempura and wine restaurant in Ashiya whose Michelin star two years running made its name (official site); here the tempura shares a course with Edo-style sushi. Weekday lunch starts at a ¥4,990 nigiri set and climbs to a ¥9,990 premium omakase with tempura, which makes it one of the gentler ways into a Kitashinchi counter; at dinner diners report spending ¥10,000–14,999 (Tabelog). Courses open with small seasonal dishes (Akashi octopus, a fruit-tomato frappé, steamed abalone in August 2026), then tempura and nigiri such as kombu-cured sea bream, seared kinmedai and toro. Diners describe a chef who talks diners through each dish and puts nervous first-timers at ease; the tempura is soft rather than crisp, which a June 2026 diner did not care for and a July 2026 diner called a matter of taste. Private rooms for two to six (a December 2025 diner booked one for a business dinner); tell the chef if you are short of time. Service charge 10%.

roles: Owner (unnamed; "very approachable", August 2026 review)
Head chef (unnamed), who explains each dish (July 2026 review)
chef_bio.origin: Branch of 鮨 天ぷら いわい, which began in Ashiya, Hyogo as 天ぷら&ワイン いわい (official site).
chef_bio.background: Group site (read 2026-11-01): the original Ashiya restaurant earned a Michelin star two years running ("ミシュランガイドで2年連続一つ星を獲得"), then opened in Gion (Kyoto), Ginza (Tokyo), Hiroshima and elsewhere, some shops adding Edo-style sushi; the shops listed now are Kitashinchi, Hiroshima, Gion, Kichijoji and Ginza. The group's owner (店主, unnamed) holds wine-sommelier and vegetable-sommelier qualifications, grew up in a family that ran a Japanese restaurant, and has long hotel experience. The Tabelog listing calls this shop the Kitashinchi opening of the Michelin-listed "Ashiya Iwai"; the group site lists the same address as 北新地 鮨 天ぷら いわい. In 2026 reviews the owner is "very approachable" (August) and the head chef explains each dish (July).
chef_bio.philosophy: "自然の物語を天ぷらに閉じ込める" — sealing nature's story into tempura, with seasonal produce (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi and tempura in one course.

anecdotes.text: "As soon as we were seated, the chef kindly engaged us in conversation, helping my wife, who is usually shy, to relax." — August 2026, a second visit, with family.
"Given the location, the staff is mindful of time, so if you're in a hurry, it might be a good idea to inform the chef in advance!" — July 2026, a family celebration on the ¥10,000 course.
"Since we were seated at the counter, we could watch the sushi being prepared right in front of us" — October 2026, lunch on the Omakase Premium Course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 鮨 天ぷら いわい、兵庫県芦屋市の「天ぷら&ワイン いわい」から始まり、ミシュランガイドで2年連続一つ星、その後祇園、銀座、広島などに出店、一部の店では江戸前寿司も、店主はワインソムリエと野菜ソムリエの資格を持ち、日本料理店が生家でホテルでの経験も豊富、店舗は北新地、広島、祇園、吉祥寺、銀座。北新地の店: 大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-9-11 1F、ランチ11:30〜14:00、ディナー17:00〜23:00 (土日祝16:00〜23:00)、不定休、サービス料10%。食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 鮨 天ぷら いわい 別邸、北新地駅から徒歩2分、平日限定ランチのにぎりのセット4,990円、ランチのおまかせ6,990円、天ぷらつきの Premium Omakase 9,990円、20席、個室2・4・6名、禁煙、子ども可、2023年9月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年1〜10月): 1万円のコース、6,990円のコース、前菜、天ぷら、握り、いくらの小さな丼、茶碗蒸し、大将が料理を説明して緊張をほぐしてくれる、珍しい日本酒とビール、天ぷらはさくさくではなくやわらかめ、急ぐなら先に伝えて。

osaka_sushi_sogoro_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Course dishes include spring rolls (wheat wrappers) and a thickened ankake dashi sauce (September 2026); nigiri is usually finished with soy sauce or a glaze, which normally contains wheat.
osaka_sushi_sogoro_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase course of fish, shellfish and sushi.
osaka_sushi_sogoro_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00, holidays included (Tabelog); "Closed: None" (September 2026 review). Reservations needed (December 2024 review); the shop may not answer the phone during service, so book online (Tabelog). A year-end surcharge applies 24–31 December 2026 and 1–11 January 2027 (¥1,000 dinner, ¥500 lunch; Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats, all with chairs; non-smoking; no children below junior-high age; go easy on perfume (Tabelog). Opened 28 November 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_sogoro_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi main street, seven seats] A seven-seat counter on Kitashinchi's main street that began as a standing sushi bar; the sign still said so in December 2024, but everyone sits now. The chef picks the fish each morning, the rice is cooked in a clay pot and seasoned with red vinegar, and the monthly omakase mixes inventive small plates with small, easy nigiri: in September 2026, a butternut-squash potage with crab, seared bonito with a corn sauce, ayu spring rolls, sanma sushi heaped with ikura, then about ten nigiri including oyster, marinated tuna and fluffy anago. At ¥13,200 for dinner (lunch ¥6,600 or ¥8,800), diners call it remarkably reasonable for Kitashinchi. The chef is friendly and full of jokes, described in a December 2024 review as multilingual. One December 2025 diner felt rushed by sushi piling up; on a return in September 2026 the same diner found the service much improved. Seats are close together. No children below junior-high age; book ahead.

roles: Chef (unnamed), who chooses the fish each morning (Tabelog; December 2024 review)
Owner (unnamed; mentioned in a September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 28 November 2013 (Tabelog); first a standing sushi bar, now seated (reviews, December 2024 and September 2026). Tabelog Sushi WEST 100, 2021. The shop text: sushi has become more exclusive over time, and the shop aims to bring back the casualness and joy of sushi's origins, travelling the country to choose ingredients (Tabelog). Diners describe a "friendly and skilled chef" who "runs the establishment with charm" (September 2026), a chef "sharing some silly jokes to lighten the mood" (September 2026), and a "multilingual and friendly chef" (December 2024); a June 2024 diner heard that the chef is "quite the eccentric cook".
chef_bio.philosophy: To recreate the casualness and joy of sushi's origins and show each ingredient at its best (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly omakase of small plates and nigiri on red-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: "Next was the Katsuo no Tataki. I was told to enjoy it with a sauce made from corn paste... I thought it was a bold dish, but it paired perfectly and was delicious!" — September 2026, the ¥13,200 course.
"Although it mentions standing sushi, you can now enjoy it seated at a leisurely pace." — September 2026, the ¥12,000 omakase (before tax).
"I visited after 9 months, and it seems there has been some training implemented. The service has significantly improved." — September 2026, a return after a December 2025 visit that felt rushed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 惣五郎、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-3-32 新地リバティービル 1F、北新地駅から徒歩2分、毎日11:30〜14:00、17:00〜23:00、営業中は電話に出られないことがあるのでネット予約を、おまかせ13,200円、ランチ6,600円と8,800円 (税込、月替わり)、年末年始は追加料金、カード (VISA、Master)、カウンター7席 (すべて椅子)、禁煙、中学生未満は不可、香水は控えめに、毎朝仕入れる食材、土鍋で炊くご飯、2013年11月28日オープン、寿司 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年10月): 赤酢のシャリ、小ぶりの握り、かぼちゃのポタージュ、カツオとコーンのソース、鮎の春巻き、いくらをのせたサンマの鮨、はもと茄子の松茸あんかけ、牡蠣の握り、もとは立ち鮨で今は座って食べる、冗談の好きな気さくな大将、2025年12月に急かされたと感じた人が2026年9月にはサービスがよくなったと書いている。

osaka_critters_burger_nishishinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Every burger comes on the house bun of Hokkaido wheat (Kansai Walker 2018; a September 2026 review), and pancakes, fries and onion rings fill out the menu; no gluten-free bun is described.
osaka_critters_burger_nishishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the burgers are built on an all-beef patty with mayonnaise, bacon, cheese or egg, and no meat-free burger appears in the sources read.
osaka_critters_burger_nishishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, last order 21:00; weekday lunch 11:00–16:00; open all year (Tabelog). Reservations only for the evening, from 18:00; walk in at lunch, when a few groups may be waiting at opening (Tabelog; September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) for bills over ¥5,000, e-money and QR payments; PayPay (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 25 seats, tables only; smoking allowed from 17:00, non-smoking until then; pets allowed; take-out (Tabelog). Opened 23 May 2009 (Tabelog).
osaka_critters_burger_nishishinsaibashi.notes: [Burgers · Amerikamura, a pioneer since 2009] A wood-fronted American burger house in Amerikamura that opened in 2009, before gourmet burgers had caught on in Kansai, and has been in Tabelog's Hamburger 100 seven times since 2017. The bun is the point: made from Hokkaido wheat and natural yeast at the sister bakery, toasted, fluffy inside and firm enough to hold the juicy all-beef patty to the last bite. Order the double cheeseburger (¥2,365 in October 2026), or the spinach bacon burger, the house favourite since at least 2018. Expect a few groups waiting at the 11:00 opening and many overseas visitors; evening tables can be booked from 18:00. Note that smoking is allowed from 17:00.

roles: Representative of CRITTERS BURGER (Kansai Walker 2018)
chef_bio.background: Per Kansai Walker (2018): the representative 栗田宗太朗 went to an international school hoping to study at an American university, then trained at an architecture college, qualified as an architect and worked three or four years as a site supervisor for a housebuilder. The father, a programmer, baked bread as a hobby and opened a bakery near the family home, baking every morning while the mother sold the bread; the younger brother, three years younger, came in to help. The brothers decided to make burgers with that bread, ran a mobile stall for about a year around 淀屋橋 and at festivals, and opened the shop in Shinsaibashi, an area known since high school, in 2009 with 20 burgers on the menu. The first two years were hard and delivery kept the shop going. When the family bakery could no longer keep up with the buns, West Wood Bakers opened in 2013, then The Pie Shop in 2016 (Kansai Walker). Time Out (2025) calls it a pioneer of high-end beef burgers in Osaka. Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Bring American food culture to Japan and serve it with an arrangement of our own" (Kansai Walker 2018, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Spinach bacon burger; double cheeseburger; house buns of Hokkaido wheat.

anecdotes.text: "The bun was fluffy on top and firmer on the bottom, with a slight sweetness from the bread and richness from the cheese" — October 2026, a Double Cheeseburger for JPY 2,365 on a Sunday at 5:50 PM; full 15 minutes later.
"The music playing in the restaurant happened to be my favorite Southern American artists like Dr. John and Lynyrd Skynyrd" — September 2026, a spinach bacon burger before a concert.
"I entered the restaurant a bit hesitantly, but I was warmly welcomed." — September 2026, the mozzarella mushroom burger lunch set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 関西ウォーカー (ウォーカープラス、2018年): クリッターズバーガー、まだ関西にグルメバーガーの波が来ていなかった2009年から関西のハンバーガー界を牽引、代表の栗田宗太朗さん、高校はインターナショナルスクール、建築の専門学校で建築士の資格、ハウスメーカーの現場監督を3、4年、プログラマーの父が趣味でパンを作り家の近所にパン屋、毎朝父が焼き母が売る、3つ下の弟が手伝い、兄弟でハンバーガーを作ることに、淀屋橋やフェスで移動販売を約1年、心斎橋に路面店、メニューは最初から20種、最初の2年は苦労してデリバリーで食いつなぐ、2013年にウエストウッドベーカーズ、2016年にザ パイ ショップ、バンズは姉妹店で焼く北海道産小麦100%のブレンドと天然酵母の長時間発酵、パティは牛100%つなぎなし、国産牛と輸入牛のブレンド、ソースは使わずマヨネーズとマスタードのみ、人気ナンバーワンはスピナッチ（ホウレンソウ）ベーコンバーガー、ベーコンエッグパンケーキも人気、テーブル席のみ、テラス席、創業2009年5月23日。公式サイト: 大阪市中央区西心斎橋一丁目10-35 1階、無休、姉妹店 Critters Pizza、West Wood Bakers、The Pie Shop。食べログ (店舗会員): 毎日11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、平日ランチ11:00〜16:00、夜のみ予約可 (18時以降)、カードは5,000円以上、電子マネー・QR可、25席、17時まで禁煙でその後は喫煙可、ペット可、テイクアウト可、ハンバーガー 百名店 2017〜2019・2021・2022・2024・2026。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): ダブルチーズバーガー2,365円、トーストしたふわふわのバンズ、ジューシーなパティ、ほうれん草とベーコンのバーガー、開店時から数組が待つ、海外の客が多い。

osaka_cafe_basara_kaerudo_kitahorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The house curry is a thick sauce simmered for 100 hours with no stated ingredients, and much of the menu is breaded or wrapped: katsu curry, croquettes, fried vegetables, omurice with demi-glace, curry ramen; the monthly Inaka Gozen has included grilled fresh wheat gluten (July 2026).
osaka_cafe_basara_kaerudo_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. There is a vegetable curry (September 2026), the monthly Inaka Gozen is mostly vegetables (July 2026), and the omurice can come with a soy-milk cream sauce (September 2026), but nothing is stated about the curry base, stock or dairy.
osaka_cafe_basara_kaerudo_kitahorie.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:00–20:00; Wed 11:00–15:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Weekday lunch until 15:00 includes a free coffee or tea (July and October 2026 reviews). Lunch fills up around noon; mid-afternoon is quieter (2026 reviews). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 40 seats with sofas and a terrace; smoking only on the terrace; dogs welcome on the terrace; children welcome (Tabelog). The monthly Inaka Gozen menu is posted on Instagram at the start of each month (July 2026 review).
osaka_cafe_basara_kaerudo_kitahorie.notes: [Curry café · Kita-Horie by Nishi-Ohashi Stn] A slightly hidden, old-style café a minute from Nishi-Ohashi Station, where the smell of curry reaches the street. The curry is the reason to come: fruits and vegetables simmered for 100 hours into a thick sauce, sweet and fruity at first and then building heat. Order the Tonchi curry with grilled pork and cheese (¥1,200 in August 2026), add croquettes or a pile of fried vegetables, or have it over omurice; at weekday lunch a coffee or tea comes free, and a large rice gets a refill. The monthly Inaka Gozen of small vegetable dishes is the lighter choice. The owner cooks everything alone, so busy lunches mean a short wait (September 2026). Dogs are welcome on the terrace. Cash only. Tabelog Cafe WEST 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2025.

roles: Owner-cook, unnamed in the sources read

The BAILA blog (2024, updated 2026) calls it an old-house-style café known for a curry of fruits and vegetables simmered 100 hours, and a past Tabelog 100 shop. Tabelog Cafe WEST 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2025.

anecdotes.text: "The presentation was impressive, with fried vegetables piled high on top of the katsu." — September 2026, a katsu curry plate after 1 PM, with a short wait because the owner cooks everything alone.
"The staff kindly changed my partner's order to the large size because they were happy to see us enjoying our meal." — October 2026, on the terrace.
"The curry is simmered for 100 hours, resulting in a thick, sauce-like consistency that is wonderfully rich. It doesn't contain any chunks of ingredients." — July 2026.

osaka_ajinoya_honten_namba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: okonomiyaki and negiyaki are wheat-batter dishes and the yakisoba uses the house noodles; no gluten-free option described.
osaka_ajinoya_honten_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba on the official menu carries pork, beef, seafood, egg or cheese.
osaka_ajinoya_honten_namba.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00, a full close at 22:00; closed Monday and New Year's Day, and sometimes the last Monday and Tuesday of the month (official site). Tabelog gives last order 21:30, and on Friday and Saturday 11:00–22:30 (last order 22:00). No same-day bookings and no bookings by phone or email; a TableCheck FastPass buys a timed place at the front of the queue (up to 4 people, valid 15 minutes after the slot, the whole party present, 90 minutes at busy times), and bookings through AutoReserve are void (official site). The queue is otherwise long: an hour or more at 17:00–18:00 in October 2026, with a check-in terminal outside that sends an SMS as your turn nears, and orders taken while you wait. Each okonomiyaki takes about 15 minutes to cook (official site). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 10 counter seats and 10 tables, up to 45 people (official site; Tabelog says 50 seats); non-smoking; English menu; children welcome (Tabelog). Founded 1965 (official site).
osaka_ajinoya_honten_namba.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Namba, a queue since 1965] An okonomiyaki house founded in 1965, on a second floor opposite the stage door of the 松竹座 theatre, with a retro interior that the shop itself likens to a trip back to an old downtown okonomiyaki stand. Staff mix, pour, flip and sauce every okonomiyaki on the iron plate at your table; the batter is light, the result fluffy, sweetish sauce on top. Order the Ajinoya Mix, the tomato and cheese, or the Kujo green-onion negiyaki with beef tendon, which October 2026 diners singled out. The queue is the catch: in October 2026 an hour or more at dinner, so register at the terminal outside, walk off and come back on the text message, or buy a FastPass. In Tabelog's Okonomiyaki 100 most years since 2018, it now has two sister shops, 味乃家はなれ and 四代目味乃家, the second opened in July 2026 at the Namba Oriental Hotel.

roles: Shop manager (店舗責任者) of the main shop: 空山 嘉津子 (official site)
Operator: Ajinoya Inc.; news on the official site is signed 味乃家 店主
chef_bio.background: Founded 1965 in Namba and "passed down through four generations" (Tabelog shop text). The official site describes over 50 years of okonomiyaki grilled in front of the customer, so that diners enjoy the sizzle, the smell and the fluffy texture. Sister shops: 味乃家はなれ (reservation only, formerly the 寺田町 central kitchen, 天王寺区) and 四代目味乃家 (opened 31 July 2026 in The Namba Central Eatery, Namba Oriental Hotel 1F). Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025; an October 2026 diner writes that it has consistently received a Bib Gourmand.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Each one grilled with care, one at a time" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Ajinoya Mix okonomiyaki; Kujo green-onion negiyaki with beef tendon; mix yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: "After checking in at the terminal outside, we were assigned number 19. … the restaurant has a system that sends an SMS notification to your registered phone number as your turn approaches" — October 2026, seated after about an hour.
"What stood out the most was the Kujo Negi-yaki. The abundant flavor and aroma of the Kujo green onions were exceptional" — October 2026.
"While there are many table seats, solo diners are directed to the counter." — October 2026, Ajinoya Mix for JPY 1,780 at about 4 PM on a weekday, with four people ahead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 味乃家 本店、1965年創業、食いだおれ大阪・難波で50年以上続くお好み焼きの老舗、松竹座の向い楽屋口前、大阪市中央区難波1-7-16 現代こいさんビル 2階、店舗責任者 空山 嘉津子、カウンター席10席、テーブル10卓、最大45名、火〜日・祝11:00〜22:00 (22時に完全閉店)、月曜と元日休み、最終月曜と火曜が休みになることも、当日予約不可、電話・メールの予約不可、TableCheck の FastPass (1回1〜4名、指定時間から15分まで有効、混雑時は90分制、全員揃って来店)、AutoReserve 経由の予約は無効、焼き上がりまで約15分、2026年4月15日からメニューの一部見直しと価格改定、味乃家ミックスお好み焼き1,780円 (人気1位)、ミックス焼きそば1,980円 (人気2位)、京都九条ネギ入りネギ焼き すじ肉1,580円 (人気3位、ポン酢とゴマダレ付き)、新鮮トマトと特選チーズのお好み焼き1,780円、餅入りお好み焼き1,680円、スペシャルミックスお好み焼き3,480円、広島焼き1,580円、自家製牛すじ煮込み980円、味乃家特選Bセット5,340円 (2名向き)、税込。姉妹店に味乃家はなれ (完全予約制、旧 寺田町セントラルキッチン店、天王寺区大道2-5-11) と四代目味乃家 (2026年7月31日オープン、なんばオリエンタルホテル1階)。食べログ (店舗会員): 4代にわたる味、キャベツたっぷりで生地は軽め、ふわふわのお好み焼き、PayPay 可、カード不可、禁煙、英語メニューあり、お好み焼き 百名店 2018・2019・2022〜2025。口コミ(2026年10月): 1時間以上の行列、外の端末で受付して順番が近づくと SMS、並びながら注文、各テーブルの鉄板でスタッフが焼く、九条ネギのネギ焼きが好評、ひとり客はカウンター、海外の客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); the official site has English, Chinese and Korean pages; staff cook at the table; many overseas customers (October 2026).

osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the listing asks guests to note allergies in the booking comments. The signature "Paitza" is a pizza on flaky pastry, and pasta, baguette and cakes run through the courses; carpaccio, steak, duck and garlic rice are dishes without obvious wheat, but nothing is stated about their sauces.
osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The courses are built on fish, pork, wagyu, duck and cheese; the à la carte menu is long and changes with the market, so ask what can be made without animal products.
osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 15:00–24:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; note allergies or a dessert plate with a message in the booking comments (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; PIN needed for IC cards from April 2025) and e-money; no QR payments (Tabelog). 24 seats: about 10 at the counter, a table for four and one for six (September 2026 review); private hire for 20 to 50; non-smoking; BYO drinks possible; no minors (Tabelog). No sign on the ground floor: take the lift to the top, 10th floor and walk to the far end of the outdoor corridor (September 2026 reviews).
osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi.notes: [Italian · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, a 10th-floor hideaway] An Italian restaurant with no sign at street level: take the lift of an apartment-like building on the Amerikamura side to the top floor and walk to the end of the open corridor. Inside are a counter of about ten, two tables and soft light, with one chef at the counter, a cook behind and two people serving (September 2026). Order the carpaccio of three fish, which several 2026 diners singled out, and the "Paitza", a pizza on crisp, flaky pastry, then a pasta, such as mackerel and bottarga or duck and porcini cream. Couples, groups of friends and birthday dinners fill it, and the kitchen will write a message on the dessert plate. Tabelog puts the average at ¥5,000–5,999 a head, and the courses run ¥6,600–8,800; open from 15:00 to midnight. Tabelog Italian 100 in 2021; there is a sister shop in Namba.

roles: Chef unnamed in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Our chefs visit the market daily to bring you unique dishes that can only be enjoyed that day." A September 2026 diner saw one main chef at the counter, two staff serving and one person in the kitchen. A regular's June 2025 note says the restaurant had recently been featured on TV. Reviews mention a Namba branch and 食堂ペスカ (September 2026). Tabelog Italian 100 in 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Daily market buying, "committed to maximizing the quality of the finest ingredients" (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: "Paitza" pastry pizza; carpaccio of three fish of the day.

anecdotes.text: "There's one main chef at the counter, two staff serving, and one person in the kitchen." — September 2026, a pre-birthday dinner on the Special Wagyu Tenderloin course (JPY 8,800).
"Since I was dining alone, they prepared all the dishes in single portions, which was a thoughtful touch." — October 2026, an early dinner at 3 PM.
"The pizza featured a flaky crust reminiscent of a pie, with a whole egg in the center, making it incredibly tasty." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ペスカ 心斎橋店 (PESCA Shinsaibashi)、イタリアン、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-28 心斎橋Mビル 10F、四ツ橋駅3番出口から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅7番出口から徒歩5分、毎日15:00〜24:00、不定休、予約可 (アレルギーやデザートプレートの希望は予約のコメント欄へ)、カード可 (ICカードは2025年4月からPIN入力)、電子マネー可、QR不可、24席、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、持ち込み可、未成年不可、毎日市場に行くシェフ、名物はサクサクの「Paitza」、コース: Hirata Bokujo の豚などの90分飲み放題付き7,000円、ヨーロッパ産の鴨6,600円、特選和牛ヘレ8,800円 (記念日のメッセージプレート)、イタリアン 百名店 2021。口コミ(2025年6月〜2026年10月): マンションのような建物の最上階、1階に看板なし、外廊下のいちばん奥、カウンター約10席とテーブル2卓、カウンターにメインのシェフ、ホール2人、厨房1人 (2026年9月)、鮮魚3種のカルパッチョ、パイ生地のピザ、サバとカラスミのペペロンチーノ、鴨とポルチーニのクリームパスタ、黒毛和牛のガーリックライス、ワインは3,900円から、ひとり客には一人前ずつ作ってくれた、テレビで紹介されたという話 (2025年6月)、なんば店と食堂ペスカという姉妹店。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online or by phone; set courses can be chosen in advance, and the à la carte menu is long (2026). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: Tabelog listing: "If you have any allergies or if you would like a dessert plate, please kindly indicate your requests in the comments section when making your reservation."

osaka_okonomiyaki_dan_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: okonomiyaki, modern-yaki, yakisoba and the yakisoba omelet are wheat batter or wheat noodles finished with sauce; the Western-style grilled squid is seasoned with soy sauce (September 2026). No gluten-free option described.
osaka_okonomiyaki_dan_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki filled with pork, beef, squid, shrimp or scallops, a batter with a hint of dashi (September 2026), and grilled chicken and seafood on the side.
osaka_okonomiyaki_dan_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–04:00 (last order 03:30); holidays 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and recommended: an August 2026 diner found every seat booked (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 23 seats, no private rooms; non-smoking; takeaway and delivery (Tabelog). On the third floor of a mixed-use building that is easy to miss; one diner warns of street touts outside (October 2026).
osaka_okonomiyaki_dan_shinsaibashi.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Souemoncho, until 4 a.m.] A third-floor okonomiyaki counter in a mixed-use building on the Souemoncho street, easy to miss among the touts below, and open until four in the morning, which makes it a late-night favourite of local drinkers; it was named a Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2025. The okonomiyaki is fluffy and light, with cabbage that keeps its crunch and a sweetish sauce, and it comes to the teppan in front of you, with room on the counter for a proper plate. Start with grilled squid or plump shrimp with mayonnaise and mustard over a drink, then a pork okonomiyaki (¥950 in October 2026, or ¥1,350 for a double), a beef and egg modern-yaki or the yakisoba omelet one diner rated above everything else. Mains run ¥950–2,100. Book: an August 2026 diner found every seat reserved. Closed Sundays; holidays close at 21:00.

roles: Teppan staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100, 2025. Reviewers call it long-established and a favourite of local drinkers (August and September 2026). No owner or chef is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Okonomiyaki with crunchy cabbage; modern-yaki; yakisoba omelet.

anecdotes.text: "I was amazed by the incredible texture of the cabbage packed inside. The fluffy batter held onto the crispness of the cabbage" — September 2026, after grilled squid and shrimp.
"I was surprised by the reasonable price of JPY 950 for the regular size, but I decided to upgrade to the double size for an additional JPY 400!" — October 2026, pork okonomiyaki.
"There is plenty of space for large serving plates, making it very easy to eat." — October 2026, beef and egg modern-yaki ¥1,350.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): お好み焼だん、お好み焼き、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-12 喜八ビル 3F、なんば駅から徒歩5分、心斎橋駅から徒歩8分、月〜土17:00〜翌4:00 (L.O.3:30)、祝日17:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、日曜定休、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、23席、個室なし、禁煙、テイクアウト・デリバリー、お好み焼き 百名店 2025。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 豚のお好み焼き950円 (倍は400円増し)、イカと豚のお好み焼き1,250円、ミックス1,550円、ホタテ入りミックス2,100円、豚のモダン焼きと牛と卵のモダン焼き各1,350円、ミックス焼きそば1,550円、焼きそばのオムレツ1,070円、醤油味の洋食風のイカ焼き1,070円、イカの塩焼き560円、鶏の塩焼きハーフ700円、ソフトドリンク250円、キャベツの食感、ふわふわの生地、だしの風味、甘めのソース、目の前の鉄板、広いカウンター、予約で満席の日も、朝4時まで、地元の飲み客に人気、客引きに注意。

osaka_hong_kong_kaisen_yumcha_shinsaibas.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Dim sum wrappers, spring rolls, buns, noodles and fried dishes use wheat, and many sauces are soy- or oyster-based. The official site says the kitchen will change course dishes as far as it can for allergies or dislikes.
osaka_hong_kong_kaisen_yumcha_shinsaibas.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Vegetable dishes exist (stir-fried water spinach, bok choy, eggplant, tomato with egg), but the kitchen is built on seafood, pork and chicken, and vegetable plates may use oyster sauce or bacon.
osaka_hong_kong_kaisen_yumcha_shinsaibas.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; holidays dinner only; open year-round (Tabelog). The official site gives dinner to 23:00 (last order 22:30 on weekdays, 22:00 at weekends and holidays) and occasional closures. Lunch menu and prices are the same at weekends (official site; August 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 3% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay and others); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 110 seats, private rooms for 6, 8 and 10–20, whole-floor hire for 50 or more; non-smoking with a smoking area outside; children welcome with high chairs, strollers welcome (Tabelog). Step-free from the entrance, wheelchairs can reach the tables (official site); the lift opens straight into the restaurant (August 2026). One hour free at the partner car park with ¥5,000 spent (official site).
osaka_hong_kong_kaisen_yumcha_shinsaibas.notes: [Chinese · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, dim sum and a live tank] A large Hong Kong-style dining room up a lift above a 7-Eleven, with a tank of live sea bream, abalone and kuruma prawns at the door and round tables for groups; named a Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021. The dim sum is made by a chef holding China's special-grade dim sum master qualification, the wrappers in house, and the tank fish is cooked as you choose, including a Chinese-style sashimi dressed with soy, sesame and cashews. Lunch is the bargain: weekly sets from ¥850 with free rice and soup (a ¥1,000 pork and vegetable set came with gyoza, tofu and almond jelly in August 2026), or dim sum courses from ¥1,950 for two. Evenings lean to banquets: about ¥6,000–7,000 for a course with all-you-can-drink. Diners in 2026 praised the gentle spice and the homemade dim sum wrappers, while one found the staff blunt (September 2026) and another was unimpressed in a near-empty room (October 2026). Add 3% service. The company also runs a branch in Umeda and a hotel in Shima.

roles: Dim sum chef (unnamed) holding China's 特級点心師 qualification (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the dim sum is made by a 特級点心師, a Chinese national qualification for cooks with eight grades taken one at a time in exams held every two years, so that it takes at least fifteen years to reach; the chef has more than twenty years of cooking. Seafood bought from the market goes live into the tank and is cooked to order. The shop is the 心斎橋本店 of 會通株式会社, which also runs a branch in Umeda (Breeze Breeze 6F) and the 一楽温泉ホテル in Shima, Mie (honkonkaisen.com); Tabelog says seafood comes direct from that hotel. Tabelog Chinese WEST 100, 2021. An August 2026 diner notes the staff are Chinese.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Warm human contact" and "handmade" food, not service bound by a manual (company site).
chef_bio.specialty: Dim sum; live-tank sea bream and abalone; Chinese-style sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "Not only was the filling of the dim sum delicious, but the wrappers were also homemade, and the shark fin soup was delightful." — October 2026, a dim sum lunch course.
"Both rice and soup are refillable. … I was truly impressed that such a meal was available at this price." — August 2026, stir-fried pork and vegetable set ¥1,000.
"As someone who isn't fond of spicy food, I asked, 'Is this dish spicy?' and was met with a blunt response" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 香港海鮮飲茶樓 心斎橋本店、本格海鮮料理と香港飲茶、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-12-17 ロンスカール高吉ビル2F、心斎橋駅から徒歩6分、長堀橋駅から徒歩4分、セブンイレブンの二階、ランチ11:00〜15:00、ディナー17:00〜23:00 (平日L.O.22:30、土日祝L.O.22:00)、不定休、入口から段差なしで車いす可、5,000円以上で提携駐車場1時間分。特級点心師 (中国の国家資格、八段階、最低十五年) が作る点心、料理経験二十年以上、市場直送の活魚を店内のいけすへ、中華風特選ソースとゴマ・カシューナッツの中華風刺身、伝統の美容茶「九龍茶」と茶芸のパフォーマンス、アレルギーや苦手な食材には出来る限り料理の変更に対応。ランチ: 週替わり850円〜1,300円、ご飯とスープおかわり自由、本格飲茶コース1,950円、自家製飲茶コース2,480円、ヘルシーコース3,590円、小籠包セット1,480円、五種点心セット1,750円。お品書き: 活魚5,500円〜、活あわび1,540円〜、海老のマヨネーズ1,520円、XO醤入り蟹と春雨の土鍋1,850円、北京ダック (1本) 660円、酢豚1,680円、フカヒレの姿煮8,800円、あわびの姿煮5,500円。運営は會通株式会社 (梅田店、一楽温泉ホテルも)。食べログ (店舗会員): 毎日11:00〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、祝日は夜のみ、年中無休、サービス料3%、110席、個室、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、子ども・ベビーカー可、飲み放題つきコース5,980円から、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 1,000円の定食、週末も同じランチ、自家製の皮の点心、フカヒレスープ、マイルドな辛さの麻婆豆腐、海鮮豆腐、小籠包、11品と90分飲み放題で6,980円、エレベーターで店内へ、中国人のスタッフ、そっけない対応という声、昔の百名店の面影はないという声。

osaka_vrai_de_vrai_chez_hiro_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The courses include a baguette with refills, gougères, a pilaf with meat sauce, a mille-feuille and sauces such as américaine; no gluten-free handling described.
osaka_vrai_de_vrai_chez_hiro_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses built on seafood, lobster, venison, lamb, duck, goose and pork, with butter and cream.
osaka_vrai_de_vrai_chez_hiro_shinmachi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:30); closed Monday, or Tuesday when Monday is a holiday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses are also bookable on Ikyu (April 2026 review). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 36 seats with counter and sofa seating, two private rooms for 4; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). Moved to Shinmachi in 2003 (Tabelog).
osaka_vrai_de_vrai_chez_hiro_shinmachi.notes: [French · Shinmachi, generous courses on a quiet corner] A calm French restaurant on a back-street corner in Shinmachi, a few minutes from Yotsubashi, at this address since 2003 and named a Tabelog French WEST 100 in 2021. Courses come with a choice of mains and portions that diners keep calling generous: three appetisers before the fish, a lobster terrine that more than one diner singles out, then a pick of four meats such as Ezo venison, lamb or duckling, and a small serving of venison meat sauce with pilaf to finish. Lunch at ¥3,800 lets you choose starter, main and dessert; dinner courses run ¥7,700–16,500. Staff pace the courses well, and took a commemorative photo for one birthday table (November 2025); ask for the half-circle sofa at the back. Some diners found the seasoning salty (2025) or the top course short of its price (March 2026). Closed Mondays.

roles: Chef (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog notes the restaurant moved to Shinmachi in 2003; Tabelog French WEST 100, 2021. No chef is named in the listing or the reviews read, and no official site was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Lobster terrine; choice of four meats; meat sauce with pilaf.

anecdotes.text: "With 8 dishes plus the baguette and drinks, the first courses include the amuse-bouche and three appetizers, each with generous portions. These are definitely not just appetizers!" — April 2026, the ¥16,500 course.
"It was a dish where you mixed apple puree with the lobster terrine and enjoyed it together, and it was delightful." — November 2025, a birthday dinner on the half-circle sofa.
"For JPY 3800, you can select from appetizers, main courses, and desserts. The first thing I noticed was the wide variety of choices" — March 2026, lunch.

osaka_horse_baniku_higashishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a horse-meat specialist; the hot pot broth is made from horse tendon.
osaka_horse_baniku_higashishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–21:30; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). The official site gives last order 22:00 and posts holiday closures (Obon, New Year). Reservations accepted; cancel by the day before (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX); no e-money (Tabelog). 41 seats: 7 at the counter, tables, a second floor for 9–20 with sunken seating; non-smoking; children welcome; English menu (Tabelog). osaka_horse_baniku_higashishinsaibashi.notes: [Horse meat · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, since 1982] A horse-meat specialist in Higashi-Shinsaibashi, cooking nothing else since 1982. Diners describe the meat as Kumamoto horse, sweet, clean and light, and the menu runs from sashimi through grilling to a hot pot: sashimi of three cuts including 高根, the collagen-rich meat from under the mane; smoked saiboshi with a drink; grilled horse yakiniku or a tender steak; and the harihari nabe of horse meat and mizuna in a broth drawn from horse tendon, finished with Chinese noodles or rice. Most people take a course (¥7,500 for the hot pot, ¥10,500 for steak and hot pot), and staff explain the hot pot to first-timers. A December 2025 diner found the owner kind, and many customers seemed to be regulars; one in March 2026 felt the price outran the experience on a quiet weekend night. English menu. Closed Sundays and holidays.

roles: Owner (unnamed) and staff

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 馬肉料理専門店ホース、おいしい馬肉で美容と健康、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-3-12、地下鉄心斎橋駅6番出口から徒歩10分、ラストオーダー22:00、日曜・祝日定休、カウンター6席・テーブル3・2階10〜20名、禁煙。メニュー: 付出し2品1,000円、高根 (タテガミの下でコラーゲンたっぷり) 800円、馬刺し3,800円、生レバー3,800円、桜なっとう (熊本から取り寄せる冬限定のわらに包まれたなっとうに馬肉) 950円、桜ユッケ900円、サイボシ (馬の燻製) 1,600円、コリコリ3,200円、あみ焼き3,800円、焼肉セット1人前6,300円 (2人前から)、馬ステーキ6,500円、馬のはりはり鍋 (馬スジからダシを取った秘伝のスープ、しめの中華そば) 5,000円、コースは2人前から: 鍋コース7,500円、ステーキコース8,600円、Ｗコース10,500円、生ビール680円。食べログ (店舗会員): 月〜土17:00〜21:30、日・祝休み、予約可 (キャンセルは前日まで)、カード可、41席、2階は9名以上で貸切可、掘りごたつ、禁煙、英語メニュー、子ども可、1982年から馬肉ひとすじ。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): Kumamoto の馬肉、親切な店主、常連が多い、鍋の食べ方を教えてくれる、三種のお造り、サイボシ、ステーキ、はりはり鍋、炊き込みご飯、しめの麺、桜ユッケ、45年の歴史、値段ほどの満足感はなかったという声。

osaka_yakiniku_kitan_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Most cuts can be ordered with salt instead of the house sauce, and the aged lean beef comes with salt and grated-daikon ponzu or the dipping sauce; the horumon is dressed in a miso sauce, the sukiyaki-style strip loin is grilled in a homemade warishita, the soups are finished with a house dashi soy sauce, and the cold noodles are described only as using buckwheat flour (Tabelog menu, September 2026). Nothing is said about wheat.
osaka_yakiniku_kitan_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an aged-wagyu yakiniku restaurant; the soups are made from beef bones, and the kimchi is described as having a shrimp aroma (Tabelog menu). Salads, namul, grilled vegetables and wrapping leaves are side dishes.
osaka_yakiniku_kitan_minamisenba.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–23:00 (last order food 22:20, drinks 22:30); irregular closures and closed 1 January; lunch and bento takeout ended (Tabelog). 2-hour seating; courses must be booked by the day before (Tabelog). Every seat is in a private room, for 2 to 20; tatami and sunken seating; non-smoking, with a smoking area outside; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. A 5% service charge from 28 December to 5 January (Tabelog). Children welcome: a kids menu (curry, udon, chicken nuggets ¥500 each, a kids rice set), free toys, children's chairs, Bumbo seats and blankets (Tabelog). English menu and a menu with photos (Tabelog). Opened 3 June 2019 (Tabelog).
osaka_yakiniku_kitan_minamisenba.notes: [Yakiniku · Minami-Semba, aged wagyu in private rooms] The original shop of the small Kitan yakiniku group (a September 2026 diner), in a basement off Route 1 near Shinsaibashi, where every table is in its own room, for two up to twenty. The kitchen ages black wagyu cut by cut, including dry aging, and the aged tongue is the thing to order: a thick-cut salted tongue (¥2,300), or the thick-cut tongue the grill master cooks for you (¥3,100), served with sudachi instead of lemon. Aged lean cuts come as a sampler of three with salt and grated-daikon ponzu; the house signature is a strip loin grilled sukiyaki-style and dipped in egg. Courses run ¥7,700–13,000, à la carte works too, and diners in 2026 praised the tongue, the outside skirt, the omasum sashimi and the wagyu sushi. It suits families: a kids menu, free toys, baby seats. One diner found the much-advertised French toast a letdown after the meat; another had hoped for more kinds of tongue. Tabelog Yakiniku WEST 100 2021 and Grill WEST 100 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 焼肉 㐂舌（きたん）KITAN 大阪 南船場・法善寺・韻、予約ページ (TableCheck の kitan-in) と食べログへのリンク。食べログ (店舗会員): Yakiniku Kitan Minami senba、南船場4-11-22 B1F (YOC Building)、心斎橋駅から徒歩5分、毎日17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:20・ドリンク22:30)、不定休、1月1日休み、ランチと弁当のテイクアウトは終了、2時間制、コースは前日までに予約、全席個室 (2〜20名)、座敷、掘りごたつ、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、Wi-Fi、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、年末年始28日〜5日はサービス料5%、子ども歓迎 (キッズメニュー、おもちゃ、子ども椅子、バンボ、ブランケット)、英語メニュー、写真付きメニュー、オープン2019年6月3日、焼肉 WEST 百名店 2021、焼肉・ステーキ WEST 百名店 2024、系列店に焼肉㐂舌 法善寺と 㐂舌 響 (ステーキ)。店の説明: 㐂舌は「舌が喜ぶ」、黒毛和牛を部位ごとに熟成、ドライエイジング。コース (税込): Casual 7,700円、Namba Senba 9,350円、Kitan 11,000円、Premium 13,000円、飲み放題付き10,000円・13,000円。メニュー (2026年9月8日更新): 熟成タンはレモンではなくsudachiで、厚切りタン3,100円、上厚切り塩タン2,300円、熟成赤身は塩とgrated daikon と ponzuかタレ、シャトーブリアン6,200円、ドライエイジングの U.S. Prime のハラミ2,300円、特選ストリップロインの Yaki-suki4,000円 (大分の卵)、horumonはmiso だれ、wagyu sushi盛り合わせ2,750円、冷麺はそば粉入り、テールスープ、フレンチトースト750円、熟成タン1本の持ち帰り9,000円。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 厚切りタン、ハラミ、センマイの sashimi、wagyu sushi、Awaji Island の玉ねぎのサラダ、Jeju の japchae、Yaki-suki、全室個室で家族連れや若いカップル、Kitan 創業の店、改装後、フレンチトーストは期待外れだったという声、タンの種類がもっとほしかったという声。

osaka_trattoria_pappa_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Pasta is central, bread comes with the cover charge, and there are gratins and desserts; the carpaccio, grilled and steamed fish and other seafood mains may suit, but nothing is stated. The shop asks diners to state likes and dislikes.
osaka_trattoria_pappa_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-only Italian kitchen (official site; Tabelog). Seasonal vegetables such as the early-summer Wakayama tomatoes appear within seafood dishes.
osaka_trattoria_pappa_shinmachi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Sunday and on irregular days listed on the official schedule (official site; Tabelog). The set lunch menus ended on 29 November 2025; lunch and dinner now offer à la carte and courses, with courses booked by the day before (official site). Reservations online (TableCheck) or by phone; one course per table; a booking may be treated as cancelled 20 minutes after the time if the shop cannot reach you (Tabelog). At dinner only diners of middle-school age and older (Tabelog). Coperto (bread and table charge) ¥500 per person plus tax at dinner, ¥550 with tax on Tabelog. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats: 13 at the counter, 18 at tables; non-smoking; whole-restaurant hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Opened 22 February 2002 (Tabelog).
osaka_trattoria_pappa_shinmachi.notes: [Italian · Shinmachi, a seafood-only trattoria at a thousand-year-old counter] An owner-chef's Italian in Shinmachi since 2002 that cooks only seafood: the chef goes to Osaka's central wholesale market every morning and makes trips to fishing ports around Japan a life's work, and fish also arrive from people met on those trips (official site). The open kitchen faces a counter cut from a single slab of African bubinga about a thousand years old, and the walls carry work by the artist TALA. Order the daily omakase course (¥6,000–25,000 before tax at dinner, ¥4,000 at lunch), or tell the staff what you want: a drinking course, a pasta course, a whole fish. The summer chilled capellini with sea urchin and tomato is a seasonal favourite (July 2025 and July 2026), and diners in 2026 praised mackerel-and-tomato pasta, a shrimp gratin and crisp-skinned fish. One regular on a twentieth visit (October 2026) pre-orders lobster with caviar. The set lunches ended in November 2025, and at dinner only diners of middle-school age and up are seated. Tabelog Italian WEST 100 2021 and 2023.

roles: Owner-chef (オーナーシェフ) and representative (official site); "Matsumoto" in English reviews
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: after cooking school, trained in Italian cooking under chef 鮎田淳治 at ラ・コメータ in Tokyo, then sharpened technique at Fontana in Hotel New Otani Osaka (ホテルニューオータニ大阪) and helped launch Italian restaurants, learning how to build a shop; opened Trattoria Pappa independently in 2002, and in 2005 バール・パッパ and パッパバー, both closed on 31 May 2020 when their building was to be rebuilt. The chef loves seafood, hence the seafood-only menu, buys fish at the Osaka central wholesale market every morning, and travels to fishing ports around Japan as a life's work. A painting by 少路和伸, made for the chef's 50th birthday, hangs in the shop. An October 2026 diner first saw the restaurant about 15 years earlier on the MBS programme "Kitchen Puipui" and met the owner-chef on the visit; a June 2026 diner found the chef friendly and fun to talk to.
chef_bio.philosophy: "I love seafood! So the Italian at Pappa is seafood only. I want people to eat Italian casually at Pappa, drink wine and recharge" (official site, owner-chef 松本).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily omakase of market seafood; seasonal chilled capellini; pasta.

anecdotes.text: "If you're visiting in summer, you absolutely must try this chilled uni pasta… The thin capellini is topped with juicy fresh tomatoes and plenty of uni." — July 2026.
"When I asked the staff, I learned that it was a single slab of Bubinga wood over 1,000 years old." — August 2026, mackerel and tomato pasta at lunch.
"It was a fresh and juicy tomato sauce that, while not overly rich, was packed with flavor and truly delicious." — October 2026, mackerel in tomato sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 大阪市西区のイタリア料理店 トラットリアパッパ、魚介系パワフルイタリアン、ガラス貼りのオープンキッチン、オーナーシェフ松本「魚介類が大好きなんです！だからパッパで出すイタリアンも魚介系オンリー (ランチは除く)」、毎朝大阪中央卸売市場に通い新鮮な魚介類を仕入れ、全国各地の漁港を尋ねる旅をライフワーク、初夏の和歌山の山中さんのトマト、樹齢約1000年のアフリカ産ブビンガのカウンター、アーティストTALAさんの作品、画家・少路和伸さんが50歳の誕生日の記念に描いた絵画。おまかせコース (税別): 4,000円 (ランチタイムのみ)、6,000円・10,000円・15,000円・25,000円 (25,000円は前々日までの予約)、1テーブル1コース、Coperto (パン代・テーブル使用料等) お一人様500円 (ディナーのみ)、酒飲みコース、パスタコース、魚を1匹丸ごと、デザートの代わりにイタリアのチーズ、季節のトマト、ブロッコリー、ホワイトアスパラ、トリュフ、秋刀魚、タラの白子、とらふぐ、鮎。ランチメニュー終了のお知らせ: 2002年開店当初からのランチセットメニューを2025年11月29日で終了、ランチもディナーもアラカルトとコース、コースは前日までの予約、Pappa店主 松本喜宏。Pappa代表 松本 喜宏: 1964年北海道生まれ、調理師学校を卒業後、東京「ラ･コメータ」鮎田淳治シェフのもとで修業、ホテルニューオータニ大阪「Fontana」、イタリア料理店の立ち上げ、2002年独立して「トラットリア・パッパ」を開店、05年に「バール・パッパ」「パッパ・バー」(2020年5月31日閉店)。営業時間 11:30〜14:00／17:30〜 最終入店20:00、日曜日・不定休。食べログ (店舗会員): 新町2-3-9、西大橋駅1番出口から徒歩4分、魚介イタリアン専門で肉料理はなし、ディナーは中学生以上、予約時間から20分連絡がつかなければキャンセル扱いの場合あり、コペルト550円 (税込、ランチなし)、カード・PayPay可、31席 (テーブル18、カウンター13)、禁煙、貸切20〜50名、オープン2002年2月22日、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2023。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 夏の冷製カッペリーニ (ウニとトマト)、サバとトマトのパスタ、キャベツとアンチョビのオイルソース、アサリとブロッコリーのクリームパスタ、海老のグラタン、白いトマトのジュレと玉ねぎのムース、皮がパリッとした魚、ゴルゴンゾーラのアイス、常連は食材を伝えて調理法はシェフにおまかせ (Ise lobster、鮑、鰻、ウニ、夏トリュフ、キャビアをのせたオマール)、MBS「Kitchen Puipui」で見た、ランチのコース4,400円、テーブルに塩とこしょう。

cultural_comfort.note: Daily dishes written up by the staff; say what you like and the chef decides how to cook it (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_jon_higashishinsaibashi.notes: [Korean · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Korean cooking to 4 am] A bright, roomy Korean restaurant that moved from Soemoncho to Higashi-Shinsaibashi and stays open until 4 am six nights a week, a Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST 100 pick in 2026. Free banchan arrive first, then the choice is wide: thick samgyeopsal grilled whole and wrapped in perilla with kimchi, a bossam whose napa cabbage one October 2026 diner singled out alongside the pork, dak hanmari in a ginseng-and-herb broth (one diner found the herbs strong), oxtail soup, ganjang gejang, chijimi and bubbling chige. Portions are big; one diner suggests coming as four to try a hot pot and samgyeopsal both. One diner found the samgyeopsal ordinary and dear; another made it the late-night finish after drinking. Smoking is allowed.

roles: Kitchen and owners unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text, the restaurant moved in May 2016 to its present, bright and spacious premises (Tabelog opening day 24 May 2017); an October 2026 review says it was formerly in Soemoncho. Diners in 2026 describe it as authentic Korean cooking; a reviewer who had spent a long time in Korea agreed.
chef_bio.specialty: Samgyeopsal; dak hanmari; bossam; chige.

anecdotes.text: "What arrived on the teppan was a generous portion of thick-cut pork belly… it's cut into manageable pieces and wrapped in Korean perilla leaves with kimchi and onions that have soaked up the pork fat." — October 2026, late-night samgyeopsal.
"The Ttukbaegi Samgyetang was enough for 3 to 4 people, and I ended up feeling quite full." — September 2026, ¥6,000.
"I recommend coming with about four people so you can order both the hot pot and Samgyeopsal for a perfect experience." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Jon (ジョン)、韓国料理・焼肉・居酒屋、東心斎橋2-3-29 リップルプロローグ88 1F、日本橋駅から徒歩5分、長堀橋駅から徒歩7分、月〜土17:00〜翌4:00、日・祝17:00〜24:00、不定休、予約可、喫煙可、カード・QR (楽天ペイ、Alipay、WeChat Pay) 可、電子マネー不可、テーブル48席、個室 (6・8・10〜20名)、30〜48名の団体、テイクアウト、ベジタリアンメニューありの表示、オープン2017年5月24日、店の説明では2016年5月に移転、アジア・エスニック WEST 百名店 2026。メニュー (2024年5月21日更新、税別の場合あり): Dak Hanmari 4,500円 (高麗人参、にんにく、銀杏、栗、漢方のスープ、最後はお粥)、Samgyeopsal セット2,000円 (2人前から)、Samgyetang 2,500円、鍋3,000円前後、Chijimi 1,000〜1,500円、Bossam 2,500円、Chige 1,000円、テールスープ1,200円、石焼 bibimbap1,200円、冷麺1,000円、ラーメン800円。飲み放題付き C コース6,600円。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): Ttukbaegi Samgyetang 6,000円で3〜4人分、ポテトの chijimi1,850円、無料のおかず (じゃがいも、海苔、大根キムチ、青菜、こんにゃく、さつま揚げ、黒豆)、鉄板で焼く厚切り Samgyeopsal をエゴマの葉とキムチで、Sannakji、Yukgaejang、Bossam、Ganjang Gejang (ない日も)、4人で来るのがおすすめ、Samgyeopsal はふつうで高いという声、旧店舗は宗右衛門町、喫煙可。

osaka_teppan_toyoshimake_dotonbori.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Every steak course includes a mini wagyu burger in a bun and ends with fried rice; the monthly course has a teppan tonpeiyaki. The steak, grilled vegetables and champagne-steamed lobster may be simpler, but sauces are not described. The booking page asks diners to write allergies in the comments.
osaka_teppan_toyoshimake_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu steak and seafood teppanyaki restaurant; the roasted vegetables come within meat courses.
osaka_teppan_toyoshimake_dotonbori.hours_raw: Dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00), irregular closures listed on the official site (official site; Tabelog). Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) on irregular days only; the official site calls lunch fully reserved, while its lunch page says the steak sets need no booking; dinner courses at lunch need booking 3 days ahead (official site). Reservations strongly preferred: dishes are prepared to the bookings, walk-ins may be turned away, and a seat-only booking gets the Steak Course (Tabelog). Same-day cancellations may be charged 100% (official site). One drink per person required; water other than chasers is charged; card payment needs a ¥20,000 minimum except for solo diners (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog; official site). 24 seats on Tabelog, 26 on the official site: a counter, tables and semi-private rooms for up to 12; non-smoking (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Children welcome; kids plate ¥6,000 (official site).
osaka_teppan_toyoshimake_dotonbori.notes: [Teppanyaki · Dotonbori, wagyu steak over the canal] A teppanyaki room on the second floor of a building by the Dotonbori canal, near Harishige, where you eat A5 Miyazaki beef or Kobe beef with a view of the water. The official English site says the Toyoshima brothers have run it since 2005 (Tabelog's opening day is September 2009). Courses follow one pattern: a soup, small plates, the house's famous mini wagyu burger (a repeat diner's favourite), lobster steamed in champagne or grilled sirloin shabu-shabu, then the steak, flambéed in front of you, and fried rice; the 120 g Chateaubriand course from ¥15,900 is the one most people book. A September 2026 diner was shown the Miyakonojo wagyu's certificate; a July 2025 diner seated at a table was invited to the counter for the flambé. There is no wine list: the sommelier pours to your taste. Book ahead; drinks push the bill up (one December 2025 diner paid just under ¥20,000 in all). Tabelog Steak/Teppanyaki WEST 100 2024.

roles: Run by the Toyoshima brothers (official English site); cooks with more than 20 years of experience and a sommelier (official site); individual names not given
chef_bio.background: The official English site says the Toyoshima brothers have shared teppanyaki with locals and overseas diners since 2005; Tabelog gives the opening day as 9 September 2009, and its shop text speaks of 20 years. The beef is A4–A5 Miyazaki beef bought through the shop's own route and Kobe beef (official site); a September 2026 diner was served Miyakonojo wagyu from Miyazaki and shown its certificate. Diners describe a friendly chef who flambés at the table and staff who show the meat before cooking (2024–2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Each cut judged by an experienced cook and grilled to the right doneness on a 2 cm plate; no wine list, the sommelier chooses for the day's food and your taste (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Miyazaki A5 Chateaubriand; mini wagyu burger; champagne-steamed lobster.

anecdotes.text: "The counter seating is nice for watching the cooking, but the view of Dotonbori from the window was truly fantastic." — September 2026, Chateaubriand and lobster course.
"I've visited this place about 5 or 6 times… While the main meat dishes are delicious, my favorite has to be the hamburger." — May 2026.

"Although we were seated at a table, we were invited to the counter during the flambé, allowing us to witness a spectacular fire show right in front of us." — July 2025, ¥20,000 Chateaubriand tasting course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 道頓堀てっぱんステーキ豊島家、道頓堀1-10-7 ぼんちビル2F、近鉄・阪神「大阪難波駅」から徒歩5分、大阪メトロ「なんば駅」から徒歩4分、昼の部12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:30、完全予約制)、夜の部17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、不定休、26席、貸切可、カード・PayPay可、当日キャンセルは100%の場合あり。A4〜A5ランクの宮崎牛と神戸牛、20年以上の経験を積んだ料理人、厚さ2cmの鉄板、ワインリストはなくソムリエが提案、ペアリング FOUR 4,500円・SIX 6,000円。ステーキコース (税込): シャトーブリアン120g 15,900円〜、フィレ120g 13,900円〜、二大和牛ブランド シャトーブリアン食べ比べ100g×2種 20,000円〜 (スープ、シェフの気まぐれ小皿、豊島家名物 ミニ和牛ハンバーガー、自家製鶏つくね 卵黄のせ、オマールテールシャンパン蒸し アメリケーヌソース か サーロイン焼きしゃぶポン酢、彩野菜のロースト、選べるステーキ、八代目儀兵衛のオリジナルブレンド米の〆のフライドライス、本日のデザート)、神戸牛コース38,000円、Monthly Special お任せコース17,500円〜 (前日までの予約、創業以来の味 鉄板 豚平焼き、旬魚の包み蒸し焼き、神戸牛クラシタのすき焼き60g、宮崎県産 A5 シャトーブリアン70g)。ランチ (不定期、予約不要): 宮崎牛サーロインステーキセット5,000円、宮崎牛フィレステーキコース7,000円、フライドライスに変更+800円、ディナーコースは3日前までの予約で昼も可、キッズプレート6,000円、テイクアウト (3日前までの予約): フィリーチーズステーキ1,900円 (大阪・関西万博で人気)、ミニハンバーガーとミニエビタルタルバーガーセット1,500円。英語版: Since 2005, the Toyoshima brothers、Seafood grill course 13,800円。食べログ (店舗会員): Dotonbori Teppan Toyoshimake、神戸ビーフ指定登録店、ソムリエのシェフ、平日限定ミニフィレステーキコース8,500円、予約優先、席のみの予約は当日ステーキコースのみ、ワンドリンク制、チェイサー以外の水は有料、カードは20,000円以上 (お一人様は除く)、24席、個室は12名まで、禁煙、英語メニュー、英語を話すスタッフ、子ども可、オープン2009年9月9日、ステーキ・鉄板焼き WEST 百名店 2024。口コミ(2024年8月〜2026年9月): ミニハンバーガー、シャンパン蒸しのオマール、シャトーブリアン、何度もフランベ、テーブル席からカウンターに呼ばれてフランベ、Miyakonojo の wagyuの証明書、窓から道頓堀の眺め、卵につけるつくね、和牛の焼きしゃぶ、フライドライス、Harishige の前、海外の客が多い、飲み物込みで20,000円弱。

osaka_cafe_stand_el_sol_umeda.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu leans on bread, pizza and pasta (baguette, margherita, tomato-sauce pastas), fried dishes (corn croquettes, anchovy potato fries) and paella; ask which tapas and grills are made without flour.

osaka_cafe_stand_el_sol_umeda.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 16:30–22:30, last order 22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). A September 2026 review lists 18:30–22:30 as of 20 September 2026, while an August 2026 diner had happy hour from 17:00, so check before going. Happy hour on weekdays until 18:15 and weekends and holidays until 17:30: draft beer, highballs and sours ¥198 (August 2026). Drinks half price for women's groups on Tuesdays (Tabelog; February 2026) and, per one diner, all drinks half price on a Sunday (November 2025). Reservations recommended; tables for two may be moved to the counter when busy (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay; small discounts for cash on courses (Tabelog). 18 seats (25 standing), counter and sofa seats, a back room for 7–11 or private hire up to 20; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; smart casual, no flip-flops, beachwear or gym wear; children only with the back room booked (Tabelog). Opened 15 April 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_cafe_stand_el_sol_umeda.notes: [Spanish-Italian bar · Umeda, Osaka Station Front Building No. 2 B1F] A small tapas bar tucked into the back of the basement of Osaka Station Front Building No. 2 (one group found it on the building map), the second shop of the Spanish bar El Sol in Kitashinchi. The aim is the chef's own Spanish and Italian cooking at low prices: a tapas platter at ¥693, jamón carved from the leg, ajillo with just the right salt, pizza, pastas and squid-ink paella, in portions small enough for a solo diner to try several. Happy hour pours beer and highballs at ¥198 until 18:15 on weekdays (August 2026), and women's groups drink at half price on Tuesdays. One regular always starts with sparkling wine, poured until it overflows the glass. Counter seats suit one or two; a back room takes groups of seven or more for 3-hour all-you-can-drink courses (¥5,800 in September 2026), and staff set out candles for a birthday cake guests brought. Fills soon after opening; book even at short notice.

osaka_cc_carbon_copy_canopy_umeda.gf_detail: Ask ahead. No gluten information, but the hotel says it handles food allergies when asked in advance (official page). Courses and set lunches lean on bread, pizza and pasta; the breakfast buffet includes a miso soup with fu, wheat gluten (June 2026).
osaka_cc_carbon_copy_canopy_umeda.vegan_detail: Ask ahead. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the hotel takes dietary requests in advance (official page), but no vegan dish is described; the breakfast buffet has salads and fruit alongside eggs, fish and meat (June 2026).
osaka_cc_carbon_copy_canopy_umeda.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 6:30–10:30; lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:00); dinner 17:30–21:30 (last order 20:00), no dinner on Tuesday and Wednesday, except dinner on Wednesday 23 December 2026 (official page; Tabelog, from 1 August 2026). Hours and prices may change in festive periods (Golden Week, Obon, Christmas, New Year) and on promotion days (official page). Breakfast ¥4,500 (13 and over), ¥2,250 (6–12); set lunch from ¥5,800; set dinner from ¥7,800; à la carte from ¥700; tax and service charge (15% per Tabelog) added to listed prices (official page). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (AMEX, UnionPay, Diners, Master, Visa, JCB); no e-money or QR (official page; Tabelog); a diner was asked to pay cash because of a terminal fault (August 2026). 81 seats: 67 in the room and a private room for up to 14 (an extra ¥18,000 for parties of six or fewer); non-smoking; step-free for wheelchairs and strollers; children's tableware and chairs; parking free for 2 hours with ¥10,000 spent (official page). English menu and English-speaking staff; smart casual (Tabelog). Opened 6 September 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_cc_carbon_copy_canopy_umeda.notes: [International · Umeda, Grand Green Osaka hotel restaurant] The all-day restaurant on the 11th floor of the Canopy by Hilton in Grand Green Osaka's north building, with windows over Umekita park and the Osaka Station area; one diner watched the view turn from evening to night (September 2026). The kitchen cooks dishes from around the world with Osaka produce and plates them small, Japanese-style, with a live cooking station; the room nods to Osaka food culture, with a ceiling of Sumiyoshi bamboo craft and lights shaped like kushikatsu (August 2026). Breakfast is a ¥4,500 buffet with omelettes made to order, Japanese sides, yakisoba and fresh juices, praised in June 2026 and found ordinary by an October 2026 hotel guest. Lunch sets start at ¥4,500 including tax and service; dinner is à la carte or sets from ¥7,800. Diners note loud music at a business lunch, slow notice at dinner (October 2026), and a calm room even at weekends. The hotel takes allergy requests in advance.

roles: Hotel kitchen team (chef unnamed in the sources read)

Opened 6 September 2024 (Tabelog).

osaka_ooyodo_avenue.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Dishes include zeppole, gratin, fritters, cream pasta and bread served for the sauces (2026 reviews).
osaka_ooyodo_avenue.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Most dishes hold fish, meat, egg or dairy (carpaccio, omelettes, roast beef, salmon, gratin); roasted peas appear on an appetizer platter (August 2026).
osaka_ooyodo_avenue.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before or after a holiday 18:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–23:00; last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30 (Tabelog). Open all year but sometimes closed on irregular days; the shop posts them on Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; busiest around 19:00, easier after 21:00 (August 2026). No cards, no e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 19 seats: 11 at the counter, one table for 4, two for 2; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, ashtray outside; children welcome (Tabelog). osaka_ooyodo_avenue.notes: [Bistro · behind Umekita, a quiet street ten minutes from Osaka Station] A 19-seat creative bistro on a quiet street past Grand Green Osaka, themed on "adult play": charcoal-grilled dishes and bistro classics with a twist, wine and gin, and a soundtrack worth listening to. Diners come for the colourful appetizer platter (¥1,419 a person in August 2026: shime-saba potato salad, kanpachi carpaccio, a shirasu omelette, yodare chicken, salmon confit) and the soft omelettes, with tomato, shirasu or, when it has not sold out, eel. Most praise the presentation and the sauces; others found portions small for the price, waited half an hour for the platter, or found the room hot and the high stools hard (September 2026). Courses run ¥4,280–5,680. Book for 7 pm; it is easier after 9. No cards; PayPay accepted.

roles: Chef and staff (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a creative bistro near Osaka Station and Umeda themed on "adult play", with unique twists on classic bistro dishes, fine wine or gin, and quality music; charcoal-grilled dishes and carefully chosen domestic drinks. Opened 22 November 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Adult play" in bistro cooking (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Assorted appetizers; omelettes; charcoal-grilled dishes.

anecdotes.text: "We ordered an appetizer platter for one, but since there were two of us" the portion was adjusted for two — August 2026, back home in Kansai for Obon.
"For dessert, I had the hojicha Basque cheesecake. It was drizzled with black syrup, giving it a Japanese twist." — August 2026, a solo visit after work.
"The omelet, generously topped with shirasu (whitebait) and fresh tomatoes, was exquisite with its perfectly creamy texture and refreshing acidity." — July 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Order à la carte or a set course; book ahead for 7 pm (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_niku_kappo_tomoyuri_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Every course includes a beef cutlet sandwich (bread and breaded cutlet), and reviews describe spring rolls, beef-tongue curry and dan dan noodles on a May 2025 menu.
osaka_niku_kappo_tomoyuri_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses built on wagyu, with seafood, soups and broths.
osaka_niku_kappo_tomoyuri_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00, last order food 21:00, drinks 22:00; closed Sundays, holidays, Obon, Golden Week and New Year (Tabelog; official site). Courses start at 18:00 or 20:30 (official site). Reservation only (Tabelog); online booking on the official site. Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seats: 14 counter and 6 semi-private per Tabelog; 12 counter and one table that seats up to 6 semi-privately per the official site; private hire up to 20. Heated tobacco only, in the private room. School-age children welcome; a children's plate for lower-elementary pupils ¥5,500 (Tabelog). Opened 22 April 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_niku_kappo_tomoyuri_kitashinchi.notes: [Meat kappo · Kitashinchi, a wagyu counter] A counter in Kitashinchi where the owner-chef, 三井秀和 (official site), cooks wagyu from producers across Japan in front of you, course by course: soup, seasonal small dishes, raw and seared beef, a thick beef cutlet sandwich that diners photograph again and again, charcoal-grilled tenderloin, then kamameshi with a choice of toppings such as beef-tongue curry, gyudon and mentaiko. Two 2026 reviews say the owner was formerly head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan; one called the owner a comedian who keeps the counter laughing (July 2026), and at an April 2026 birthday all the guests joined in the song. Courses run ¥17,600–33,000 with 10% service; pairings ¥10,000. Portions are large: come hungry. Private room for business dinners; a loud group at the counter spoiled one November 2025 evening. A sister yakiniku shop, 北新地 焼肉友ゆり, opened in October 2026.

roles: Owner-chef (オーナーシェフ) (official site)
Formerly head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan (August and October 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Official site (read 2026-11-01): "オーナーシェフ 三井秀和"; the owner-chef pairs carefully chosen meat with seasonal ingredients, using skills built up over the years and ingredients from trusted producers, and finishes each dish while talking with guests at the counter. Reviews: "The cheerful master, who has been the head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan for a long time" (August 2026); "The owner here was formerly the head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan" (October 2026). A July 2026 diner writes that the shop specialises in Iga beef and Tsushima beef. Opened 22 April 2023 (Tabelog); a sister shop, 北新地 焼肉友ゆり, opened in Kitashinchi on 13 October 2026 (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Hospitality through meat dishes made with care, finished while talking with each guest (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Meat kappo course; beef cutlet sandwich; kamameshi finale.

anecdotes.text: "I had heard from my friend beforehand that while the food is delicious, the owner can be a bit loud (laughs), so I was prepared for that. However, I found out that the loudness was more of a comedic style rather than intimidating!" — July 2026.
"The head chef was very friendly, and even though it was my first time at the restaurant, all the guests joined in to sing a birthday song for me" — April 2026, a birthday dinner.
"The beef katsu sandwich was a huge hit, with many guests taking multiple photos of it!" — September 2025, a fourth visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 肉割烹 友百合 (ともゆり)、ライブ感のある割烹、全国から取り寄せた和牛を刺身、炙り、炭焼き、煮物などで、ソムリエが選ぶシャンパン、ワイン、日本酒、オーナーシェフ 三井秀和、月替りおまかせコース (神戸牛コース33,000円、特選コース24,200円、おまかせコース17,600円、税込)、コースは18:00〜と20:30〜、ワインペアリング6種10,000円、友百合オリジナルペアリング7種10,000円、サービス料は別、カウンター12席とテーブル1席 (6名まで半個室)、18時〜23時、日曜・祝日・盆・正月・ゴールデンウィーク休み、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1丁目3番26号 ぐらんぱれビル1階、姉妹店の北新地 焼肉友ゆりが2026年10月13日に開店。食べログ (店舗会員): 予約制、子ども用のプレート5,500円、20席、サービス料10%、加熱式たばこは個室のみ、お土産のカツサンド、2023年4月22日オープン。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年10月): 牛カツサンド、ウニとユッケの手巻き、炭火焼き、釜めしと選べるご飯のお供、大将は以前 Tsuru Ton Tan の料理長、冗談の多い楽しい大将、量が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses at a counter, each dish explained (2026); many overseas guests (September 2025, July 2026). No English menu listed.

osaka_dammann_lumiere_takashimaya.gf_detail: Ask. The Tabelog listing says allergy information is available, but nothing is called gluten-free. Much of the food is wheat (pasta, croque monsieur, French toast, scones, pancakes, baguettes with the lunch); the galettes are not described as buckwheat-only. Teas themselves are leaf blends. The steaks and the pudding are the dishes to ask about.
osaka_dammann_lumiere_takashimaya.vegan_detail: Ask. More than 60 Dammann Frères teas (official site) served in a pot are the safe ground; milk tea is an option (September 2026). The food uses cream, egg, butter, cheese, meat and seafood; no vegan dish is listed.
osaka_dammann_lumiere_takashimaya.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–20:00 (last order 19:00); closed when Takashimaya Osaka closes (Tabelog; official site). Reservations on weekdays only, for two or more; a private room for up to 6 on weekdays for groups of 5 or more (Tabelog). Afternoon tea is served on weekdays from 13:00 (shop menu on Tabelog; a September 2026 diner missed it on a weekend). Lunch fills up: half full at 11:45, full by 12:30 on a weekday (October 2026); one diner queued (September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; parking in the store's contracted car park (Tabelog). Seats: 36 (Tabelog) or 52 including the private room (official store page). Opened 3 March 2011 (Tabelog).
osaka_dammann_lumiere_takashimaya.notes: [Café · Namba, a French tea salon in Takashimaya] Up on Takashimaya's second floor among the brand boutiques, a calm, black-toned salon that the official site calls Japan's first tea salon and boutique made with Dammann Frères, the Paris tea house given France's tea monopoly by Louis XIV in 1692, and chef Yasushi Karato of lumière in Shinsaibashi. Pick from more than 60 teas, served in a pot with the leaves taken out so they do not stew, alongside food from the lumière side: galettes folded around shrimp in lobster sauce or salmon, a seasonal one-plate lunch, a croque monsieur, steaks, and sweets from French toast to a Mont Blanc. The weekday afternoon tea (¥4,950, from 13:00) comes with free-flow tea. Weekday lunches fill by 12:30. Tabelog Cafe 100 in 2021 and Cafe WEST 100 in 2025. Teas and tea accessories are sold too. Open daily 10:00–20:00 with the store.

roles: Producer: chef Yasushi Karato of lumière (osaka_lumiere_higashishinsaibashi), head of the Lumière Group (official sites)
Run by the Lumière Group as one of its two DAMMANN lumière tea salons (k-coeur.com; dammann.jp)
chef_bio.background: Per dammann.jp: DAMMANN lumière is a collaboration between Dammann Frères and the French restaurant lumière, produced by Yasushi Karato, and Japan's first tea salon and boutique for the brand; besides Dammann Frères teas and accessories it serves seasonal dishes and desserts with more than 60 teas. Dammann Frères dates its history to 1692, when Louis XIV granted サー・ダマン (as written) the sole right to sell tea in France, and blends more than 300 teas, among them グールース, a French take on Earl Grey. The second DAMMANN lumière is in Daimaru Ashiya. Per the store page and Karato's profile there: trained at many famous restaurants and hotels, opened lumière in 2006, imports Dammann Frères, and heads a ten-shop group. This salon opened on 3 March 2011 (Tabelog). A September 2026 diner calls it "a well-known collaboration between Chef Takawata and Daman Frere" (as written).
chef_bio.specialty: Dammann Frères teas in the pot; galettes; afternoon tea; French toast.

anecdotes.text: "When I arrived at 11:45 AM, about half of the seats were filled, but by 12:30 PM, it was completely full. It's clear that this place is popular even on weekdays." — October 2026, a sixth visit, one-plate lunch with Anichai tea.
"I appreciated that [the staff] removed the tea leaves, so it didn't become overly bitter even if I took my time." — October 2026, Darjeeling with a sweets set.
"There was a brief explanation about Goulus included, which I thought was a nice touch." — September 2026, the seasonal dessert set, ¥2,200.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ダマンフレール公式サイト (dammann.jp): ダマンフレールの歴史は1692年、ルイ14世からフランス国内での紅茶の独占販売権を許可されたことに始まる、「グールース」をはじめ300種以上のブレンドティー、12年連続でミシュランの星を獲得したシェフ唐渡泰がオーナーシェフのフレンチレストラン「リュミエール」とのコラボレーションによる日本初のティーサロン&ブティック「ダマンリュミエール」、旬の食材の料理やデザートと60種類以上の紅茶。店舗: ダマンリュミエール 高島屋大阪店、難波5丁目1番5号 高島屋大阪店2F、10:00-20:00 (LO19:00)、定休日は施設に準ずる、52席 (個室あり)。芦屋店 (大丸芦屋店1階) も。リュミエールグループ (k-coeur.com): ティーサロンとして DAMMANN lumière 高島屋大阪店と芦屋店。食べログ (店舗会員): カフェ・フレンチ・スイーツ、平日のみ2名から予約可、個室は平日5名以上、36席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、アレルギー表示あり、2011年3月3日オープン、カフェ 百名店 2021、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。食べログのメニュー (英訳で確認): アフタヌーンティー4,950円 (平日13時から、紅茶はおかわり自由)、ガレット1,760〜1,870円、パスタ、クロックムッシュ、ヘルシーランチセット1,430円、ステーキ、フレンチトースト1,980円、モンブラン、スコーン。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): 番号で選ぶ紅茶、ポットで茶葉を抜いて出す、Ginori の大皿のワンプレートランチ、エビのガレット、平日の昼は満席に、季節のデザートセット2,200円、グールースの説明つき、週末はアフタヌーンティーなし。

cultural_comfort.note: Teas are numbered on the menu; reservations on weekdays only. No English evidence found.

osaka_hokkyoku_namba_honten.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The milk ice candy's label lists sweetened condensed milk, sugar, starch and flavouring (October 2026 review); the type of starch is not given, and the other flavours' ingredients are not published.
osaka_hokkyoku_namba_honten.vegan_detail: Ask. The milk ice candy is made with condensed milk and the soft serve with Hokkaido milk; the azuki (Tokachi beans, per the shop), fruit, ramune and matcha candies are not described, so ask about milk in them.
osaka_hokkyoku_namba_honten.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–20:00, open all year (official company page; an October 2026 review gives the same). Tabelog lists 10:00–20:00. No reservations (Tabelog). The ground floor is takeaway only, with a bin but no seats (October 2026); the 2F café opened on 25 April 2023 (Tabelog) and asks for one drink per person, with a last order (October 2026). Free dry ice for up to an hour with six candies (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY); no e-money (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Online shop and shipping (official site). Founded 1945 (official site).
osaka_hokkyoku_namba_honten.notes: [Sweets · Namba, Osaka's 1945 ice-candy shop] On the Ebisubashi-suji shopping street under a light-blue sign with two penguins, the ice-candy maker Osaka has known since just after the war. The founder started in 1945, when hardly any shop around Namba had food to sell, wanting to give children and women something cold and sweet, using precious sugar and selling each candy for ¥20 (official site). The milk, azuki and pineapple of that first year are still made, now with cocoa (first made in 1946 with cocoa imported from the occupation forces), matcha, strawberry, mango, ramune, mixed juice and, since August 2026, grape. Eight craftsmen make about 6,000 a day by hand, sweetened with white sugar crystals rather than sweeteners, with Tokachi azuki and diagonal sticks of Yoshino hinoki and cedar. Most are ¥200–¥230; soft serve of Hokkaido milk and Uji matcha is ¥500. Takeaway downstairs, a café upstairs since 2023. Tabelog Ice cream/gelato 100 in 2023 and 2026. Open daily 10:30–20:00.

roles: Representative: 久保田光恵 (as written; no romaji given), since 2005, of 株式会社アークティック (official company page)
Eight ice-candy craftsmen (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official history and company pages: founded in Namba in 1945 (昭和20年), selling milk, azuki and pineapple ice candy at ¥20; in 1946 made cocoa ice candy with cocoa imported from the occupation forces; radio advertising from 1952 and television and film advertising from 1953; in 1955 the Hokkyoku Building was completed, with a factory in the basement and a café and light meals on the first and second floors, also selling Western cakes and Japanese sweets; it was the second shop in Namba with an automatic door and brought in a colour television, filling the room for 力道山 wrestling broadcasts. In 2005 久保田光恵 became representative and 株式会社アークティック was set up. The company page recalls children who came for candy then and now buy them as gifts as grown men. Eight craftsmen make about 6,000 candies a day, 700,000 a year. The 2F café opened on 25 April 2023 (Tabelog). Tabelog Ice cream/gelato 100 in 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the founder on: a cold, tasty ice candy for children and women in the hungry years after the war; a place to relax on the Ebisubashi shopping street; the same handmade taste then and now (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Milk ice candy; azuki ice candy; soft serve.

anecdotes.text: "My parents used to frequent it when [my parents] were kids." — October 2026, soft serve mix, ¥500.
"The ice candy here features a stick (a chopstick from Yoshino, Nara) inserted diagonally, which is a unique touch for easier eating." — October 2026, milk ice candy ¥200.
"Thanks to years of commercials, it's hard to find someone who hasn't heard of it." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hokkyoku.jp): 北極、なんば戎橋筋、大阪名物手作りアイスキャンデー、創業昭和20年、当初からの味「ミルク」「あずき」「パイン」、現在は「ココア」「イチゴ」「抹茶」「マンゴー」「ラムネ」「ぶどう」も、職人が一本一本手作り。歴史: 昭和20年大阪難波にて創業 (当時20円)、昭和21年進駐軍からココアを輸入しココア味を製造、昭和27年ラジオCM、昭和28年東宝映画とテレビCM、昭和30年北極ビル完成 (地下に工場、1階・2階で喫茶・軽食、洋菓子や和菓子も)、難波で2番目に自動ドア、カラーテレビで力道山のプロレス中継は毎回満席、平成17年久保田光恵が代表に就任、株式会社アークティック設立。会社概要: 終戦直後に初代が「せめて、子供達や女性にだけでも冷たくて美味しいアイスキャンデーを造ってあげたい」と思ったのがきっかけ、難波3-8-22、10:30-20:00、年中無休。こだわり: 奈良県吉野産のひのきと杉の棒を斜めに刺す、白双糖を使い甘味料は使わない、北海道の十勝産あずき100%、8人の職人で1日6000本、年間70万本。商品: ミルク・ココア・抹茶・あずき・パイン200円、ミックスジュース・マンゴー・イチゴ・ラムネ・ぶどう230円、カップ380円 (マンゴー、ミルク、日向夏、大阪名物ミックスジュース)。食べログ: アイスクリーム・ジェラート 百名店 2023・2026、2023年4月25日に2階にカフェ、予約不可、カード・QR可。口コミ(2026年10月〜11月): ソフトクリーム500円 (北海道のミルク、宇治抹茶、ミックス)、1階は持ち帰りのみ、2階カフェはワンドリンク制、6本でドライアイス1時間無料、値引きのアイス。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose from the two cases and pay; staff are friendly (October 2026).
