osaka_shinsaibashi_kawaguchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Salt skewers and chicken sashimi (with wasabi or salt) are the plainest; tsukune comes with sauce (October 2026), the rice with raw egg uses soy-sauce koji (April 2025), and side dishes include kara-age, keema curry and truffle salt bread.
osaka_shinsaibashi_kawaguchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant. Vegetable skewers (shiitake, tomato, ginkgo, raw-eatable corn in season) are on the menu, but nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_shinsaibashi_kawaguchi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30) (official site; Tabelog). Reservations through the official site (Tabelog; official site); often fully booked even on the day, so book ahead (2025–2026 reviews), though a diner walked in after 22:00 on a July 2026 holiday. Cards: JCB, AMEX and Diners only; no e-money or QR (official site; Tabelog). Smoking allowed (official site). 14 seats at a counter facing the charcoal, plus private rooms for 4, 6 or 8 (official site; Tabelog); an October 2025 diner mentions a separate area on the third floor. No parking (official site).
osaka_shinsaibashi_kawaguchi.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, chicken sashimi and binchotan skewers in an alley] A 14-seat counter in a Shinsaibashi back alley, where you watch each skewer grilled over the charcoal in front of you; the official site counts six Tabelog Yakitori 100 selections (2018–2024). Start with the six-cut platter of morning-slaughtered chicken sashimi, which diners call the dish you would regret skipping, then move to the offal skewers the kitchen is known for (liver that even liver-haters eat, white liver, heart, neck, tamahimo) and finish with rice and raw egg. Side dishes are generous: a dashimaki with minced chicken inside, keema curry, truffle salt bread, a sweet-potato brûlée. It is almost always full, so book through the site; one diner who has come for over ten years, with children, recommends it to anyone asking for yakitori, while a busy September 2026 night meant an hour for the first three skewers. Smoking is allowed; JCB, AMEX and Diners only. Open daily 17:00–24:00.

roles: Grill cooks and a manager (unnamed; "the person grilling in front of the charcoal", April 2026; "Thank you, manager", August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (built on AutoReserve and linked from the Tabelog listing): a charcoal yakitori shop in a Shinsaibashi alley, selected for Tabelog Yakitori 100 in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024; morning-slaughtered jidori, a six-cut sashimi platter, offal skewers grilled so the liver stays soft and the heart juicy, tamahimo shigure-ni (a soy simmer), Tokushima shiitake, and rice with raw egg to finish; 14 seats including the counter and small private rooms. No opening date or owner is given in the sources read. Diners name the chicken as Satsuma chicken (May 2024; a Satsuma chicken tataki in October 2026) and as Ise Akadori from Mie (another October 2026 review). A September 2026 reviewer calls the shop "Kawaguchi Hanare", a name not found elsewhere.
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshness of morning-slaughtered chicken and careful charcoal heat in every skewer (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi platter; white liver; rice with raw egg.

anecdotes.text: "I've been a regular at this restaurant for over 10 years, and I used to visit every month. My kids love it too!" — August 2026.
"I had the chicken tail served medium-rare, and it was exceptional as well! Only restaurants confident in their freshness serve chicken tail this way." — October 2026, a third visit.
"Given the crowd, it was understandable that [the staff] forgot my drink order, and it took an hour for just three skewers to arrive." — September 2026, the omakase course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kawaguchi-9489.com): 心斎橋かわぐち、心斎橋の路地で朝引き地鶏を炭火で焼き上げる百名店の焼き鳥店、心斎橋駅から徒歩3分、食べログ焼鳥百名店に2018・2019・2021・2022・2023・2024年の6度選出、朝引き地鶏のむね・もも・ささみ・こころ・ずり・きもの6種盛りお造り、内臓系の炭火串 (レバーは柔らかくトロトロ、こころはジューシー)、玉ひもしぐれ煮、徳島産じいじいしいたけ、〆の卵かけご飯、6,000円コース (6,600円)、味肝のお造り850円、カウンター席と少人数向けの個室で14席、予約必須、月〜日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、駐車場なし、カードは JCB・AMEX・Diners、電子マネー・QR不可、店内で喫煙可、東心斎橋1-19-11 ピテカントロプスビル 1F。食べログ: 焼き鳥・鶏料理・創作料理、予約は公式サイトから、個室 (4、6、8名)、日本酒・焼酎・ワインにこだわり。口コミ(2025年4月〜2026年10月): お造り盛り合わせは必須、白レバー、ぼんじり、つくね、ささみのわさび、トリュフの塩パン、キーマカレー、肉入りのだし巻き、卵かけご飯、いつも満席で予約必須、10年以上通う人も、Ise Akadori (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on the official site, which has an English version; order à la carte or a course at the counter.

osaka_ushitora_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, grilled fish and salt-grilled chicken neck are the plainest; kara-age, tempura (conger eel, maitake, ginger), macaroni salads, rice noodles and dishes in sauce or broth are not.
osaka_ushitora_namba.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu is mainly seafood and meat, and several small plates use broth (fried eggplant in broth, dashi omelette). Grilled shiitake and ginger tempura appear on the menu; ask what is in the batter and sauces.
osaka_ushitora_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00; Sat–Sun 15:00–23:00; public holidays 15:00–22:00; open all year (Tabelog). No reservations; often a short queue outside (2026 reviews). From October 2026 the shop takes no groups of three or more; come alone or as a pair (Tabelog notice). No soft drinks; no minors (Tabelog). The shop asks you not to linger (Tabelog), and diners describe drinking quickly and moving on (2024–2026). No cards or e-money (Tabelog). 28 standing places at the counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Behind Takashimaya, near Nankai Namba Station, behind a vinyl curtain (September 2026 reviews).
osaka_ushitora_namba.notes: [Izakaya · Ura Namba, a standing bar for one or two] Behind a vinyl curtain in the lanes behind Takashimaya, a long standing counter for 28, lined with the day's small plates. The shop's own words: a place for a quick drink after work, not for lingering or large groups, and since October 2026 for one or two only, with no soft drinks. Order the ¥500 assortment of three plates for one, then sashimi, the double-fried kara-age with rakkyo tartar sauce (a diner on a 21st visit jokes about quitting work to make the tartar sauce), conger eel grilled or set in jelly, and whatever is on the counter. Staff, mostly women in an October 2026 visit, keep it moving. Tabelog Tachinomi 100 in 2025. Expect a short wait outside; open daily from 16:00, 15:00 at weekends.

roles: Staff (unnamed; "mostly women" in an October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing with the shop's own welcome note for first-time visitors; no opening date or owner is given. October 2026 reviewers call it a long-established standing bar and "a pioneer of the standing bar boom". Tabelog Tachinomi 100, 2025. Several diners have visited 11 to 24 times (2024–2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: A standing bar for a quick drink without lingering, a cozy spot to unwind after work; come alone or as a pair (shop note on Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Three-plate assortment for one; kara-age with rakkyo tartar sauce; conger eel.

anecdotes.text: "I love it so much that I'm considering quitting my job to become a pickled shallot tartar sauce vendor." — September 2026, a 21st visit; kara-age, sashimi platter, roast pork and a highball, ¥3,080.
"The jelly-like dish was beautifully garnished with chrysanthemum flowers, and I was once again amazed that this is a standing bar in the back streets of Namba." — September 2026, a tenth visit.
"It seems like the rule here is to drink quickly and not linger, as everyone seems to understand" — June 2024, a 12th visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 丑寅、立ち飲み、難波千日前15-19、地下鉄なんば駅から徒歩5分、南海なんば駅から徒歩3分、月〜金 16:00〜23:00、土日 15:00〜23:00、祝日 15:00〜22:00、年中無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、28名の立ち飲み、喫煙可、未成年は入店不可、ソフトドリンクなし、2026年10月から3名以上の団体は不可、立ち飲み 百名店 2025。食べログのメニュー (英訳で確認): kara-age のらっきょうタルタル350円、生姜の天ぷら180円。口コミ(2024年6月〜2026年10月): おひとりさまの3種盛り500円、カウンターに並ぶおばんざい、刺身盛り、本まぐろ、なめろう、穴子の白焼き、うざく、だし巻き、kara-age、メガ角ハイボール700円、日本酒の品ぞろえ、長居しないのがルール、外で少し待つ、スタッフは女性が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: A crowded standing counter; order from the dishes laid out or the menu; one or two people only; no soft drinks. No English evidence found.

osaka_yp_ryu_nishishinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The meat is eaten with a washing sauce, salt or wasabi (official site), and some courses include a sukiyaki-style seasoning, a fillet-cutlet sandwich and a wagyu dashi chazuke; none is described as gluten-free.
osaka_yp_ryu_nishishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: course yakiniku of wagyu, with yukhoe, beef dashi and a cutlet sandwich.
osaka_yp_ryu_nishishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Dinner daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); lunch Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00); closed on some days, posted on Instagram (official site). Tabelog lists lunch every day, sold out when gone. Dinner is courses only and basically by reservation, with a 2-hour limit; lunch takes no reservations (official FAQ; Tabelog). No service charge; course prices include tax (official FAQ; Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). 32 seats: 6 at the counter, tables, semi-private tables and a private room for 6; private hire for 20 or more; non-smoking (Tabelog; FAQ). The entrance is locked: ring the intercom (Tabelog). No sandals or jerseys (Tabelog). Children if the private room is free (official FAQ). Opened 5 June 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_yp_ryu_nishishinsaibashi.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, the staircase platter] The quieter of the two YP流 shops, down a staircase into a calm, Japanese-modern basement a minute from Shinsaibashi Station, serving 'yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach': long-fed heifers such as Yamagata beef, eaten with a light washing sauce, salt or wasabi rather than heavy sauce. Dinner is courses only. The ¥7,000 Challenge course is the one to book: seared yukhoe, a wagyu bowl with sea urchin and salmon roe, a thick, tender fillet-cutlet sandwich made only at this branch, then the six-cut 'flower staircase' platter you eat from the top step down (the tongue grilled well, the rest lightly), and wagyu dashi chazuke to finish. Diners in October 2026 found it light to the end and good for dates and business; one birthday party found the young part-time staff short of high-end service. Weekend lunch is a wagyu rice box. Ring the intercom; no sandals.

roles: Representative (unnamed) who buys at the auctions; meat craftsmen at the counter
chef_bio.background: Per the two official sites (ypryu-nishi.com, ypryu-honten.com): "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach" (胃もたれしない、和の焼肉), using only long-fed heifers chosen for bloodline and producer, such as Noto beef and Yamagata beef, eaten with a washing sauce (洗いダレ), salt and wasabi; the signature is the "flower staircase" platter (花の階段盛り), six cuts set out on a stepped stand; anniversary courses end with a cake in a treasure chest. The founding wish: "to make a place where young customers can look good" (若いお客様でも格好の付けれるお店を作りたい), a "first high-end restaurant", and the site says many guests are twenty-somethings (20代のお客様に数多く御来店). Per the Nishi-Shinsaibashi Tabelog listing, the company's representative goes to the auctions personally to buy long-reared female cattle. Two shops: the Souemoncho main shop (opened 29 September 2017) and Nishi-Shinsaibashi (5 June 2022), per Tabelog.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Flower staircase platter; fillet-cutlet sandwich (this branch only); wagyu dashi chazuke.

anecdotes.text: "It's suggested to grill the tongue well, while the others should be grilled lightly." — October 2026, the Challenge course ¥7,000.
"Premium Salted Tongue, Sirloin Cap, Top Sirloin, Gluteus Accessorius, Premium Loin, and Special Loin! … personally, I especially loved the Sirloin Cap!" — October 2026, the staircase platter.
"While the children enjoyed udon, we were constantly amazed by the flavor of the meat." — October 2026, a birthday lunch in the private room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 焼肉 割烹 YP流 西心斎橋店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-1-13 東邦ビル B1F、「胃もたれしない、和の焼肉」、長期飼育の雌牛 (能登牛、山形牛など)、洗いダレ・塩・わさび、名物「花の階段盛り」、記念日コース限定「ケーキ付き宝箱」、西心斎橋店のヘレカツサンド・和牛のお重・タンユッケ・うにいくら丼、カウンターで職人の肉捌き、6名の完全個室、「若いお客様でも格好の付けれるお店を作りたい」、月〜金17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、土・日・祝11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:00〜23:00、不定休、カード・QR可。コース (税込): 平日限定 入門コース5,000円、挑戦コース7,000円、継承コース9,000円、記念日コース10,000円、飲み放題は2,000円増し。よくあるご質問: ディナーはコースのみ (コースの人は焼物の追加可)、ランチは数量限定の和牛のお重、ディナーは基本予約制、ランチは予約不可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、20名以上で貸切、子どもは個室が空いていれば可。食べログ (店舗会員): 2時間制、32席 (カウンター6、テーブル、半個室、6名個室)、禁煙、入口はオートロックでインターホン、サンダル・ジャージは断ることも、2022年6月5日オープン、代表が競りで長期肥育の雌牛を仕入れる。口コミ(2026年10月): 挑戦コース7,000円、階段盛りの6種、タンはしっかり、ほかは軽く焼く、無煙ロースター、追加の焼物、ランチのお重1,500円と3,000円、出汁をかけてひつまぶし風に、若いアルバイトの接客が物足りないという声。

osaka_lilo_coffee_kissa_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The coffee itself is plain beans and water; the sweets are cakes such as tiramisu and baked cheesecake, which usually contain wheat.
osaka_lilo_coffee_kissa_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Black coffee in any brewing method is the plain option; floats come with vanilla or rum-raisin ice cream and the cakes use dairy.
osaka_lilo_coffee_kissa_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 13:00–21:30; Tue 13:00–19:30; Sat and Sun 11:00–21:30 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). A queue forms on the stairs in the afternoon: 20–30 minutes around 14:00–15:00 in October 2026, with orders taken while you wait; about half the waiting customers were taking out. No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; October 2026). 24 seats, non-smoking, free Wi-Fi and power outlets; takeaway; babies welcome (Tabelog). Opened 6 June 2018 (Tabelog).
osaka_lilo_coffee_kissa_shinsaibashi.notes: [Kissaten · Shinsaibashi, beans and brew to order] A retro second-floor coffee room between the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade and Midosuji, the sister of LiLo Coffee Roasters in Nishi-Shinsaibashi. The staff explain each bean in detail, then you choose the beans and the method (siphon, AeroPress and more) and get a card describing your cup; a September 2026 couple had a dark Kenya by AeroPress and a medium Colombia by siphon. The room keeps the look of the cocoa shop that was here before (Akatori, per the staff), Showa-era walls, clocks and chairs. Pair a cup with the tiramisu made from the house blend, the rich cheesecake, or a float with rum-raisin ice cream; a seasonal coffee-and-dessert set was ¥1,300 in October 2026. Expect a 20–30 minute queue on the stairs in the afternoon; staff take orders as you wait and explain in English. PayPay or cash.

roles: Baristas (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing: specialty coffee roasted in-house, baristas who ask about your taste and mood, three specialty coffees and five brewing methods, seasonal drinks and sweets, beans, equipment and original LiLo goods. Opened 6 June 2018. Sister of LiLo Coffee Roasters at Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-28 (osaka_lilo_coffee_roasters_shinsaibashi; same website). An August 2026 diner was told by the staff that the room was formerly a cocoa specialty shop called Akatori, and that its atmosphere was kept.
chef_bio.specialty: Choice of beans and brewing method; tiramisu with the house blend; coffee float with rum-raisin ice cream.

anecdotes.text: "I learned from the staff that this used to be a cocoa specialty shop called 'Akatori.' They have maintained the atmosphere from that time" — August 2026, a Kenya by siphon.
"The staff explained everything in English very carefully, which made me feel that the place is popular among foreigners!" — October 2026, tiramisu and coffee.
"While waiting, they kindly took my order in advance, so I was able to enjoy my drink quickly." — October 2026, a seasonal Mexico coffee pairing ¥1,300.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): リロ珈琲喫茶、喫茶店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-25 金子ビル 2F、心斎橋駅から徒歩4分、月・水・木・金13:00〜21:30、火13:00〜19:30、土・日11:00〜21:30、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、24席、禁煙、Wi-Fi・電源、テイクアウト、赤ちゃん可、2018年6月6日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 自家焙煎のスペシャルティコーヒー、バリスタが好みや気分を聞いてくれる、3種のスペシャルティと5種類の淹れ方、季節のドリンクとスイーツ、豆や器具、オリジナルグッズ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 階段で待つ行列 (20〜30分)、待つ間に注文を聞いてくれる、豆と淹れ方を選べる、サイフォン、Kenya、Colombia、Ethiopia、季節の Mexico とさつまいものペアリング1,300円、ハウスブレンドのティラミス、チーズケーキ、ラムレーズンアイスのフロート、豆の説明カード、昭和レトロの内装、以前は Akatori というココアの店、英語で説明、海外の客が多い、カード不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explained the coffees in English to overseas visitors (October 2026); bean cards with each cup.

osaka_osaka_ryori_asai_higashishinsaibas.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The daily menu runs to 150-plus dishes, including tempura, fried skewers and a beef cutlet, and Osaka cooking is built on dashi and soy sauce. The official menu page asks guests to tell the restaurant about allergies in advance.
osaka_osaka_ryori_asai_higashishinsaibas.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Osaka-style cooking of fish, shellfish, whale and meat, seasoned with dashi.
osaka_osaka_ryori_asai_higashishinsaibas.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00; holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday (official site). Tabelog lists holidays as closed; ask before a holiday visit. Reservations recommended, preferably by phone (official site; July 2026). Cash or cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site). 45 seats: a 16-seat counter, tables for up to 30, private rooms on two floors (1F and 7F); designated smoking area; children welcome with a kids menu (Tabelog; official site). Takeaway: sansho jako, sardines for chazuke and bento boxes (official site). Formerly named おおさか料理 喜川 浅井 (Tabelog).
osaka_osaka_ryori_asai_higashishinsaibas.notes: [Osaka ryori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a 150-dish scroll] A busy Osaka-cuisine counter in a Higashi-Shinsaibashi back street, where a scroll-long handwritten menu of more than 150 dishes is rewritten every day from the morning market and carries no prices; the restaurant was formerly called Kikawa Asai. Sit at the 16-seat counter to watch a kitchen of about seven cooks (May 2026), and order freely: sashimi, tender simmered octopus, hamo in summer, a beef cutlet with a rare centre that one regular never skips, fried whale skewers, Nara-zuke with cream cheese, a tuna bowl with fish broth to finish. Or let the chef choose five dishes (¥14,300 or ¥18,700) or take a course. Two diners spent just under ¥30,000 with drinks (June 2026). Diners praise the dashi and the staff; one found it flawless but unexciting (September 2026). Book by phone. Closed Sundays.

roles: Kitchen of about seven cooks (unnamed; May 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: run by 株式会社一是; "おおさか うまいもん"; the day's menu is decided by what comes from the market each morning, with more than 150 dishes on a scroll-like menu, Japanese, Western and Chinese; guests choose freely or leave it to the chef; "the traditional taste and skill of Osaka cuisine". Tabelog gives the former name おおさか料理 喜川 浅井, and a 2020 review calls it a branch from the famous restaurant Kikawa. The official site writes the name 淺井; Tabelog 浅井.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Seasonal Japanese ingredients, cooked with time and care", to be picked at "with idle chatter" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Scroll menu of 150-plus dishes; beef cutlet; hamo.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering, the first thing that surprises you is the number of chefs! For the size of the restaurant, it seems like only 2 or 3 would be enough, but there are about 7!" — May 2026.
"Among the dishes, the beef cutlet is a must-try. It's perfectly cooked, with a crispy coating and a beautifully rare center." — September 2026, a regular's third visit.
"The menu does not display prices, which can be a bit nerve-wracking at first. However, for two people, we spent just under JPY 30,000" — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: おおさか料理 淺井、運営は株式会社一是、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-19 ロイヤル中家1F・7F、長堀橋駅から徒歩4分、心斎橋駅から徒歩5分、月〜土17:00〜23:00、祝日17:00〜22:00、日曜定休、カウンター16席、テーブル30席、現金・カード可、予約は電話がおすすめ。「おおさか うまいもん」、日本の旬を活かし手間暇をかけて調理、毎朝市場から仕入れた食材でその日の献立、巻物の如く長いお品書きに常時150種以上、和洋中、好きな料理を選ぶか板前のお任せコース、おおさか料理伝統の味と技。コース (税込): 竹コース14,300円、梅コース18,700円、楽コース22,000円、お任せ5品14,300円・18,700円、鱧しゃぶ・てっちり・カニ鍋も、苦手な食材やアレルギーは事前に。お土産: 山椒じゃこ2,200円、お茶漬け用鰯2,200円、お弁当4,320円〜。食べログ: 旧店名 おおさか料理 喜川 浅井、45席、個室、分煙、子ども・キッズメニュー可、日・祝休み。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 値段の書いていない長いお品書き、板前が7人ほど、カウンターがおすすめ、お造り、タコのやわらか煮、ビーフカツ、鱧、梅肉の鱧、アワビとアスパラのバター焼き、赤貝と junsai、春野菜と稚鮎の天ぷら、クジラの串揚げ、なすと蟹のあんかけ、マグロの漬け丼、Nara-zuke とクリームチーズ、2人で3万円弱、だしの深い味わい、電話予約で外国人スタッフが対応、完璧だが面白みはないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English version; a foreign staff member took one diner's phone booking (August 2026). The menu itself is a handwritten Japanese scroll without prices.

osaka_yp_ryu_souemoncho.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Three of the nine grilled cuts in the plate courses come in sauce, the courses end with wagyu sukiyaki, and other dishes include beef shigureni and a soy-milk bun in a thickened sauce; salt-grilled cuts with wasabi are the plainest, but nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_yp_ryu_souemoncho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: course yakiniku of wagyu, with yukhoe, sukiyaki and beef dashi.
osaka_yp_ryu_souemoncho.hours_raw: Dinner daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); lunch Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00); closed on some days and on 31 December and 1 January (official site; Tabelog). Tabelog lists lunch every day; one diner found 15 lunch bowls a day and a queue before opening (October 2026). Reservations with a 2-hour limit; cancellations within 2 days are charged in full (Tabelog). No service charge; course prices include tax (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). 32 seats: 8 at the counter, tables, a curtained semi-private room for 4 and a private room for 5–8; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking, ashtray outside; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). The entrance is locked: ring the intercom (Tabelog). From late October 2026 single dishes can be ordered here too (official site news, 26 October 2026). Opened 29 September 2017 (Tabelog).
osaka_yp_ryu_souemoncho.notes: [Yakiniku · Souemoncho, the YP流 main shop] The first YP流, behind a locked door in a basement on the east side of Souemoncho, a minute from Dotonbori: course yakiniku of long-fed wagyu heifers, served with salt, wasabi or a light washing sauce, 'yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach'. The ¥7,700 Souemoncho course is the favourite: kimchi and namul, seared yukhoe with egg yolk, three cuts of tongue, three salt-grilled and three sauce-grilled cuts from Yamagata, Omi or Kobe beef, then wagyu sukiyaki, rice and yuzu sherbet; staff time each plate to your pace and butcher at the counter in front of you. The shop says some 2,000 parties a year come for anniversaries, with cake in a treasure chest. Lunch at weekends brings a limited wagyu and salmon-roe bowl or the full course; one diner found the lunch meat thin for the price (October 2026). From late October 2026 single dishes can be ordered too. Ring the intercom.

roles: Meat craftsmen at the counter (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the two official sites (ypryu-nishi.com, ypryu-honten.com): "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach" (胃もたれしない、和の焼肉), using only long-fed heifers chosen for bloodline and producer, such as Noto beef and Yamagata beef, eaten with a washing sauce (洗いダレ), salt and wasabi; the signature is the "flower staircase" platter (花の階段盛り), six cuts set out on a stepped stand; anniversary courses end with a cake in a treasure chest. The founding wish: "to make a place where young customers can look good" (若いお客様でも格好の付けれるお店を作りたい), a "first high-end restaurant", and the site says many guests are twenty-somethings (20代のお客様に数多く御来店). Per the Nishi-Shinsaibashi Tabelog listing, the company's representative goes to the auctions personally to buy long-reared female cattle. Two shops: the Souemoncho main shop (opened 29 September 2017) and Nishi-Shinsaibashi (5 June 2022), per Tabelog. The Souemoncho site adds that about 2,000 parties a year choose the shop for anniversaries, and that it serves its own wagyu dashi chazuke and a soy-milk bun in warm sauce. Tabelog notes guests include young people, couples and international travellers, and points business diners to the quieter Nishi-Shinsaibashi shop.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Plate courses of nine cuts with wagyu sukiyaki; flower staircase platter.

anecdotes.text: "Moreover, I appreciated how they timed the serving of the next meat based on my pace." — October 2026, the Pure Yakiniku Course ¥7,700.
"Watching the butchering process right in front of me added to the overall experience! There were many young regulars dining alone" — October 2026, a first visit.
"I was delighted to learn that I could enjoy the same course for lunch as I would for dinner" — October 2026, the last day of a trip to Osaka.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 焼肉 割烹 YP流 宗右衛門町本店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町1-12 セントラルビル地下1階、「胃もたれしない、和の焼肉」、長期飼育の雌牛 (能登牛、山形牛など)、洗いダレ・塩・わさび、名物「花の階段盛り」、年間2,000組が記念日に利用、記念日コース限定「ケーキ付き宝箱」、和牛出汁茶漬けと豆乳まんじゅう、カウンターで職人の肉捌き、個室は5名から、月〜金17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、土・日・祝11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:00〜23:00、不定休、2026年10月26日から本店限定で単品利用。コース (税込): 肉おまかせ5,500円、宗右衛門町コース7,700円、神戸牛コース10,000円、記念日コース10,000円、プレミアム記念日コース12,000円、土鍋コース11,000円 (焼肉9種〈タン3種・塩焼き3種・タレ焼き3種〉＋和牛のすき焼き)、飲み放題は2,000円増し。食べログ (店舗会員): 2時間制、2日前からのキャンセルは100%、32席 (カウンター8、テーブル、4名の半個室、5〜8名の個室)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、入口はオートロックでインターホン、12月31日・1月1日休み、2017年9月29日オープン、若い人、カップル、海外の旅行者にも人気。口コミ(2026年10月): 宗右衛門町コース7,700円、炙りユッケ、タン3種、Yamagata・Omi・Kobe・Kagoshima の牛、和牛のすき焼き、しぐれ煮、わかめスープ、ゆずシャーベット、目の前の肉捌き、ペースに合わせて出してくれる、ランチは1日15食の和牛といくらの丼、ランチの肉が薄く割高という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Official site and courses in English, Chinese and Korean; international travellers among the guests (Tabelog).

osaka_yuzan_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Seasoning is kept simple, but the shop names a naturally brewed, three-year soy sauce and miso among its seasonings (official site), and dipping sauces of soy, miso and sudachi come with the meat (August 2026); courses end with a spice curry or cold noodles.
osaka_yuzan_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an aged-beef and horumon restaurant; the vegetables come with the meat courses and the red-wine shabu-shabu.
osaka_yuzan_minamisenba.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 17:30–23:00, last order 22:30 (official site); Tabelog gives 17:00–23:00 with last order food 21:30, drinks 22:00, and says closing time can depend on how much meat is left; closed Sunday and Monday, with occasional irregular closures. Reservations by phone (official site) or online (Tabelog). Cancellation: 30% of the course two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day (official site; Tabelog gives 50% and 100%). Table charge ¥550 per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 47 seats: tables for 4 ×7 and 6 ×2, a private room for 7, rooms up to 15; non-smoking, smoking area on the terrace; whole-restaurant hire up to 50 (Tabelog; official site). Children only when a private room is free (Tabelog).
osaka_yuzan_minamisenba.notes: [Yakiniku · Minami-Semba, bone-in aged beef with a walk-in wine cellar] A quiet, spacious meat-and-wine restaurant in an office district near Nagahoribashi, open since the early 1990s and moved here from Ikuno Ward (a June 2025 diner). Everything is aged on the bone: Omi beef from Shiga, grazed shorthorn from Hokkaido, and black wagyu from a century-old Kagoshima farm; the horumon is from free-roaming Hokkaido ジビーフ (jibeef) cattle, lean and grassy. The owner-chef brings a bone-in block to the table, explains each cut and grills it over Kishu binchotan (January 2025). Start with the seared wagyu carpaccio, a must-order for one returning diner, then a course from ¥9,350 with tax, the red-wine shabu-shabu, or à la carte down to a glass of wine and appetizers for one; finish with the spice curry and mango chutney. Diners pick bottles inside the cellar (January 2026). One diner found the soy, miso and sudachi sauces short of punch. Tabelog Yakiniku WEST 100 2020 and 2021.

roles: Owner-sommelier and owner-chef ("Yasuda" in a September 2024 review; no Japanese source names the owner)
Head chef (料理長) grills the blocks at the table (official site)
Operator: the company behind a-nest.co.jp, which also runs 薪火 全 (Makibi Zen) on Awaji Island
chef_bio.background: The official site gives the founding as 1990 in one place and 1992 in another; Tabelog's opening day is 4 November 1993, and its shop text speaks of 34 years and aged Omi beef that draws fans from afar. A June 2025 diner knew it long ago in Ikuno Ward before the move to Minami-Semba. The same operator runs 薪火 全 (Makibi Zen), an 8-seat wood-fire counter in a national park on Awaji Island with one guest room (official site), open on weekends per 2024–2025 reviews. Diners describe the owner-chef explaining each cut's origin and rearing (September 2024) and an attentive owner couple (January 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Seasoning kept to the simplest, so you taste the difference between meats"; no chemical seasonings since opening, "not just delicious, but easy on the body" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Bone-in aged beef; jibeef horumon; seared wagyu carpaccio; spice curry.

anecdotes.text: "The carpaccio remains delicious as ever. It's a must-order… For the finale, I recommend the curry. Be sure to add mango chutney for a perfect finish." — July 2025, back after five years or more.
"I was able to enter the wine cellar and choose my wine while receiving explanations!" — January 2026.
"The Premium Salted Tongue and Aged Omi Beef were surprisingly delicious… The staff kindly explained the characteristics of the meat and the benefits of aged meat." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (a-nest.co.jp): 肉料理とワイン 遊山 Yuzan、心斎橋にほど近い静かなエリアの隠れ家レストラン、1990年創業以来 (別の箇所では1992年の創業以来)、熟成肉は全て骨付き、近江牛ランプ・イチボ / 経産牛は滋賀県草津「サカエヤ」、放牧の短角牛 Tボーン / ミスジは北海道エレゾ、創業100年を超える「やまさん牧場」の発酵したパイナップルやさとうきびを食べた雌の黒毛和牛 (ヒレ / シンタマ など希少部位)、ホルモンは北海道の様似牧場の完全放牧「ジビーフ」(日本で一番自由な牛)、化学調味料は一切使用せず、井上本店の天然醸造 三年熟成の醤油と味噌、内堀醸造のりんご酢・米酢、田野屋塩二郎の塩、淡路島の天日塩、クラタペッパー、オーナーソムリエ厳選ワインのセラー、ワインとアテで一人呑みも、個室、最大50名の貸し切り。お料理例 (外税): 自分のペースで焼肉コース8,500円、控えめな量でリーズナブルに10,000円、遊山の厳選肉を一通り13,000円 (発酵食で育った鹿児島県産 黒毛和牛 極上ヒレ)、シェフが焼く塊肉の特別コース15,000〜25,000円 (料理長が目の前で焼く)、赤ワインしゃぶしゃぶ12,000円・プレミアム15,000円 (シャトーブリアン)、炙り黒毛和牛肉のカルパッチョ2,300円、牛肉100%テリーヌ1,800円、ジビーフホルモンの煮込み850円、特上塩タン2,000円、肉盛5,000円、ほろ酔いセット。営業時間 火曜日〜土曜日17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、予約は電話、キャンセル料は前々日30%・前日50%・当日100%、南船場1-10-2、長堀橋1番出口から徒歩5分。同じ会社の店: 薪火 全 (淡路島の国定公園内、カウンター8席の薪料理専門店、一日一組のゲストルーム)。食べログ (店舗会員): 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理21:30・ドリンク22:00)、日・月休み、チャージ550円、47席、テラスに喫煙所、子どもは個室が空いているときのみ、オープン1993年11月4日、焼肉 WEST 百名店 2020・2021、コース (税込) 9,350円・11,000円・14,300円。口コミ(2024年9月〜2026年9月): オーナーシェフが骨付きの塊肉を持ってきて産地と部位を説明、Kishu binchotan、センマイと味噌ベースのたれ、和牛のカルパッチョ、ホルモンのトマト煮込みとパテ、40日熟成と3週間熟成のトップサーロイン、Kikaijima の牧場のシャトーブリアン、スパイスカレーにマンゴーチャツネ、赤ワインしゃぶしゃぶ、ワインセラーに入って選べる、以前は Ikuno 区、醤油・味噌・sudachi のたれは物足りないという声、sudachi のソルベは酸っぱかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English version; staff explain each cut (2024–2026).

osaka_chugoku_ryori_ryumon_kitahama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu leans on gyoza, spring rolls, yakisoba, champon and other wheat-noodle dishes, kara-age and sauced stir-fries; nothing is said about what goes into the curry fried rice, which diners season with Worcestershire or soy sauce from the table.
osaka_chugoku_ryori_ryumon_kitahama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg covers the signature fried rice, and the menu is meat, squid and shrimp stir-fries, gyoza and soups; nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_chugoku_ryori_ryumon_kitahama.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–13:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Saturday and Sunday (Tabelog; reviews). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); group omakase dinners are booked ahead (April 2026), and Friday nights fill up (September 2026). At weekday lunch it fills by noon; the Tianjin curry fried rice can take a while, and staff may suggest another dish (September and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). About 50 seats, tatami room, non-smoking (Tabelog). Not a shop-maintained listing.
osaka_chugoku_ryori_ryumon_kitahama.notes: [Chinese · Kitahama, the curry fried rice under an omelette, in a listed basement] A long-established local Chinese restaurant, over 40 years by one diner's count, down a narrow stair into the basement of a retro Kitahama building registered as a tangible cultural property; you go in through the entrance of the omurice shop Kitakousei and take the door on the right. Weekday lunch fills up by noon, and most diners order the same thing: Tianjin curry fried rice, a mound of curry-flavoured rice under a thick, soft omelette (¥1,000, large ¥1,200), served with a soup that changes day to day. It can take time, so the ¥1,100 two-dish daily lunch is the quick choice. Evenings it turns into a lively group dinner spot: garlic-free gyoza, crisp spring rolls, a Mongolian-squid salad, mapo tofu, ankake yakisoba and plenty of Shaoxing wine. Mind your head on the stairs. Closed at weekends. Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 2021.

roles: Owner and kitchen unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: A long-established local Chinese restaurant with over 40 years of history (September 2026 review), in the basement of 青山ビル, which reviewers describe as a registered tangible cultural property (September and October 2026). Diners describe an always cheerful, lively owner who welcomes regulars (May 2025) and a lively, assertive hostess with an Osaka manner (October 2026); a reviewer recalls it on TV (August 2026). Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Tianjin curry fried rice; gyoza; Mongolian-squid salad; ankake yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: "That said, about 80% of the other diners also ordered the Tenshin Curry Fried Rice." — October 2026, two lunches on consecutive days.
"Please be careful not to bump your head on the narrow stairs at the entrance (even if you know, you'll hit it about one out of three times)." — May 2025.
"The gyoza is delicious even without garlic." — May 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (英語版): Chinese Ryomon (チュウゴクリョウリ リュウモン)、中国料理・ラーメン、伏見町2-2-6 青山ビル B1F、北浜駅6番出口からすぐ、月〜金11:00〜13:00・17:30〜21:00、土日休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、50席、座敷、禁煙、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ(2025年5月〜2026年10月): 40年以上の歴史、登録有形文化財のレトロなビルの地下、Kitakousei の入口から入って右の扉から階段を下りる、狭い階段で頭をぶつける、昼は満席、ランチ客の8割が天津カレー炒飯 (1,000円、大盛り1,200円、日替わりのスープ付き)、ふわふわの卵の下にカレー味の炒飯、ソースや醤油をかけても、時間がかかるので日替わりランチ1,100円 (2品、ご飯、スープ) を勧められることも、天津麺、ankake yakisoba、少し甘めのあんの champon、ラーメン、麻婆麺、夜はにんにくなしの gyoza、春巻き、Mongolian squid と kaiware のサラダ、蒸し鶏の胡麻 miso、茄子の肉味噌炒め、きくらげと卵の炒め、麻婆豆腐、酢豚、団体のおまかせ3,500円、紹興酒、元気な店主、開店以来変わらないメニュー、テレビで見た。

cultural_comfort.note: Orders taken verbally; a long Japanese menu, but most lunch diners just order the curry fried rice (2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (not shop-maintained); 2026 reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_tenshin_no_kimochi_taisho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every gyoza is wrapped in wheat dough made from Hokkaido Haruyutaka flour (Tabelog), and the menu adds fried gyoza, mazesoba and soy-based dipping sauces.
osaka_tenshin_no_kimochi_taisho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the gyoza are meat- or shrimp-filled, and the courses add oysters, chicken and beef; nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_tenshin_no_kimochi_taisho.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30), open year-round; set lunches until 14:00, and lunch ends when the rice runs out (Tabelog). Lunch reservations only for the 11:00 opening, and a booking is cancelled if you are not there when called; from 14:00 one drink per person (Tabelog). The phone may go unanswered at lunch. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), PayPay and au PAY; no e-money (Tabelog). 44 seats: 12 at the counter, 34 at tables; non-smoking; hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Children welcome all day, kids menu (Tabelog). English menu, menu with photos, digital menu (Tabelog). Takeout; frozen gyoza by mail order (official site). Opened 6 April 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_tenshin_no_kimochi_taisho.notes: [Gyoza · Taisho, handmade gyoza by the station, open to midnight] A spacious gyoza tavern a minute from Taisho Station, handy before a game or concert at Kyocera Dome, where the wrappers are rolled from Hokkaido Haruyutaka wheat and every dumpling is wrapped by hand in the workshop on site. Plates of two (¥380–580) let you compare: juicy pan-fried, chewy boiled, crisp fried, fried with tartar sauce, and the favourite of one October 2026 diner, steamed gyoza in a rich sesame sauce; staff explain which sauce goes with which, and there's no garlic. Lunch sets (fried gyoza set ¥1,180) come with an herb salad, soup and self-serve zha cai; the pickled mustard greens alone won over one returning diner. Evenings bring Taiwanese mazesoba, mapo tofu and all-you-can-drink courses. One drink per person after 2 pm, and one diner found dishes cooling when served all at once. Tabelog Gyoza 100 2024.

roles: Kitchen and owner unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the shop makes everything by hand, from kneading the dough to wrapping, "going against the times" of mechanisation for quality, and sells its preservative-free frozen gyoza online; site posts from February 2021 announce the gyoza tavern with an attached workshop opening in April in Taisho-ku and a switch to Tsumagoi highland cabbage. Tabelog's opening day is 6 April 2021; Gyoza 100 2024. Diners describe kind staff who explain how to eat each kind (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "No preservatives, all handmade": an analogue process kept on purpose, to make gyoza that digital efficiency cannot (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade gyoza: pan-fried, boiled, fried and sesame-sauce steamed.

anecdotes.text: "The chewy steamed gyoza coated in rich sesame sauce is a match made in heaven! You can really taste the sesame flavor, making it my top pick!" — October 2026, four kinds of gyoza and rice for ¥1,720.
"Particularly noteworthy is the appetizer, the pickled mustard greens… so delicious that it could overshadow the star of the show, the gyoza." — October 2026, lunch.
"As expected from a gyoza specialty shop, the gyoza was chewy and juicy. Plus, it was garlic-free, so I could enjoy it without worry." — October 2026, fried gyoza set ¥1,180.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 日式飲茶 点心の気持ち、大阪市大正区三軒屋西1-2-11、工房併設の餃子レストラン、食べログ2024年餃子百名店選出、保存料無添加オールハンドメイド餃子、生地の練り上げから包む工程まですべてハンドメイド、機械化・効率化が進む時代に逆行するアナログな工程、冷凍餃子通販 (96個4,980円、24個1,980円、セール価格)、2021年2月のお知らせ: 餃子工房併設の餃子酒場を4月に大阪市大正区にオープン、国産食材のみ使用、嬬恋高原キャベツ。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Nama Gyoza Seizo Tokoro Tenshin no Kimochi、大正駅から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜24:00 (L.O. 料理23:00・ドリンク23:30)、年中無休、ランチ定食は14時まで、ご飯がなくなり次第終了、ランチの予約は11時の開店のみ、14時以降はワンドリンク制、カード・PayPay・au PAY可、44席 (カウンター12、テーブル34)、禁煙、貸切20〜50名、子ども可、キッズメニュー、英語メニュー、写真付きメニュー、テイクアウト、オープン2021年4月6日、餃子 百名店 2024、北海道産小麦 Haruyutaka 100%の皮、牡蠣と点心の宴会コース12品5,000円 (1月31日まで)。口コミ(2026年2月〜11月): 1皿2個で380〜580円、焼き餃子、水餃子、揚げ餃子、タルタルの揚げ餃子、胡麻だれの蒸し餃子、トリュフ餃子、海老餃子、にんにくなし、焼き餃子定食1,180円 (香菜のサラダ、スープ、zha caiとセロリのおかわり自由)、4種と ご飯1,720円、水餃子と焼き餃子の定食と中華風の chawanmushi、前菜の漬物 (pickled mustard greens)、台湾 mazesoba、飲み放題のコース2,000円から、店員さんが食べ方を説明、一度に出てきて冷めたという声、ワンドリンク制を後から知らされたという声、Kyocera Dome の近く。

osaka_rokukakutei_kuromon.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an omakase of battered and deep-fried kushiage, with homemade bread; the shop does not say its batter is wheat-free, and a September 2026 diner mentions rice-flour bread, not batter.
osaka_rokukakutei_kuromon.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog marks "vegetarian options" and the course comes with a vegetable platter, but the 20 skewers are mostly seafood and meat, and nothing is said about the batter, oil or sauces.
osaka_rokukakutei_kuromon.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday and over New Year (official site; Tabelog). Lunch ended in December 2022 (site news). Reservations online or by phone; a second seating from 20:30 lasts 90 minutes (Tabelog course page). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 60 seats including a counter; non-smoking; private hire for 20–60 (Tabelog; official site). Children welcome; children are charged only for what is eaten (Tabelog).
osaka_rokukakutei_kuromon.notes: [Kushiage · Kuromon Market, an omakase of 20 skewers with wine] A kushiage house upstairs in the Kuromon Market arcade, founded in 1980 and here since 1995, that serves only an omakase: about 20 skewers (¥10,800), from a live-killed kuruma prawn through seasonal pairings like tonburi with minced chicken, myoga with pork fillet and anago with makomo, each with its suggested salt or sauce. A light, crisp batter keeps people eating, vegetables come to dip between skewers, and just when you're full the rice-flour bread arrives. Skewers keep coming until you say stop. A sommelier pairs wine, a big part of the house's identity; one regular uses it as the benchmark for kushikatsu in Osaka. Finish with the pudding. Closed Wednesday; there is a Ginza branch. The name comes from a mentor's advice to cherish the "six senses".

roles: Kitchen unnamed; the company 株式会社 六覺燈 is led by representative director 水野幾郎 (official company page)
chef_bio.background: Per the company page: founded in Konohana-ku, Osaka, in November 1980; moved into Kuromon Market, Nipponbashi, in June 1995; incorporated as 株式会社 六覺燈 in September 1998; a Ginza shop opened in October 2004. A wine importer, 株式会社エイマーケット (A-MARKeT, founded 2012), is listed alongside. Site news: lunch ended December 2022; a 六覺燈カフェ opened in April 2024; a new brand, 燈のひとさじ, in 2026. A September 2026 reviewer also mentions a counter in the Daimaru Shinsaibashi food hall. Per the site, the name comes from a master's advice on entering the kitchen to value the "six senses": sight, hearing, smell, taste, touch and the cook's sense; "燈" is a vow not to let the first light go out. The site says the shop chose kushikatsu after studying many cuisines, because it goes with any drink and can take on any genre. Diners describe a friendly distance with the frying master at the counter (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Stick to the obvious": cleanliness, good ingredients, effort to please and enjoying the work are all taken as given (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kushiage of about 20 skewers; wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: "The combinations of ingredients are unique, such as tonburi with minced chicken, myoga with pork tenderloin, and anago with makomo mushrooms." — August 2026.
"Even when you think you're full, the light and crispy batter makes you want to keep going for just one more, and then another." — September 2026.
"Personally, I use the quality and price range of this restaurant as a benchmark to evaluate other kushikatsu places." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 六覺燈 黒門本店、串揚げ専門店、黒門市場のアーケードの中、1980年創業、全国の生産者から直送される旬の食材、メニュー表はなく全ておまかせのコース、苦手な食材は申し付けを、おまかせコース 活〆車海老をはじめとする創作串20本・お野菜盛合せ・自家製パン・自家製デザート・コーヒー 10,800円 (税込)、17時〜22時、年末年始・水曜日休み、60席、全席禁煙、カード可、手作りのパンとデザート、世界の銘醸地に自ら足を運んで仕入れたワイン。六覺燈について: 「六覚を大事にしろ」という親方の言葉 (視覚・聴覚・嗅覚・味覚・触覚と料理人のセンス)、初心を忘れず燈を消さない、「あたりまえにこだわる」、串かつはどんな飲み物とも相性が良い。会社概要: 株式会社 六覺燈、代表取締役 水野幾郎、1980年11月 大阪市此花区で創業、1995年6月 黒門市場内に移転、1998年9月 法人化、2004年10月 銀座店オープン、株式会社エイマーケット (ワイン輸入販売、代表取締役 水野冨貴子)。お知らせ: 2022年12月 ランチ営業終了、2024年4月 六覺燈カフェオープン、2026年10月 新ブランド「燈のひとさじ」、冬季休暇 2025年12月31日〜2026年1月7日。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本橋1-21-16 たこそうビル 2F、日本橋駅から徒歩3分、L.O.21:30、20時30分からの90分のコース、サービス料10%、ベジタリアンメニューありの表示、子どもは食べた分だけ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 車海老、牛ヒレ、帆立、edamame のコロッケ、トンブリと鶏のミンチ、茗荷と豚ヒレ、Anago と Makomo、Hamo、銀杏、鴨、Shiitake、鮭、キスと三つ葉、蓮根、チーズ、野菜は食べ放題、米粉のパンとベーグルにチーズクリーム、デザートは3種から、プリン、ストップと言うまで出てくる、串ごとに塩かソースをすすめる、ソースは一人ずつ、ワインとの組み合わせ、銀座と大丸心斎橋のフードホールにも店がある、軽い衣。

osaka_shinya_yakiniku_jiru_higashishinsa.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Meat comes with tare or salt (several cuts are offered salted), and the menu also has ramen, Shin Ramyeon, cold noodles and a meat pasta; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_shinya_yakiniku_jiru_higashishinsa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku menu of beef cuts and horumon, with egg soup and meat-based ramen; kimchi, namul and rice are the only plant dishes mentioned.
osaka_shinya_yakiniku_jiru_higashishinsa.hours_raw: Fri and Sat 23:00–04:00; closed Sunday to Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations by Instagram DM or phone (Tabelog); fully booked at 23:00 in March 2026, with walk-ins sometimes possible later in the night (2025–2026 reviews). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Prices shown without tax, plus a ¥300 table charge (November 2026 review). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Gas roasters at the table (October 2026 review).
osaka_shinya_yakiniku_jiru_higashishinsa.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Friday and Saturday after 23:00] When the hard-to-book yakiniku restaurant Pome closes for the night, the curtain changes and the same room reopens as Jiru, an à la carte horumon bar for the small hours, open only on Friday and Saturday from 23:00 to 04:00. Diners rate the quality as Pome's, without the course: black tongue, tsurami that one diner ordered three times, an outside skirt so tender it cuts with chopsticks, a horumon platter of tetchan, akasen, mino and more, then a spicy ramen loaded with horumon that some come for alone. Expect ¥5,000–10,000 a head in 2026, cash only, plus a ¥300 table charge. Book by Instagram DM or phone for 23:00; walk-ins sometimes find a seat later. Tabelog Yakiniku 100 in 2026.

roles: Run by the team of the yakiniku restaurant Pome (ぽめ), unnamed in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe Jiru as Pome's late-night second brand at the same premises, with only the noren changing (October 2026), "carrying on the DNA" of Pome (February 2026), and a place that has been "dedicated to horumon for many years" (June 2026). A June 2023 diner calls it Pome's 2nd branch, open only at weekends, and saw Pome's owner cooking behind the counter. A February 2026 diner notes the signatures of well-known diners lining the walls. Tabelog Yakiniku 100 in 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Horumon platter; black tongue; horumon spicy ramen.

Charge ¥800 a person, children included, built into course prices; private rooms for 2, 4 or 6 cost ¥3,300 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 26 seats at a long wooden counter, tables and private rooms; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; August 2026 review). osaka_sumibi_yakitori_mokkei_higashishin.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a basement of aged jidori] Down a flight of stairs off a Higashi-Shinsaibashi street is a calm, modern room with a long wooden counter in front of the charcoal, tables and private rooms, and jazz playing (2026). Three jidori breeds are aged whole at low temperature, broken down and skewered in house, and grilled over Kishu binchotan by a chef with 20 years of experience (September 2026 reviews). Book the 7 Assorted Yakitori course: small plates of confit breast, vinegared offal and chicken ham with figs, a consommé, homemade tofu, seven skewers with a choice of tsukune (truffle shaved at the table, or kumquat yolk), then a golden TKG under gold leaf and a chicken white soup. Reservation only, ¥7,500–7,800 for the course plus drinks. Tabelog Yakitori WEST 100 in 2023.

roles: Grill chef with 20 years of experience, unnamed (September 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "as much as possible by our own hands"; Miyazaki Jitokko, Niwa Jidori and Awa Oidori are aged one bird at a time at low temperature, broken down by hand and skewered, and grilled slowly over Kishu binchotan; mizutaki and sukiyaki are also served. Two September 2026 diners describe the skewers as grilled by a chef with 20 years of experience. An August 2026 group with a member who avoids raw food was given well-cooked alternatives. Opened 18 July 2017; Tabelog Yakitori WEST 100 in 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼鳥 木鶏 (Mokkei)、焼き鳥・水炊き、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-8-14 オーブナテビル B1F、長堀橋駅7番出口から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅5・6番出口から徒歩5分、毎日17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30、最終入店21:30)、年末年始休み、完全予約制、当日キャンセルは1名5,000円、チャージ料金1名 (子どもも) 税込800円でコースに含む、個室 (2・4・6名、室料3,300円)、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、26席、禁煙、2017年7月18日オープン、Miyazaki Jitokko、Niwa Jidori、Awa Oidori を1羽ずつ低温で熟成し、手でさばいて串打ち、Kishu binchotan でじっくり焼く、できる限り自分たちの手で、焼き鳥ショートコース6,500円 (12品)、焼き鳥7種盛りコース7,800円 (16品)、黄金鶏水炊きコース6,800円 (4時間炊いたスープ、自家製ポン酢)、黄金の TKG、オンラインショップ、焼き鳥 WEST 百名店 2023。口コミ(2026年6月〜11月): 7種盛りコース7,500円、鶏むね肉のコンフィ、酢モツとポン酢のジュレ、鶏ハムといちじく、鶏のコンソメ、Hokkaido の Toyomasari の自家製豆腐、つくねはタレ、金柑、チーズ、トリュフから選べる、金箔の TKG、鶏白湯、鶏刺し盛り合わせ、レバー刺し、20年の経験の職人が焼く、地下へ階段を下りる、木の長いカウンター、ジャズ、生が苦手な人には火を通した料理に替えてくれた。

osaka_craft_burger_co_kitahorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information, but every burger can be served on a salad plate instead of the bun (official menu). Fries, onion rings in beer batter, chicken bites and sauces are not described for gluten, and nothing is labelled gluten-free.
osaka_craft_burger_co_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu marks one burger vegetarian: the tofu steak burger of seasoned deep-fried tofu with a choice of ketchup, teriyaki, BBQ, chipotle or peanut butter (official menu). osaka_craft_burger_co_kitahorie.notes: [Burgers · Kita-Horie by Yotsubashi Stn] A small burger shop with a terrace, half a minute from Yotsubashi Station, opened in 2015 by an Australian owner and a Japanese co-owner, a married couple. The patty is 100% domestic beef, ground in the shop every day and shaped by hand, the sauces are made in house, and each burger tastes different by design. Get the Craft Burger Deluxe with bacon, avocado and cheddar (¥1,990 in 2026), or a smaller petit size; every burger comes with fries, onion rings, salad or soup, and can be served on a salad instead of the bun. There is a tofu steak burger marked vegetarian. A lunch set was ¥1,390 in August 2026. Drink a Minoh Beer on the terrace. Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2019, 2021, 2022 and 2024.

chef_bio.chef_name: パット アゴスティネリ
roles: Owner (Kansai Walker 2018)
Co-owner: 美希, married to the owner (Kansai Walker 2018)
chef_bio.background: Per Kansai Walker (2018): the owner パット アゴスティネリ came to Japan from Australia at 30 to change course in life and taught English for seven years; the co-owner 美希 had worked part-time in cafés, McDonald's and びっくりドンキー before a staff job at a civil-engineering firm. The two met at a friend's bar in Higashi-Shinsaibashi and married. After a plan to co-run a relative's friend's burger shop fell through, the couple opened Craft Burger co. on 11 November 2015, aiming to change the image of burgers in Japan with an original, healthier menu; the "co." was a hope of becoming a company, realised as a godo kaisha in January 2018. A second shop opened in Dojima on 18 June 2018. A TV feature and English comments on Google Maps brought overseas visitors (Kansai Walker). Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2019, 2021, 2022 and 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Our burgers are not like an ordinary burger shop's: buns, sauces and meat are all handmade, so we are the same as a restaurant" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Craft Burger Deluxe; hand-shaped 100% domestic beef patties.

osaka_steak_wine_oxon_nishishinsaibashi.notes: [Teppanyaki · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, a 1974 steak house with a salon below] Behind a heavy door north of Namba is a steak house from 1974 furnished with Art Nouveau antiques, stained glass and lamps, where chefs grill A5 Kobe heifer beef and live seafood on the teppan in front of you, with a paper apron at your place. After the garlic rice you are led downstairs to a salon of antiques for homemade cakes and siphon coffee, and on some evenings a classical concert there (October 2025, February and July 2026). The owner, a woman, looks after the room in person and chats with guests (2026 reviews). Dinner courses cost ¥23,000–29,600 (Tabelog), while lunch averages ¥4,000–4,999 (Tabelog). Book by phone; closed Sundays. Tabelog Steak 100 in 2021.

roles: Owner, a woman, unnamed in the sources read (2026 reviews)
Teppanyaki chefs, unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a steak house founded in 1974 in Osaka Minami, with seasonal starters, soups and vegetables made by experienced chefs, Art Nouveau antiques, a basement salon for desserts and digestifs, its own balsamic vinegar and a rooftop garden; past events include a special dinner by the executive chef of the Imperial Hotel in Vienna and wine evenings with a former president of the Japan Sommelier Association, and the menu carried contributions by the writers 藤本義一 and 桐島洋子. The house holds OXON concerts (オクソン音楽会). Reviews from February, March and May 2026 describe the female owner looking after guests in person; a May 2026 diner repeats a saying attributed to Shigeo Nagashima, "the mountain is Fuji, and the meat is Oxon". The 2F of the building houses the sister restaurant なにわ懐石しゃぶしゃぶ 久壷庵 (official site). Tabelog Steak 100 in 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients brought out by the skill of experienced chefs, in pursuit of the real taste (official site, translated).

osaka_rantei_lucua_barchika.notes: [Chinese · Umeda, creative Chinese under Osaka Station] A branch of Rantei, an Osaka group of seven Chinese restaurants whose first shop is on Tabelog's Top 100 list (Tabelog), opened in April 2026 on the Barchika food floor two levels under Lucua, a minute from the JR gates. The group builds its menu on creative Chinese cooking matched with wine. Most people come for the sweet-and-sour pork, fried Kagoshima pork with the sauce poured on afterwards and buried in green onion, which more than half of lunch customers order (official site), or for the Taiwan ramen, the group's signature since its first shop: thin noodles in a chilli-laden soup of minced pork with garlic and doubanjiang. Lunch sets come with refills of rice and soup, and you can pick the heat and the numbing of the mapo noodles. Diners found the mapo tofu good, the shrimp in mayonnaise bouncy, and one sweet-and-sour pork over-fried (September–October 2026). Only this shop serves an afternoon tea of six Chinese sweets, panda buns among them, with a pot of tea for ¥1,980.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 蘭亭、【創作中華×世界のワイン】がコンセプト、各店の料理長とソムリエが試作を重ねる、蘭亭特製酢豚は赤ワインにも白ワインにも合う、旬の食材、日本では珍しい現地の食材、本場の調理法、QSCH。店舗は谷九本店、本町店、茶屋町店、上一店、南本町店、ルクアバルチカ店、近鉄上本町店。ルクアバルチカ店: 大阪市北区梅田3-1-3 ルクア大阪 バルチカ B2F、全日11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、不定休、テーブル34席、カウンター14席、限定メニュー (黒酢角煮酢豚定食、前菜5種盛り合わせ、アフタヌーンティーセット)。一品料理 (税込、店舗により異なる): 蘭亭特製酢豚 (8個) 1,870円 (鹿児島産もち豚の唐揚げ、タレは後がけ、青ネギ)、台湾ラーメン1,320円 (創業当初からの看板、豚挽き肉をにんにくと豆板醤で炒めて煮立てたスープ)、前菜3種盛り1,980円、大エビのマヨネーズソース1,870円、レタス入りカニチャーハン1,650円、黒酢酢豚1,650円、酸辣湯1,100円、杏仁豆腐605円。お昼の定食: 白ごはん・お漬物・スープ・サラダつき、ごはんとスープはおかわり自由、特製酢豚定食はダントツの1番人気、蘭亭定食 (酢豚、台湾ラーメン、五目チャーハン)。食べログ (店舗会員): 中華・居酒屋・ラーメン、JR 大阪駅から徒歩1分、本店は食べログ百名店、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、48席、禁煙、2026年4月23日オープン、8品のコース4,000円、飲み放題つき5,500円、アフタヌーンティー1,980円。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 台湾ラーメン1,430円、細い香港麺、唐辛子たっぷり、鶏皮の揚げ物のお通し、麻婆麺定食1,580円は辛さとしびれを選べる、麻婆豆腐定食、焼いた gyoza と takana の漬物、エビマヨ、特製チャーハン、パンダまんじゅうのアフタヌーンティー。

Opened 31 July 2024, the first Kansai shop (Tabelog; official site).
osaka_xiringuito_escriba_osaka.notes: [Spanish · Umeda, Barcelona paella at Osaka Station] The Japanese outpost of a Barcelona beach restaurant, opened on the Olympic year of 1992 by Joan Escribà and known locally for the city's best paella, came to Kansai in July 2024 on the third floor of Innogate Osaka, straight off the west exit of the station. A bright, beach-house room of 82 seats serves about five paellas, cooked 17 minutes over a direct flame: the house Escribà paella of shrimp, mussels and clams, with crisp rice at the bottom of the pan, and a squid-ink fideuà made with short pasta, both favourites in 2026 reviews. Start with the "Airbag", crisp bread under prosciutto that you smash with a hammer, and garlic shrimp. The seven-dish XIRINGUITO course is ¥4,800 at lunch or dinner; finish with the fruit roll cake. One October 2026 diner found the portions small. Book ahead: one diner found it full and booked a week out the next time (October 2026).

Joan Escribà also owns the beach club Guingueta Escribà and the modern Spanish restaurant La Picanteria, and is owner-chef and chocolatier of Escribà. chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: XIRINGUITO Escribà (チリンギート エスクリバ)、バルセロナで一番おいしいパエリアを提供、7月31日に関西初出店、1992年にスペイン・バルセロナにオープン、25年以上地元の人に愛されるシーフードレストラン、オーナー兼エグゼクティブシェフのジョアン エスクリバはバルセロナ生まれ、オリンピックの1992年に地中海沿いに開店、ビーチクラブ Guingueta Escribà とモダンスペイン料理店 La Picanteria のオーナー、エスクリバのオーナーシェフでショコラティエ。メニュー: エスクリバパエリア (エビ、ムール貝、アサリ、白身魚、木のスプーンで)、イカスミのフィデウア (パスタで作るパエリア、アリオリソース)、"エアバッグ" 生ハムスライスとクリスピーブレッド、カヴァ・白ワイン・赤ワインのサングリア。食べログ (店舗会員): スペイン料理・海鮮、大阪市北区梅田3-2-123 イノゲート大阪 バルチカ03エキウエ 3F、大阪駅西口直結、月〜金11:00〜15:30、17:00〜23:00、土・日・祝11:00〜23:00、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、82席、禁煙、子ども可、2024年7月31日オープン、直火で17分のパエリア、海の家のような内装、数量限定のフルーツロールケーキ、XIRINGUITO コース7品4,800円、月〜木の2時間飲み放題つきコース6品7,000円・8品8,500円。口コミ(2026年10月): パエリアは約5種と日替わり、イカスミがおすすめ、底のおこげ、キノコのサラダとチーズ、ミートボールの煮込み、ガーリックシュリンプ、エアバッグはハンマーで割る、小さいサイズのパエリア、イチジクのロールケーキ、バスクチーズケーキ、イカスミのショートパスタ、飲み放題つきで1人約7,900円、量が少ないという声も、ベビーカーで来店、ポテトにディルソース。

osaka_xex_west_an_umeda.notes: [Sushi · Nishi-Umeda, the Japanese room of XEX WEST] The Japanese room of XEX WEST, a floor at the top of Herbis PLAZA ENT that puts an Italian restaurant, a bar and this sushi and tempura counter side by side (Tabelog). At lunch most people book a plan: a tempura set followed by a seasonal fruit dessert buffet, or eight nigiri with seasonal starters; at night it is counter sushi à la carte or a Japanese course with wagyu and matsutake in autumn. Diners in 2026 praised the service more than anything: the chef asks about likes and dislikes, talks with the counter and places each piece on the side of the hand you eat with. The squid and horse mackerel stand out (May 2026). One August 2026 diner was splashed by water from the fish sink and found the apology curt. Dinner adds a ¥580 seat charge and 10% service; dinner is for school-age children and up.

April to December open every day, with a tent for rain; January to March closed Mondays; closed 1–3 January with the building; may close for typhoons or heavy rain (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; around 19:00 in beer-garden season is crowded, so book before 18:45 or after 19:15; 10% off courses starting before 17:00 (Tabelog). Children welcome, kids' menu; menu in English, Chinese and Korean (Tabelog). Access: in Osaka Ekimae Dai-1 Building take the lift on the Nishi-Umeda Station side (right) of the central lift hall to R (13F); the left lifts stop at 12F (Tabelog). Opened 17 June 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_umeda_icchome_sky_beer.notes: [BBQ beer garden · Umeda, on the roof of the station buildings] A beer garden on the roof of Osaka Ekimae Dai-1 Building, opened in June 2025 and built as a Showa-retro street of stalls: lanterns light up at dusk, the official site likens the mood to Taiwan's Jiufen, and an Inari shrine sits on the roof. Under an all-weather tent, groups grill set courses of pork, wagyu, lamb, seafood and vegetables on gas grills, with two hours of all-you-can-drink from eight draft beers you pour yourself at the push of a button, highballs made on the whisky you pick, and in winter 47 shochu from every prefecture. Diners liked the drinks and the city view at dusk; several found the meat portions on the cheaper courses small (September and October 2026), and on a rainy night one corner got wet. Courses run ¥5,800–10,000, 10% off before 17:00. Take the right-hand lifts to the roof.

roles: Manager and staff (unnamed)

The Tabelog invoice number T4120001274503 is registered to ジョナサン・フーズ株式会社 at 梅田1-3-1 (NTA invoice register). Opened 17 June 2025 (Tabelog).

osaka_osakana_ya_okapi_umeda.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Umeda, Osaka Station Building No. 4 B2F] A small seafood bar in the basement of Osaka Station Building No. 4, a minute from Higashi-Umeda, run directly by a fish wholesaler from the central market, with fish delivered each morning. At lunch it sells seafood bowls for ¥900–1,000 with a fish-broth miso soup that diners single out; one regular on a ninth visit still calls the price remarkable (October 2026), and the limited tuna bowl goes early. From mid-afternoon at weekends and in the evening it is a drinking spot: thick-cut sashimi platters, palm-sized oysters, namerou, hamo and anago tempura and grilled eel, with shochu and a Maru F draft. Twelve counter seats suit solo diners; smoking is allowed. One August 2026 diner found the food slow to come, and one September 2026 diner found the seats cramped and the service cool.

osaka_tempura_kisaka_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses mix seafood (shrimp, kisu, hamo, anago, abalone, caviar) with vegetables, and finish with a dashi-based tempura chazuke or a rice bowl.
osaka_tempura_kisaka_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 21:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Lunch is cash only (Tabelog; October 2026); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) at dinner; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). osaka_tempura_kisaka_kitashinchi.notes: [Tempura · Kitashinchi, a seventh-floor counter] A tempura counter on the seventh floor of a building at the west entrance of Kitashinchi's main street, near the Sakurabashi crossing. The shop chooses seasonal vegetables with a vegetable sommelier, fries in two oils, and keeps shrimp alive in a tank; the chef dusts each piece with a brush. Courses run ¥8,800–14,300 at dinner, through shrimp, kisu, hamo and abalone to sweet potato and figs, and end with a tempura rice bowl or tempura chazuke whose dashi a third-time diner calls exquisite (October 2026). Lunch is the bargain: a ¥1,200 tendon built from eight pieces you choose, or an abalone tendon for ¥3,500, cash only. With a small kitchen team, food can take a while; allow time. One September 2026 diner noticed a cloth smell on the rice bowl. Staff walked one diner to the lift (October 2026).

Opened 14 July 2014 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_nakagawa_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, a sake-loving sushi counter] An eight-seat sushi counter with private rooms, three floors up in Kitashinchi, serving one course of fish from ports across Japan: seasonal vegetables, thick-cut sashimi, a grilled dish, Edomae nigiri and a shrimp-rich red miso soup, on rice from Yae Hara in Nagano seasoned without sugar. Diners remember the sashimi above all, and a November 2025 course ended with a bowl of raw sakura shrimp and sea urchin. The chef seeks out sake breweries and wine makers for pairings and is fond of Daishinshu sake. Diners describe a warm, entertaining chef, who per an August 2026 diner has ties to surfers and joins beach clean-ups; tell the staff your budget and dishes and drinks are suggested to fit it (January 2025). The course is ¥22,000; with drinks expect ¥20,000–26,000. Book ahead: a September 2026 weekday was full. Private rooms suit business dinners.

osaka_sushi_tiger_osaka_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, a Vietnamese sushi brand comes to Japan] The first Japanese branch of Sushi Tiger, a sushi brand from Vietnam, opened in Kitashinchi on 21 September 2026. It keeps Edomae technique and red-vinegar rice, mixed live at the counter, but tops the nigiri with ideas from abroad: chutoro with truffle cheese, black wagyu, oyster, anago tempura. Dinner courses run ¥4,950–7,150 for 8–12 pieces, with sushi-bar showmanship; a ¥3,300 add-on brings a sake pairing and free-flowing drinks. Lunch brings a ¥1,000 seafood yukke bowl or a sushi set. In its first month the room was mostly overseas guests, with staff interpreting (October 2026). Most diners loved the fun; a traditionalist missed plain fish with soy sauce, and another was not keen on the rice. No lunch on Fridays.

osaka_furafura_nishinakajima.notes: [Yakitori · Nishinakajima, a charcoal counter since 2003] A small yakitori izakaya a few minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, open since 2003, with a ten-seat counter and a tatami room at the back. The shop says its chef cooks with skills from the hotel trade, and one diner heard the chef was once an Italian cook (March 2026), which may explain the mustard and mayonnaise on the skewer plate. The chicken comes from Fukuchiyama, ground the same morning. The usual order is the "Horo-yoi Set" (two diners order it every visit): a starter that changes daily (cold shabu with ume dressing in March 2026, a mochi gratin in January), five omakase skewers and a drink for about ¥1,200–1,500, with a negima so packed there is no place left to hold the skewer. The homemade tofu is a specialty. At lunch, charcoal smoke out front draws office workers in for a yakitori rice bowl (¥700 in June 2026) or a chicken steak set (¥850), and the counter fills by noon. Smoking is allowed. Closed Sundays.

A March 2026 diner heard the chef "used to be an Italian chef". December 2025: the owner and one young staff member ran lunch; March 2026: the chef and two staff. Opened 1 September 2003 (Tabelog).

osaka_enishina_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Sun and holidays 17:00–01:00; Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–03:00; closed Wednesday; other closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥290 (Tabelog's original text: チャージ料290円（税込）). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter (up to 10) and terrace seats; whole-shop hire up to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog), at your seat too (July 2026); English menu (Tabelog). osaka_enishina_nishinakajima.notes: [Chicken yakiniku · Nishinakajima, a late-night counter] An eight-seat counter in a drinking street near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, with Showa-retro tiles and a few terrace seats, where you grill chicken yourself and dip it in a homemade miso sauce worked out from the chicken-and-miso grills of Matsusaka in Mie (Tabelog; August 2024). It opened in September 2021 as a counter beef yakiniku (November 2021) and had turned to chicken by July 2024. Order cuts at ¥550 each (March 2026), from tender young chicken to chewy old hen, a whole heart and a liver seared rare; the portions are big. The all-you-can-drink course, with chicken sashimi, a grilled platter, wings and cold noodles, is ¥3,780 on Tabelog. Open till 1 am, and till 3 am on Friday and Saturday; one diner came in at midnight for a solo grill and seaweed soup (June 2026). One diner found the owner a little curt at first (March 2025); another found owner and staff very friendly (June 2026). Smoking is allowed. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed) and counter staff

A November 2021 diner described it as the counter yakiniku "Enishina", opened in September 2021 on the former site of the counter sukiyaki restaurant "Mitsumaru", lunch only at first and dinner from October 2021. An August 2024 diner wrote that the miso sauce "was crafted by researching flavors from a Matsusaka restaurant" and that the shop had shifted from a yakiniku format; a March 2025 diner, that it "used to be a beef-centric yakiniku restaurant".
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken yakiniku with homemade miso sauce; all-you-can-drink chicken course.

"I tried to order everything listed on the menu, but was advised that the portions are quite generous." — March 2026.

osaka_tsuta_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The yakitori come with a homemade sweet-savoury sauce or salt, the chicken sashimi is eaten with sweet Kyushu soy sauce, and kara-age, fried taro and truffle fries are on the menu; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_tsuta_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken grill with chicken sashimi; nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_tsuta_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–13:00 and 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun, holidays and the days before and after a holiday 17:00–23:00; last order 22:00; hours may be extended or changed without notice depending on stock; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Lunch paused for a while and came back by March 2026, when a reviewer gave the lunch hours as 11:30–14:00, unlike Tabelog. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 25 seats at the counter, on sofas and on tatami; hire up to 20; heated tobacco only, at a designated ashtray; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, kids menu; takeaway (Tabelog). Opened 30 June 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_tsuta_higashimikuni.notes: [Yakitori · Higashimikuni, a charcoal grill behind glass] A roomy yakitori restaurant near Higashimikuni Station, seven minutes' walk from JR Shin-Osaka, opened in June 2023, with counter seats facing a charcoal grill behind glass, sofas and a tatami room, so it works for families as well as after-work drinks. The shop grills fresh domestic chicken with a homemade sweet-savoury sauce, and the tsukune is the house favourite: fluffy and as big as a rice ball, with a truffle version too. Chicken sashimi comes as a five-kind platter with sweet Kyushu soy sauce. Diners praise the sake list and draft Sapporo Black Label, and one regular keeps the bill under ¥4,000 a head even after eating and drinking a lot (October 2026). Weekday lunch is back since March 2026 with ¥1,000 rice bowls, but one person was running it alone in March and May 2026, and a May 2026 diner waited 39 minutes; go early if you are short of time.

osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kotetsu_nishinakaj.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakitori with sauces and seasonings not described, plus tempura (maitake, broccoli, chicken), fried dishes, chicken nanban, ramen and noodles to finish a hot pot.
osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kotetsu_nishinakaj.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant; the finishing rice and soup are made with chicken soup (Tabelog). The cabbage starter comes with miso, but no vegan dish is named.
osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kotetsu_nishinakaj.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–24:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog) and in practice needed: groups without a booking were turned away in August and September 2026, and a weekday at 18:00 was almost full (September 2026); a Saturday at opening was quiet because the nearby offices are closed (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 14 at tables; no private rooms; whole-shop hire possible; smoking allowed at every seat (Tabelog; September 2026). The chicken-soup rice takes about 20 minutes, so order it early (September 2026).
osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kotetsu_nishinakaj.notes: [Yakitori · Nishinakajima, a binchotan counter among offices] A 20-seat yakitori shop behind wooden doors in the office blocks between Shin-Osaka and Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since about 2018 and full most weeknights, often with office parties. The chicken is Daisen jidori over Kishu binchotan, with jazz playing because the owner thought it "fits the ambiance" (September 2026). Skewers come one at a time, in order: sasami with wasabi or plum, neck, heart, gizzard, thigh, tsukune, about ¥260–290 each (2026). Around them, more than a yakitori shop needs: chicken sashimi and namero, a fish of the day, broccoli and maitake tempura, sasami cheese nanban, and a kamameshi cooked in chicken soup to finish (it takes 20 minutes, so order it first). A weekday visit means booking ahead; a Saturday is calmer. Every seat is smoking.

Lunch set meals cannot be booked; book for the lunch all-you-can-eat course (Tabelog). Often a line at lunch (August 2026) and packed on a Friday night without a booking (October 2026). osaka_chinese_komandou_nishinakajima.notes: [Chinese · Nishinakajima, a local Chinese canteen] A 48-seat Chinese restaurant on a side street between Shin-Osaka and Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2019, with an eye-catching front and a staff from China, quick and friendly (2025). At lunch it fills up for set meals around ¥800, a mapo hot pot set or shark-fin-sauce fried rice, with fried rice or a mini ramen for ¥100 more; dishes come in about four minutes (March 2025). In the evening it turns into a banquet hall: a two-hour all-you-can-order buffet of 50 dishes with drinks for ¥3,800, booked out on Fridays (October 2026), or small plates like Cantonese steamed chicken (¥450) and Peking duck (¥1,980). Flavours run mild to fiery; one diner found the spicy beef stir-fry hot even for a chilli lover (September 2026). Smoking is allowed at the tables; one diner who dislikes smoke booked 17:30 on a Sunday (October 2026).

osaka_ore_tachi_no_tako_beya_nishinakaji.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Tacos come on yellow or blue masa tortillas (July 2026), but the "premium tacos" use a fried tortilla of unstated make, and quesadillas, a Mexican dog, nachos and taco rice are also on the menu.
osaka_ore_tachi_no_tako_beya_nishinakaji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tacos with meat, sausages, mozzarella quesadillas and taco rice; no vegan dish is named.
osaka_ore_tachi_no_tako_beya_nishinakaji.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–05:00 (last order 04:30); Sat 18:00–03:00 (last order 02:30); Sun and holidays 18:00–01:00 (last order 00:30), with some food and drinks limited; lunch in November 2026 on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday 11:30–14:00, not on holidays, until sold out; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). The official site gives "18:00～LAST". Lunch was fully booked by office workers on a March 2026 day. Reservations accepted; parties of three or fewer should consult the bar before booking a table (Tabelog). Table charge ¥500 a head (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payment (Tabelog). 16 seats, parties up to 18; private rooms for 7–20 on the 3rd floor, over 30 with the 2nd floor; smoking allowed (Tabelog). English menu and photo menu (Tabelog). Takeaway tacos (January 2026). Opened 1 October 2011; moved here from 1-9-7 Higashinakajima, Higashiyodogawa-ku (Tabelog).
osaka_ore_tachi_no_tako_beya_nishinakaji.notes: [Mexican · Nishinakajima, a late-night taco and tequila bar] A second-floor bar off Shin-Midosuji, north of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, serving tacos and Mexican spirits since 2011; the owner is a certified Tequila Maestro and Mezcalero who explains the bottles well, and the back bar holds over 600 Mexican spirits (Tabelog; July 2026). An August 2025 diner wrote that it is known as the best tequila bar in western Japan. The food holds its own: "premium tacos" on a fried, slightly sweet tortilla, a taco set on yellow or blue masa, mozzarella quesadillas and taco rice, in portions people call large (March 2026), with mild spice you adjust with hot sauce. It stays open until 5 a.m. on weekdays, so it doubles as a last stop, and runs a weekday lunch Tuesday to Thursday. English menu; ¥500 table charge; smoking allowed.

roles: Owner (unnamed): a certified Tequila Maestro (Tabelog) and Mezcalero (July 2026 review)
Bar staff, with a manager reviewers call very funny (August 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a casual Mexican bar of tacos, developed through "extensive research", and over 600 Mexican spirits chosen by the owner, a certified Tequila Maestro; opened 1 October 2011 and moved here from 1-9-7 Higashinakajima, Higashiyodogawa-ku. Per a July 2026 review: "Established in 2011, it has become quite a well-known spot for tacos"; the owner is "certified as a Tequila Maestro and Mezcalero" and explains the drinks well. Per an August 2025 review: "known as the number one tequila bar in Western Japan"; "The manager is incredibly entertaining, and the staff are wonderful."
chef_bio.specialty: Premium tacos; tequila and mezcal.

anecdotes.text: "The owner is certified as a Tequila Maestro and Mezcalero, and [gives] excellent explanations about the drinks." — July 2026.

"It seems to be popular among office workers, as it was fully booked during lunch hours." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: オレ達のタコ部屋、営業時間18:00〜LAST、50種類以上のドリンク、テキーラ、おすすめ No.1 プレミアムタコス、No.2 オレタコのタコライス、No.3 モッツァレラチーズたっぷりのケサディージャ。食べログ (店舗会員): メキシコ料理・バー・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島5-8-8 新大阪京和ビル 2F、西中島南方駅から徒歩約5分、月〜金18:00〜翌5:00、土18:00〜翌3:00、日・祝18:00〜翌1:00、11月のランチは火・水・木11:30〜14:00 (祝日を除く、売り切れまで)、不定休、予約可、3名以下のテーブルは事前に相談、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、16席、3階に7〜20名の個室、2階とあわせて30名以上の貸切、喫煙可、英語メニュー、写真つきメニュー、2011年10月1日オープン、Higashinakajima 1-9-7, Higashiyodogawa-ku から移転、オーナーは Tequila Maestro、600種以上のメキシコのお酒、10月から深夜のタコス、2時間飲み放題の宴会プラン5,000円・6,000円、二次会プラン4,500円 (税込)。口コミ(2025年8月〜2026年10月): Shin-Midosuji からすぐのビルの2階、2011年創業、オーナーは Tequila Maestro と Mezcalero、トルティーヤチップス、モッツァレラのケサディージャ、黄色と青のトルティーヤを選べるタコスのセット、揚げたトルティーヤのプレミアムタコス、Mexican dog、タコライス、量が多い、ホットソースで辛さを調整、昼は会社員で満席、テーブルチャージ500円、階段の奥の扉はトイレ、コーヒーとテキーラのカクテル、テイクアウトのタコス。

osaka_bella_locanda_italiana_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Pasta, pizza, focaccia, breads, scones and cakes run through every meal; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_bella_locanda_italiana_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog ticks "vegan options" and "vegetarian options", and the October 2026 lunch buffet had a large salad bar and chili con carne made with soy meat, but no dish is described as vegan; the soups (corn potage, minestrone) and dressings are not described.
osaka_bella_locanda_italiana_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–21:30 (last order 21:00) (Tabelog). The hotel restaurant also serves breakfast (Tabelog feature list; an October 2026 review: "serving meals from breakfast to dinner"). Cake set 14:00–17:30 (October 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); one October 2026 family dinner found the room empty. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and e-money; no QR payment (Tabelog). 60 seats; whole-room hire for 20 to over 50; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; parking for vehicles under 1.5 m tall (Tabelog), too low for one family's SUV (October 2026). English menu and English-speaking staff; sommelier; children welcome, kids' menu (Tabelog). Free hotel shuttle bus from Shin-Osaka Stn (July and October 2026), about every 20 minutes, with nine seats (October 2026). Opened 22 December 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_bella_locanda_italiana_shin_osaka.notes: [Italian · Shin-Osaka, a hotel restaurant with afternoon tea] The ground-floor restaurant of the Holiday Inn & Suites Shin-Osaka, opened in December 2025 in a bright, high-ceilinged room ten minutes' walk from the station, with a free shuttle bus. Three things draw people: a ¥2,000 half-buffet lunch, a main pasta or meat with a big salad bar, pizza and breads (featured on a TV show in October 2026); seasonal afternoon teas at ¥5,500, grape then chestnut in autumn 2026, built around a "melty tiramisu" and made from scratch in the hotel kitchen, with sweetness kept low; and a ¥1,300 cake set from the showcase. Dinner is Italian courses with free-flow drinks and a T-bone steak. Most diners loved it; one family found an empty room, small portions and a single server at dinner (October 2026). English menu and English-speaking staff.

roles: Hotel kitchen: a chef (a woman, per an October 2026 review) and a pastry chef (unnamed)
Sommelier (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: the Italian restaurant of the Holiday Inn & Suites Shin-Osaka, opened 22 December 2025, serving a vegetable lunch buffet, seasonal afternoon tea, cakes and baked goods to take away, and Italian dinners. chef_bio.specialty: Half-buffet lunch; seasonal afternoon tea with melty tiramisu.

"The female chef makes everything from scratch without relying on pre-made products." — October 2026, the grape afternoon tea.
"The staff member was managing the floor alone and seemed overwhelmed, but [was] very pleasant." — October 2026, a family steak dinner.
