osaka_sushi_minato_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Course dishes include fish grilled with tamamiso or miso, simmered clam and anago, and nigiri, which are usually finished with soy sauce or a glaze containing wheat.
osaka_sushi_minato_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omakase courses of fish and shellfish, with dashi-simmered side dishes.
osaka_sushi_minato_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch course Tuesday–Saturday by reservation only, booked by 21:00 the day before (Tabelog). Same-day bookings after 15:00 by phone (Tabelog). A service charge is added (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: 6 at the counter and a private room for 4; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; school-age children welcome; takeout (Tabelog). Opened 3 March 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_minato_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, a ten-seat omakase] A small sushi bar up the stairs of an unassuming Kitashinchi building, with six counter seats and a private room for four, run by the group behind the 心屋 seafood restaurants. The draw is price: a ¥10,000 omakase in Kitashinchi that diners call remarkable value, mixing seasonal side dishes (a chilled corn chawanmushi in July, raw and grilled sanma in September) with about a dozen nigiri on firm red-vinegar rice, from squid with sea urchin to a toro-taku hand roll, and the chef's own hojicha ice cream. A ¥5,000 lunch with ten nigiri runs Tuesday to Saturday by reservation. A July 2026 diner found the staff young and friendly, September diners a warm chef; one noted in September 2026 that the chef had changed to a younger one. Extra orders are limited to what the course used (July 2026).

roles: Sushi chef (unnamed; changed by September 2026, per a review)

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): skilled chefs, the finest ingredients and carefully prepared rice; a counter to watch the chef and private rooms. Opened 3 March 2025. Reviews: "All the staff are young and friendly. The sushi chef is also young but very skilled" (July 2026); "The chef who specializes in aged sushi had changed, and now there's a younger chef" (September 2026); "the chef's warm personality" (September 2026); desserts "handmade by the chef" (September 2026), though a July 2026 diner was served "a pre-packaged item".
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients and carefully prepared rice (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: ¥10,000 omakase; hojicha ice cream.

"While you can place additional orders after finishing the course, the options are limited to what was served in the course" — July 2026.

osaka_oriyouri_ueno_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature dishes are sandwiches (mackerel, and a wagyu katsu sandwich with demi-glace); Inaniwa udon appears in autumn (October 2025); grilled fish and sashimi are usually served with soy-based seasoning.
osaka_oriyouri_ueno_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sake restaurant (sashimi, charcoal-grilled fish, clams, crab, wagyu); vegetable dishes such as water eggplant also appear (June 2026).
osaka_oriyouri_ueno_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00, last order 22:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations recommended: fully booked on a weekday in December 2025, though half the tables had emptied by 20:00. Same-day cancellation fee: 100% of the course, or ¥5,500 a person for à la carte bookings; tables for two may be moved to the counter (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter and two tables for four; non-smoking, ashtray by the lift; no children; no strong perfume; Japanese menu only; takeout (Tabelog). Opened 27 October 2016 (Tabelog).
osaka_oriyouri_ueno_kitashinchi.notes: [Japanese · Kitashinchi, fish and sake on the third floor] A fifteen-seat restaurant for seasonal fish and rare sake on Eirakucho Street in Kitashinchi, with a seven-seat counter and sofa tables. Order a course or à la carte: sashimi platters, fish grilled over charcoal (nodoguro, kinki, natural kue), seasonal dishes like matsutake and sanma rolls or seiko crab in winter, and the house signatures, a mackerel sandwich and a black-wagyu katsu sandwich cooked rare with demi-glace, which you can take home if you cannot finish. There is a menu just for sake, served in handsome sake ware. It is expensive (¥20,000–30,000 a head is common) and popular for business dinners; book ahead. Japanese menu only, no children, and go easy on perfume in the small room.

roles: Owner (unnamed; "friendly", June 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): high-class Japanese cuisine; seasonal fish as sashimi or grilled over charcoal; the mackerel sandwich and the cutlet sandwich as signature dishes "known for their beautiful cross-sections"; rare Japanese sake and selected wines; eye-catching tableware. Opened 27 October 2016.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal fish and vegetables in refined dishes, with carefully chosen sake (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Black-wagyu katsu sandwich; mackerel sandwich; charcoal-grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: "The perfect rare doneness and the juicy, luxurious meat paired with the demi-glace sauce were simply amazing!!" — July 2025, the katsu sandwich in a ¥19,800 omakase.
"I was intrigued by a unique dish, the Kazunoko Potato Salad, which had a rich dashi flavor, making it a wonderfully Japanese-style potato salad" — July 2025, a third visit.
"The appetizer of surf clam was incredibly delicious and left a strong impression. It was refreshing with a nice hint of shiso." — June 2026.

osaka_bene_umeda_nu_chayamachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu centres on Chicago pizza, pasta, French toast, bruschetta, baguette for the fondue and cheese tastings, and cheesecakes.
osaka_bene_umeda_nu_chayamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: a cheese and raw-honey specialist, with cheese and honey through most dishes. Tabelog shows a vegetarian-options flag.
osaka_bene_umeda_nu_chayamachi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00; last order 21:00; closed when NU Chayamachi closes (Tabelog). Reservations recommended: a queue formed two minutes after the 11:00 opening on an October 2026 weekday. Diners booked for seats only order from the menu on the day (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), iD, QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). 44 seats with semi-private rooms for 3–4 and 5–8; whole-floor hire 30–67 with sound and projector; non-smoking, smoking area on the floor; children welcome, no children's menu or chairs, strollers fine (Tabelog). Opened 20 June 2012 (Tabelog).
osaka_bene_umeda_nu_chayamachi.notes: [Italian · Chayamachi, a cheese-and-honey café] A bright café-style Italian restaurant on the ninth floor of NU Chayamachi, by the Hankyu station, built around more than twenty cheeses and a range of raw honeys: drizzle the honey over the Chicago pizza, whose cheese floods out when cut, or over cheesecake. Cheese fondue for dipping vegetables and baguette, Camembert ajillo and burrata fill out the menu, and at lunch an add-on brings unlimited tastings of eight cheeses and three honeys. Prices are moderate: lunch sets from about ¥1,850, dinner courses from ¥3,500. Popular for girls' nights and birthdays, with semi-private rooms; one October 2026 weekday a queue formed minutes after opening. Some diners found the Chicago pizza hard to cut or the cheese cooled, and dessert slow to come.

roles: Kitchen and staff (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog; official site): a cheese-specialist Italian with over 20 cheeses, fresh and aged, mostly Japanese and European, and raw honey; Chicago pizza and cheese fondue are the popular dishes; many drinks made with raw honey. Opened 20 June 2012.
chef_bio.philosophy: The salt of cheese with the sweetness of raw honey (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicago pizza with raw honey; cheese fondue.

"I ordered the Quattro Formaggi Chicago Pizza! It was delicious with rich cheese and honey, but it was a bit difficult to cut because of its shape." — October 2026, lunch before the theatre.

osaka_sushi_bakou_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Horse sashimi comes with a sweet soy sauce, the Harihari hot pot ends with soba, and courses include Saikyo-grilled fish and nigiri, which are usually seasoned with soy sauce containing wheat.
osaka_sushi_bakou_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of sushi and horse meat; the hot pot broth is made from bonito and horse bones (June 2026).
osaka_sushi_bakou_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and the day before or after a holiday 18:00–22:30, last order food 22:00, drinks 22:15; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Two seatings, 18:00 and 20:30, in December 2026; menus can be tailored to a budget (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 17 seats: 7 at the counter and sunken-kotatsu tables for 4 and 6 in a tatami room, which can be booked whole; non-smoking; children welcome; English, Simplified Chinese and Korean menus; digital menu (Tabelog). Opened 1 September 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_bakou_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, sushi and Kumamoto horse meat] A Kitashinchi restaurant that began as a horse-meat specialist and reopened as a sushi bar in September 2025, keeping horse meat sent from Kumamoto alongside the fish. The top course pairs the two: sea bream wrapped in kombu with horse meat and shiso, three cuts of horse sashimi with a sweet soy sauce, and a Harihari hot pot of horse meat and watercress in a bonito and horse-bone broth, between nigiri of marinated bluefin with a hidden dab of yuzu pepper, uni piled over the rice and abalone in liver sauce. Courses run ¥10,500–16,500; a sushi-only course suits diners who skip horse meat. Diners praise a friendly head chef and staff who pace dishes to the table; one family asked the chef for a sushi cake for a child's birthday (July 2026). Counter seats and sunken-kotatsu rooms; English, Chinese and Korean menus.

osaka_sumibi_yakiniku_daikan_higashishin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a charcoal yakiniku menu of beef, horumon and chicken; namul, kimchi and perilla leaves are the plant dishes mentioned.

osaka_sumibi_yakiniku_daikan_higashishin.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashi-Shinsaibashi near Nagahoribashi] A charcoal yakiniku restaurant filling a house on three floors near Nagahoribashi, the counter downstairs and smoking tables above, that describes itself as run by a "meat professional". The tongue is the order that diners repeat: salted, thick-cut, or with green-onion salt, then outside skirt, mino and the premium liver, many cuts in half portions so two people can try more. Finish with oxtail soup or cold noodles. It is often full, even on weekdays, so book; diners spent about ¥5,000–10,000 a head in 2026, and the all-you-can-drink courses for groups are ¥6,800 or ¥8,800. Closed Mondays.

osaka_yakiniku_musou_musashi_higashishin.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, until 3 a.m.] A 22-seat yakiniku room on Kasayacho Street among the bars between Namba and Shinsaibashi, buying from a long-established butcher and open until 3 a.m. six nights a week. It is known for raw-meat dishes: harami yukke stirred with egg yolk, raw tsurami, tongue sashimi and a heart sashimi under grated yam. Then the tongue platter of four kinds (¥2,728 for two in July 2026), harami, liver and white omasum on a flat roaster, and chige ramen to finish. Expect ¥6,000–8,000 a head. Smoking is allowed, so no one under 20; book early, and not for 19:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Enjoy the finest meat directly from a long-established butcher shop to your heart's content." An April 2025 diner calls it a yakiniku restaurant run by a butcher. Opened 10 September 2019.

osaka_osaka_udon_inanoji_sennichimae.notes: [Udon · Sennichimae, the taste of a lost noodle shop] A small udon shop a few minutes from Nippombashi Station, that recreated the dashi of the closed noodle shop 信濃そば without a written recipe, working from the memory of its taste (official site); the shop says well-known customers came back for it, and reviewers mention the comedians Downtown and the TV show Gobugobu. Order the meat udon (¥1,100 in October 2026): soft Osaka noodles, sweetish broth, tender meat and green onion; or the niku-sui with onigiri, the curry udon, or a kitsune udon. Expect a queue at 11:00 and on weekend lunches; order by QR code; about five counter seats downstairs and more up a steep stair. Closed Thursdays, and earlier when the noodles run out.

roles: Owner of 大阪うどん いなの路 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 大阪うどん いなの路 wanted to keep the taste of the earlier 信濃そば, whose detailed recipe did not survive, and recreated it over a long time from the memory of its flavour; news of the revival brought many famous people and customers back for the taste they knew. The dried-fish supplier and noodle maker have changed since then, but the taste is carried on, refined, with new small dishes to go with drinks. The owner 山根 正也 writes that the aim is for people across Japan to taste it. Branches: 桜井店 in 箕面市 (opened 27 June 2023) and 西宮えびす店 in 西宮市 (opened 5 December 2025). A regular of seven visits writes in October 2026 that the soup "took years to perfect" and is even better than the previous generation's.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Carry on the traditional taste while seeking development and improvement every day" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Meat udon; niku-sui; curry udon.

anecdotes.text: "I arrived around 11:40 AM, and it was fully packed with about 12-13 people waiting outside." — October 2026, meat udon after a 30-minute wait.
"There was no recipe, so it took years to perfect this soup. I believe the result is even better than the previous generation's soup." — October 2026, a seventh visit, curry soba with extra meat.
"To finish, I saved half of the seasoned rice and poured the meat and broth over it" — October 2026, meat soba and takikomi gohan.

osaka_yakiniku_wabisabi_hozenji.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The omakase course runs from tempura and kimchi through seasoned and marinated cuts, a sukiyaki-style thigh dipped in egg and sauce, seared meat sushi and soup; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_yakiniku_wabisabi_hozenji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Kobe-beef yakiniku course with seafood starters; salad, kimchi and vegetable tempura are its only plant dishes.

Menu in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean, and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). The shop text states it has Muslim-friendly certification (Tabelog). Opened 1 July 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_yakiniku_wabisabi_hozenji.notes: [Yakiniku · Hozenji Yokocho, Kobe-beef omakase] A Kobe-beef yakiniku restaurant inside the stone-paved Hozenji Yokocho, where an owner trained in kappo cooking adds Japanese touches to grilled meat (official site). The 12-dish omakase (¥16,500) is the way in: tempura or kombu-cured sea bream to start, seared salted yukke, aged tongue with sudachi, a Kobe chateaubriand or strip-loin steak, three lean cuts, sukiyaki-style thigh in egg, then seared meat sushi and dessert. The rooms are semi-private, with open ceilings. Many diners in 2026 were visitors from overseas; there is an English menu and English-speaking staff. Add 10% service; expect about ¥15,000–20,000 a head.

roles: Owner trained in kappo cooking, unnamed (official site)

An August 2026 diner credits the kombu-cured sea bream, vegetable tempura and okra-wrapped pork belly starters to the chef's kaiseki background. Opened 1 July 2022.

osaka_yakiniku_kitan_hozenji.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Courses include sauce-grilled cuts, ribeye in sukiyaki sauce, wasabi soy sauce and sudachi cold noodles. The listing asks guests to say in advance about allergies so that substitute dishes can be prepared.
osaka_yakiniku_kitan_hozenji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: aged wagyu, tongue, offal and raw-beef dishes.
osaka_yakiniku_kitan_hozenji.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed on some days (Tabelog). Lunch bentos and seat-only lunches take no reservations (about ten people were queuing five minutes before opening in September 2026); yakiniku courses, lunch included, need booking by the day before; dinner can be booked the same day (Tabelog). A 2-hour limit on busy days (Tabelog). Dinner service charge 5% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 40 seats, all in private rooms, for 2 up to 20–30, with tatami and sunken seating; shoes off; non-smoking; English menu; sommelier; children welcome with a kids menu (Tabelog; September 2026). osaka_yakiniku_kitan_hozenji.notes: [Yakiniku · Hozenji Yokocho, aged wagyu in private rooms] A yakiniku house in a 120-year-old Japanese restaurant building in Hozenji Yokocho, made over so that every seat is a private room, many of them tatami rooms with sunken seating where you take your shoes off. It belongs to the small Kitan group (its Minami-Senba shop is the original) and serves aged meat and aged tongue, mainly Matsusaka and Miyazaki's Kirishima beef bought from the producers. The ¥11,550 Hozenji course runs from three wagyu sashimi through aged salted tongue and tongue kalbi to aged cuts in sauce, fresh offal and sudachi cold noodles, with a dessert chosen from seven; lunch brings a ¥6,000 course or a queue for the ¥1,650 aged-tongue bento. Birthday diners in 2026 praised the staff, who kept one party's cake in the fridge and set out the party's shoes on leaving. Book courses by the day before; dinner adds 5% service. English menu.

roles: Kitchen and service staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: renovated from a 120-year-old Japanese restaurant building in Hozenji Yokocho, an alley kept since the Edo period; concept "enjoying meat from various angles", with aged meat, aged tongue and creative dishes; beef bought directly from producers, mainly Matsusaka beef and Kirishima beef from Miyazaki. Two Kitan yakiniku shops: the Minami-Senba main shop (osaka_yakiniku_kitan_minamisenba in data, whose record cites an official site listing 南船場, 法善寺 and 韻) and this one. Opened 3 April 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Enjoying meat from various angles" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged tongue; aged wagyu courses; aged-tongue bento.

anecdotes.text: "I brought a paper bag with a cake to enjoy at home, and the staff kindly offered to keep it in the refrigerator for us. When we left, they had neatly arranged our shoes" — October 2026, the Hozenji course for a birthday.
"The 'Premium' option includes the tongue root, while the 'Regular' features the middle or tip parts of the tongue." — September 2026, aged-tongue bento ¥1,650.

"The gentle texture of the earthen walls, along with the decorative alcove featuring pebbles, hanging scrolls, and a single flower vase, created a luxurious atmosphere" — October 2026, the Hozenji course ¥11,550.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 きたん 法善寺 (焼肉 㐂舌)、焼肉、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-12、なんば駅から徒歩5分、毎日11:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00、不定休、ランチの弁当と席のみは予約不可、焼肉コースは前日までに予約、ディナーは当日も可、混雑時は2時間制、ディナーはサービス料5%、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、40席、全席完全個室 (2名〜20〜30名)、座敷、掘りごたつ、禁煙、英語メニュー、ソムリエ、子ども・キッズメニュー可、2022年4月3日オープン、南船場本店と法善寺店の2店。店の紹介 (英訳): 築120年の和食店を改装、江戸時代から残る法善寺横丁、「お肉をいろいろな角度から楽しむ」、熟成肉と熟成タン、Matsusaka 牛と Miyazaki の Kirishima 牛を中心に生産者から直接仕入れ、アレルギーや苦手な食材は事前に伝えれば代わりの料理を用意。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 法善寺コース11,550円、きたんランチコース6,000円、熟成タン弁当 (並) 1,650円、開店前に約10人の行列、1階のレジで注文、2階の個室、厚切りの熟成タン、和牛の harami、シャトーブリアン、すだち冷麺、7種から選べるデザート、誕生日のケーキを冷蔵庫で預かってくれた、帰りに靴をそろえてくれた、海外の観光客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); private rooms throughout; many international tourists (October 2026).

osaka_le_cafe_v_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signatures are pastries and cakes (mille-feuille made to order, gateaux, a chocolate tart) and the lunch includes waffles, bread and pasta; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_le_cafe_v_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The cakes, lattes and gratin use cream, butter and milk; the lunch course includes tuna, ham, fish and wagyu.
osaka_le_cafe_v_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–20:00, last order 19:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations, walk-in only (Tabelog; August 2026); takeaway chocolates can be reserved through TableCheck (October 2026). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter, sofa seating and an open terrace; non-smoking (Tabelog). The entrance is separate from the store, by a lift to 7F (October 2026). Opened 1 February 2020 (Tabelog).
osaka_le_cafe_v_shinsaibashi.notes: [Café · Shinsaibashi, Louis Vuitton's café floor] The café on the seventh floor of the Louis Vuitton building on Midosuji, reached by its own lift away from the crowded store and sharing the floor with SUGALABO V. Expect the monogram everywhere: on the latte art of the ¥2,000 V Café latte, on the chocolate tart, on the waffle under a tuna tartare. The thing to order is the mille-feuille assembled to order with Madagascar vanilla cream (¥3,500, August 2026), or one of the gateaux, which run large, or a Yame matcha tiramisu. At lunch there is pasta and a seafood gratin, and a ¥20,000 seasonal course with a ¥14,000 pairing for a splurge. Diners in 2026 found the staff warm and the prices high but the setting worth it. Walk-in only; 10% service.

osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kamojin_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with salt or sauce, the sashimi with condiments that include sweet soy sauce, miso and garlic koji, and the menu has kara-age, grilled rice balls and soba to finish.
osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kamojin_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a duck and chicken specialist; even the potato salad is made with three cheeses.
osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kamojin_namba.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–02:00 (food last order 01:00, drinks 01:30); from November 2026 also open on Wednesdays, which were closed before (Tabelog). Reservations for two or more by the day before; call after 15:00 (Tabelog). Table charge ¥385 (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and other e-money, and QR payments including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 40 seats over three floors: a counter, and a private room for about 8 on 3F; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). A terrace seat (September 2026). Orders by call bell; a busy October 2026 night brought delays and forgotten items. Opened 30 July 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kamojin_namba.notes: [Yakitori · Sennichimae, duck until 2 a.m.] A three-storey yakitori house near Nankai Namba built around duck: Omi duck from Takashima in Shiga, and Yamato chicken raised for the group by a Nara farm, grilled over charcoal or served raw. Start with duck tataki of breast and thigh or a platter of chicken sashimi, eaten with house condiments such as garlic koji, yuzu and miso, then skewers of duck neck, heart and gizzard; fermentation runs through the menu, developed with a well-known fermentation specialist. There are oddities to try (caciocavallo grilled four ways, a three-cheese potato salad, duck kara-age) and soba with duck to finish. Open until 2 a.m. daily, so it works as a second stop; a counter suits solo diners. Diners in 2026 found it delicious if a little pricey for the portions, and one busy night slow. Raw chicken is served here.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing (English, machine-translated): duck and chicken dishes under the guidance of a fermentation chef known from the media; Omi duck raised in Takashima, Shiga, and Yamato chicken raised by 雅chickfarm in Nara for the group's sister shop, both raised stress-free; the duck and chicken are also sold. Sister shops nearby, listed by Tabelog: Gojin, Torijin and Sumiyaki Shoten Yo Namba. Opened 30 July 2023. A September 2026 diner notes the manager or chef at the grill explaining each dish.
chef_bio.philosophy: A theme of "fermentation" that is gentle on the body (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omi duck tataki and skewers; Yamato chicken sashimi; fermented dishes.

anecdotes.text: "We had homemade seasonings: garlic koji, yuzu, miso, wasabi, and salt. These homemade condiments were incredibly delicious!" — September 2026, duck tataki and chicken sashimi.
"Grilled over charcoal, it had a wonderful aroma and was rich with oil, making it absolutely exquisite even with a sprinkle of black shichimi on top." — September 2026, the edamame.
"It was fascinating to compare multiple parts on one plate, as each part had a different texture and flavor profile" — October 2026, Yamato chicken sashimi of five kinds.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 炭火焼き鳥 鴨尽、焼き鳥・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市中央区難波千日前3-19、南海なんば駅から徒歩3分、17:00〜翌2:00 (料理L.O.1:00、ドリンクL.O.1:30)、2026年11月から水曜も営業、予約は2名から前日まで、15時以降に電話、お通し代385円 (税込)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、40席 (1〜3階)、3階に8名ほどの個室、禁煙、子ども可、2023年7月30日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): Takashima (Shiga) の Omi の鴨と、雅chickfarm (Nara) がグループのために育てる Yamato の鶏、炭火焼きと発酵の料理、近くに姉妹店3店。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 鴨のたたき (むねともも)、鴨の刺身、鶏刺しの盛り合わせ、自家製の薬味 (にんにく麹、柚子、味噌、わさび、塩)、鴨のねぎま、ハツ、砂肝、首、うずらの卵、炭火の枝豆、カチョカヴァロ、3種のチーズのポテトサラダ、鴨の唐揚げ、焼きおにぎり、締めのそば、クラフトビール、鴨尽サワー、ノンアルコールも多い、テラス席、呼び鈴で注文、忙しい夜は遅れも、量のわりに少し高いという声。

osaka_eccomi_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu is built on homemade pasta, focaccia and bread, with gratins and breaded fish; no gluten-free handling described.
osaka_eccomi_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog marks vegetarian options, but no vegan information; the daily appetizers and pastas lean on ham, fish, cheese and cream.
osaka_eccomi_shinmachi.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 14:00), dinner 18:00–24:00 (last entry 22:00); closed Tuesday and on some other days; closes early when ingredients sell out (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seating may be changed to fit bookings (Tabelog). A queue at lunch opening (July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), iD, QUICPay and QR payments (Tabelog). 21 seats (8 at the counter, 13 at tables), private hire up to 50 standing; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Opened 13 September 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_eccomi_shinmachi.notes: [Italian · Shinmachi, a daily-changing menu] A small, wood-warm Italian in Shinmachi west of Nishi-Ohashi, with a single-slab counter cut from a tree said to be 2,000 years old and window seats for solo diners. There is no fixed menu: seafood comes from the central market each morning, and the list names only the main ingredient, leaving the cooking as a surprise. In the evening order three to five small plates (Spanish ham, baked eggplant with smoked mozzarella, horse mackerel with brown butter) and then a homemade pasta or a main; lunch is the bargain, ¥1,500 for a colourful appetizer plate, the day's pasta, focaccia and a drink (June 2026), and it queues at noon. One eight-time regular came back for a pasta of beef tongue and venison braised in red wine. Some dishes sell out early. Closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Eccomi、イタリアン・パスタ、大阪市西区新町2-18-19 四ツ橋三洋ハイツ 1F、西大橋駅1番出口から徒歩5分、12:00〜15:00 (最終入店14:00)・18:00〜24:00 (最終入店22:00)、火曜休み・不定休、食材がなくなりしだい終了、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、21席 (カウンター8、テーブル13)、貸切可、禁煙、車いす可、子ども・ベビーカー可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2021年9月13日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 季節の食材、中央市場の鮮魚、決まったメニューはなく毎日変わる、前菜を3〜5品のあと自家製パスタかメイン、18か月熟成の Spain の生ハム、樹齢約2000年の木のカウンターとテーブル、グラスワイン3種、ボトル10種、Hiroshima のレモンの自家製レモンサワー。口コミ(2025年6月〜2026年7月): パスタランチ1,500円 (前菜の盛り合わせ、本日のパスタ、フォカッチャ、ドリンク)、2025年6月は1,400円、トマトとペコリーノのパスタは800円増し、牛タンと鹿の赤ワイン煮込みのパスタ、昼は開店から行列、売り切れも、メニューには主な食材だけ、とうもろこしの冷製スープ、昆布を使った鯛のカルパッチョ、生ハム、アジのフライと焦がしバター、なすとスモークモッツァレラ、しらすとレモンのクリームパスタ、ゆずの豚肩、きのこのグラタン、豚バラのリゾット、若い料理人。

osaka_absinthe_org_kitte_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information beyond Tabelog's "allergy information available". Plates and wraps come with pita or baguette, and there are pies and pasta; the falafel salad and grills may suit, but nothing is described as gluten-free and the fryer is not described.
osaka_absinthe_org_kitte_osaka.vegan_detail: Vegan options: a vegan plate of vegetables and beans and a vegan lunch with a chickpea dip (October 2026 reviews), a vegan wrap on the breakfast menu (September 2026), and falafel with hummus; Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options. Ask which dressings are vegan and whether the falafel shares a fryer.
osaka_absinthe_org_kitte_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 8:00–23:00, last order 22:00; closed when KITTE Osaka closes (Tabelog). Breakfast plates in the morning, lunch plates and dinner courses (2026 reviews). Reservations accepted; lunch 90 minutes and dinner 2 hours; 18:00–21:00 one drink and one food item per person (Tabelog). At breakfast you order at the counter and collect with a call bell (September 2026); at dinner you order on your phone (October 2026). Takeaway and an eat-in corner (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay and other QR (Tabelog). 45 table seats, terrace seats in the free space; non-smoking, smoking area in the building (Tabelog). Menu in English, Chinese and Korean, English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 31 July 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_absinthe_org_kitte_osaka.notes: [Mediterranean · Umeda, falafel and salads under KITTE] An all-day Mediterranean bar and canteen in the basement of KITTE Osaka, straight off the JR station, open from 8:00 for breakfast plates and açaí bowls, through lunch to dinner with absinthe cocktails. The draw is the falafel: fried to order, three to a regular salad bowl with hummus, pickles and a spicy tahini dressing (¥1,100, July 2026), or stuffed into warm pita to take away. Vegans get a plate of vegetables and beans, a vegan lunch with a chickpea dip and a vegan wrap, and one October 2026 diner called vegan food here a rare find in Japan. Meat eaters have grilled chicken or beef kebab in pita, and the apple pie, a whole apple in crust, is the one a diner knew from Absinthe Cafe in Yotsubashi (October 2026). Many take away; the eat-in room was quiet on a weekday noon (August 2026). Dinner courses with drinks start at ¥5,500.

osaka_muse_umekita_grand_front.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The lunch buffet centres on stone-oven pizza and the mains are pasta, curry and grills with breadcrumbs; salads and grills are the likeliest options, but nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_muse_umekita_grand_front.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegetarian options" and the buffet has farm-vegetable salads, but no vegan or vegetarian dish is named; pizzas come with cheese and a pumpkin salad had bacon (October 2026).
osaka_muse_umekita_grand_front.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00, last order 22:00; lunch 11:00–14:30; closed 1 January (Tabelog); the official site says irregular holidays. Reservations accepted for dining only, not the café; lunch 90 minutes, dinner 120 minutes; a seat-only booking has no salad buffet or free drinks (Tabelog). At dinner, one drink and one food item each, ordered by QR code (August 2026). A weekday diner who had once waited booked the buffet ahead the next time (August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). 50 seats with sofa seats over the night view; private hire for 20 to 50; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Takeaway and delivery (Tabelog). Opened 26 April 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_muse_umekita_grand_front.notes: [Italian · Umekita, a lunch buffet over the city] A big, bright café-restaurant on the restaurant floor of Grand Front Osaka's North Building, named after a museum and meant as "a playground for adults" (official site), with sofa seats facing the Umeda night view. Lunch is the draw: pick a main (weekly pasta, a keema curry or grilled fish) and the price includes a buffet of farm-vegetable salads, starters and thin, crisp stone-oven pizza, plus free drinks that run to red and white wine, with apple and chocolate dessert pizzas brought out late (August–October 2026). Expect ¥1,900–2,400, a little less if seated before 11:30. At night it is a wine bar of pizza, pasta, ajillo and grills, one drink and one dish each. Diners praise the value; one found it noisy and the staff's language casual (September 2026). Book the weekday buffet.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); sommelier on staff (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (muse-umekita.com, read 2026-11-01): a "restaurant & café as an adult's playground", menu built on the theme "Farm to table", with vegetables from contract farms every morning, organic wine at reasonable prices and homemade dolci of seasonal fruit; the name comes from a museum, a space where food and art meet. Opened 26 April 2013 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Farm to table" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch buffet with stone-oven pizza; Quattro Formaggi with honey.

anecdotes.text: "There was apple pizza and chocolate pizza, which turned into a bit of a competition to grab." — August 2026, of the dessert pizzas brought out late in a weekday buffet lunch.
"I was pleasantly surprised to find honey available at the buffet (it's delicious when you dip it in the crust of the pizza!)." — October 2026.
"However, the restaurant was a bit noisy, and I noticed some staff members were chatting casually and not using proper language" — September 2026, buffet lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: muse umekita (ミュゼ ウメキタ)、気軽に立ち寄れる大人の遊び場的レストラン&カフェ、「Farm to table」がテーマ、契約農家から毎朝届く農園野菜のサラダ、魚介のカルパッチョ、アヒージョ、グリル、石窯ナポリピッツァ、パスタ、オーガニックワイン、旬のフルーツの自家製ドルチェ、自然派イタリアン、グランフロント大阪北館6F UMEKITA FLOOR、11:00〜23:00、不定休、梅田の夜景のソファー席、店名はミュージアムから。平日限定ビュッフェランチ2,180円 (農園野菜サラダ、前菜、石窯ナポリピッツァ、フリードリンク、メインは週替わりパスタ3種、大山鶏と彩り野菜のキーマカレー、メカジキのグリル)、90分。土日祝のプレミアムランチ: カジュアル2,580円、スタンダード2,980円、シェア2,700円。ディナー: 契約農家直送サラダ1,180円〜、生ハム780円〜、前菜680円〜、アヒージョ1,180円、揚げ物880円〜、ピッツァ1,080円〜、パスタ1,880円〜、グリル1,080円〜、肉メイン2,480円〜。11月1日から WINTER FAIR 2026。食べログ (店舗会員): イタリアン・ビュッフェ・ダイニングバー、大阪市北区大深町3-1 グランフロント大阪北館 6F、JR 大阪駅から徒歩1分、11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、1月1日休み、予約は食事のみ、ランチ90分、ディナー120分、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、50席、禁煙、子ども可、ソムリエ、2013年4月26日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): メインで値段が決まるビュッフェランチ1,890円〜2,380円、11時〜11時半は1,700円、ワインもフリードリンク、デザートピッツァ、はちみつ、カボチャサラダのベーコン、タコのミートソースパスタ、マルゲリータ、エビのアヒージョ、チーズの盛り合わせ1,280円、カプレーゼ680円、白桃とアールグレイのティーソーダ780円、夜景、ひとり1ドリンク1フード、QR コードで注文、にぎやか、スタッフの言葉づかいが気になったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Buffet lunch with a main chosen from a short list; QR-code ordering at dinner (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_shinya_ekimae_dai2.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers are grilled on the teppan with salt or sauce; yakisoba, gyoza, garlic fried rice and potato salad with baguette are on the menu, and nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_shinya_ekimae_dai2.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-and-seafood skewer izakaya; even the Okinawa-style yakisoba is topped with bonito flakes (June 2026). Grilled yam and sweet potato skewers exist, but the yam is made with egg and the sweet potato with butter.
osaka_shinya_ekimae_dai2.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:30 (last order food 22:30, drinks 23:00), open year-round (Tabelog). Diners describe weekends and holidays starting from about 15:00 (September 2026) and a Sunday visit right after a 15:30 opening (Tabelog review preview), so check the time before a daytime visit. Reservations accepted; a table is held 15 minutes (Tabelog). Smoking allowed at every seat (Tabelog; diners noted it, June 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payment including Alipay and WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 44 seats: 10 at the counter, 34 at tables (Tabelog). Daily specials on a blackboard (August 2026). Opened 29 May 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_shinya_ekimae_dai2.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, teppan skewers under the station buildings] A loud, Showa-retro skewer bar in the basement arcade of Osaka Ekimae Dai-2 Building, a minute from Kitashinchi Station, open from late morning to 23:30 since 2013, one of two shops of 株式会社しん家 with a takoyaki bar in the Dai-4 Building. Skewers start at ¥100 and are cooked on a flat iron, not a grill: beef skirt, chicken neck and tail, a fluffy yam set with egg, spam steak, and seasonal seafood. Around them go Okinawa-style yakisoba with a shisa-shaped fishcake, rare wagyu shabu under an egg yolk, garlic rice with horumon, and blackboard specials. A regular missed the old staff and the louder calls of "Oi oi! Yoi yoi!" (April and July 2026), but found the food as good as ever. All-you-can-drink was ¥1,000 a head (June 2026). Smoking is allowed at every seat.

roles: Grill and floor staff of 株式会社しん家 (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (shinya-inc.com, read 2026-11-01): 株式会社しん家 runs two shops in the Osaka Ekimae buildings, 鉄板串酒場 しん家 (Dai-2 Building B1F 52) and たこ焼酒場 しん家 (Dai-4 Building B1F 50), serving skewers and takoyaki with a wide drink list. Per Tabelog: teppan skewers from ¥100 in a Showa-retro room; seasonal "seafood skewers"; opened 29 May 2013. A regular on an eighth visit noted that the staff had completely changed by April 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan skewers; grilled yam; Okinawa-style yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: "The unique calls of this restaurant, 'Oi Oi!', 'Yoi Yoi!', 'Yoi Yoi Yoi!'—I don't really understand them, but the voices are quieter than before!" — April 2026, a seventh visit.
"As for the spam steak, I didn't realize it was spam until I took a bite, but I instantly recognized the flavor I love" — July 2026, after a concert, at 22:00.
"The avocado salad, chicken sashimi, and Okinawan-style yakisoba (the shisa-shaped kamaboko was so cute!) were all delicious." — June 2026, a weekday after 21:00.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 株式会社しん家、鉄板串酒場 しん家 (大阪市北区梅田1丁目2-2 大阪駅前第2ビル地下1階52号) と たこ焼酒場 しん家 (梅田1丁目11-4 梅田駅前第4ビル地下1階50号)、串焼きとたこ焼きが中心、種類豊富なドリンク、大きな宴会から小さな宴会まで。食べログ (店舗会員): しん家、串焼き・居酒屋・鉄板焼き、北新地駅から徒歩1分、JR 大阪駅から5分、毎日11:00〜23:30 (L.O.料理22:30、ドリンク23:00)、年中無休、予約は15分まで、全席喫煙可、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、44席 (カウンター10、テーブル34)、昭和レトロ、100円からの創作串、旬の魚介の「海鮮串」、日本酒と焼酎、2013年5月29日オープン、おまかせコース1,500円、90分飲み放題つき3,000円、満腹コース2,300円。口コミ(2026年4月〜9月): ハラミ、せせり、ぼんじり、ふわふわの長いも焼き、スパムステーキ、豚巻きアスパラ、うずらのベーコン巻き、鯛のカルパッチョ串、さつまいものメープルバター、牛のレアしゃぶと卵黄、ポテトサラダとバゲット、アボカドサラダ、鶏刺し、Okinawa 風焼きそばと shisa のかまぼこ、ホルモン炒めとガーリックライス、ガーリック牛めし、ホルモン焼きそば、黒板の本日のおすすめ、飲み放題1,000円、スタッフが入れ替わり掛け声が小さくなったという常連、全席喫煙、週末は15時ごろから。

cultural_comfort.note: A busy counter-and-table skewer bar with a photo menu (Tabelog); smoking at every seat. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing and the company site; reviews dated through September 2026.

osaka_steak_ron_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Teppanyaki steak is seared plainly, but the courses include a house sauce, the signature shrimp in an egg sauce and glaze, red miso soup and a rice dish that may be curry or fried rice.
osaka_steak_ron_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Kobe-beef and wagyu teppanyaki courses with shrimp, beef appetizers and red miso soup.
osaka_steak_ron_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Dinner Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:30); lunch on some Thursdays to Saturdays 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30), on days marked "L" in the monthly calendar on the official site; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog; official site). Reservations by phone, best 12:00–17:30 or 20:00–21:00; online booking too; groups of five or more by phone only (Tabelog; official site). Prices include tax; 10% service charge at dinner (Tabelog; official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 17 seats: an L-shaped counter of 10 around the teppan and a private room for up to 7; non-smoking; BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Founded 1964 (official site).
osaka_steak_ron_kitashinchi.notes: [Steak · Kitashinchi, Kobe-beef teppanyaki since 1964] A Kitashinchi steakhouse that has grilled there for some sixty years, renovated in 2020 with Baccarat lamps and glassware, a ten-seat L-shaped counter and a private room for seven. Every seat faces the iron, where the cook grills Kobe beef from Ota Farm, timing each piece to your pace (official site). The dish diners single out is the golden-grilled wild shrimp, a house signature since the opening, glazed in an egg sauce one August 2026 diner compared to sukiyaki: "you could come here just for this dish". Courses run from ¥13,200 for black wagyu to ¥29,700 for 150 g of Kobe chateaubriand, plus 10% service, and end with a choice of rice, from Kobe-beef shigure on rice to garlic rice. One September 2026 diner found the room dark and heavy; others call it a place for birthdays and business dinners.

roles: Teppanyaki cooks (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (steakron.com, read 2026-11-01): founded in Kitashinchi in 1964 ("北新地で創業60年"); exterior and interior renewed in 2020; a ten-seat L-shaped counter and a private room for up to seven, with Baccarat lamps and glasses; steaks of Kobe beef from 太田牧場; a licence to serve raw beef; "天然海老の黄金焼き" has been a signature since the founding; steaks are cooked to the temperature and doneness that suit each guest's pace. A July 2026 diner noted foreign guests and some foreign staff and believed English-speaking guests can be looked after.
chef_bio.philosophy: "本物だけがもつ極上の味わいと贅沢な時間" (the finest flavour and luxurious time that only the real thing has; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe-beef steak from Ota Farm; golden-grilled wild shrimp.

anecdotes.text: "The signature dish, grilled shrimp in golden sauce, is unlike anything I've ever tasted. … Honestly, you could come here just for this dish!" — August 2026, a course with both strip loin and fillet.
"Kesennuma Shark Fin Steak with Ron Style Sauce. I always request this as an addition when making a reservation." — December 2025, an eighth visit, on the last day of the year.
"I've always disliked the sharpness of wasabi, so I never ate it before, but the wasabi here was truly delicious!" — June 2026, in the private room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 北新地 ステーキ ロン、太田牧場産 神戸牛専門の鉄板焼き、北新地駅から徒歩約1分、北新地で創業60年、2020年に外観・内観をリニューアル、10席のL字カウンターと最大7名の個室、バカラのランプやグラス、客席はすべて鉄板に面する、食べるスピードに合わせて温度と焼き加減を調整、神戸牛のサーロインのお刺身や神戸牛ヒウチの炭火焼などのオードブル、生食販売の許可、創業以来の名物「天然海老の黄金焼き」。ステーキロン〜since1964〜スペシャルディナーコース13,200円〜 (肉の種類とグラム数で変わる): 神戸牛サーロインまたはフィレ100g19,800円・120g22,000円・150g24,750円、神戸牛シャトーブリアン100g24,200円〜150g29,700円、特選黒毛和牛フィレ100g13,200円〜150g16,500円、特選黒毛和牛シャトーブリアン100g15,950円〜150g19,800円、季節の焼野菜、色彩胡麻風味のオニオンサラダ、〆のご飯もの (神戸牛のしぐれ煮と赤玉子かけご飯、スパイシーカレー、牛すじ入り焼きめし、ガーリックライス)、赤だし、香の物、特製アシェットデセール、珈琲・紅茶・ハーブティー。コース 雪19,800円 (120g)、月22,000円 (150g)。鳥取県産特別栽培米コシヒカリ。税込、別途サービス料10%。月ごとの定休日とランチ営業日のお知らせ。食べログ (店舗会員): ステーキ・ハンバーグ・鉄板焼き、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-10-2 北新地プレイス 1F、月〜水17:00〜22:00 (L.O.20:30)、木〜土11:30〜14:30 (L.O.13:30)、17:00〜22:00、日・祝休み、ランチは決まった日のみ、電話は12時〜17時半か20時〜21時に、5名以上は電話のみ、サービス料10% (ディナー)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、17席、禁煙、持ち込み可、雪コース19,800円、ランチ C コース13,200円、クリスマスコース26,400円。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): テールとフカヒレのダブルコンソメ、サーロインのお刺身と yama wasabi、タルタルの最中、ローストビーフ、天然海老、Kesennuma のフカヒレステーキ、百合根の炊き込みご飯、ヴィシソワーズ、とうもろこしご飯、黄金焼きは卵のソースで、すき焼きのような味、雰囲気が暗いという声、海外の客とスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter teppanyaki cooked in front of you; a July 2026 diner saw foreign staff and believed English-speaking guests can be served. Book by phone.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing and the official site with the November 2026 calendar; reviews dated through October 2026.
